无论法向力如何，都可以施加至少此幅度的

A function library with wrappers around the getter/setter functions for FSubobjectData

为FSubobjectData提供了一个带有getter/setter函数包装的函数库，

此发射器中渲染器引用的所有网格体的列表。根据可扩展性设置，在已烘焙的目标平台上实际可能会更少。

在PostLoad()中构建的收藏夹列表（从描述文件或

Key: A list of nodes that can add actors to all connections. They don't necessarily *have to* add actors to each connection, but they will get a chance to. These are added via ::AddGlobalGraphNode

用于识别特定控制板操作的字符串列表。
这是用户自定义自己的集后保存的内容，
直到PreSave才会保存。

Key: A material assigned on a volumetric cloud component does not have the UsedWithVolumetricCloud flag set.

Value: 使用线性斜率乘数增加或减少浮点/颜色值的对比度的材质表达式。

Key:
A Material is an asset which can be applied to a mesh to control the visual look of the scene.

Warning: Creating new materials directly increases shader compile times!  Consider creating a Material Instance off of an existing material instead.
Value:
材质是一个资产，可应用到网格体来控制场景的视觉外观。
当来自场景的光线到达表面时，材质的着色模型用于计算光线与表面的交互方式。

Key: A material used to render debug meshes with kind of flat shading, mostly used by Visual Logger tool.
Value: 用于渲染调试带有平整着色的网格体的材质，主要由可视记录器工具使用。

Key: A material used to render debug opaque material. Used in various animation editor viewport features.
Value: 用于渲染调试不透明材质的材质。在诸多动画编辑器视口功能中使用。

Value: 允许修改材质参数集合中的标量和向量参数的修饰符。

Key: A multipler on the particle count. By default a single particle is burst from every particle within the cache.
Value: 粒子数量倍率。默认情况下，缓存中的每个粒子都会爆发生成一个粒子。

Key: A new material instance of the specified base material will be created and set with the imported material data.
Value: 将创建指定基础材质的新材质实例，并以导入的材质数据进行设置。

A Niagara System contains multiple Niagara Emitters to create various effects.
Niagara Systems can be placed in the world, unlike Emitters, and expose User Parameters to configure an effect at runtime.
Value:
Niagara系统包含多个Niagara发射器，以创造各种效果。
与发射器不同，Niagara系统可以放置在世界中，并公开用户参数，以在运行时配置效果。

Key:
A node handling expansion of UNiagaraDataChannelLibrary::ReadFromNiagaraDataChannelSingle_WithContext.

处理UNiagaraDataChannelLibrary::ReadFromNiagaraDataChannelSingle_WithContext扩展的节点。
这会扩展为多个函数调用，用于读取各个NDC变量。

处理UNiagaraDataChannelLibrary::WriteToNiagaraDataChannelSingle_WithContext扩展的节点。
这会扩展为多个函数调用，用于写入各个NDC变量。

Value: 节点，用户可利用其在输入类型的任意集中连接内部组件，来构建任意输出类型的集。

脚本资产的路径，可在首次生成默认引脚时用于指定函数脚本。如使用此路径，无需加载所有实际

每秒从输出值扣除一定百分比。

A position offset of the sampled noise.

Usually kept at Engine.Time to break up the pattern a bit.

采样噪声的位置偏移。

通常保持为 Engine.Time，以稍微打散噪声图案。

Value: 对圆锥向量与中心轴比较结果施加幂函数；粒子越偏离圆锥轴，贡献越小，从而衰减边缘粒子速度。

对指定事件的引用（存在于一个蓝图图表中）。只
用于“停靠”的控制板中。

Value: 基于微面模型和通用Schlick菲涅尔曲线的反射/透射BSDF节点。

Value:
脚本的堆栈层级根，表示堆栈中的UNiagaraHierarchyRootObject。
它创建与它所代表的UNiagaraHierarchyRoot的子项等效的类别和输入。

这避免了层级设置成为_必需_，而是变成可选

决定各类场景元素可见性的一组标志（FEngineShowFlags），以字符串形式保存。
由于FEngineShowFlags过于复杂，UHT无法正确解析，因此必须保存为字符串。

与堆栈问题关联的单个自动修复操作。

Key:
A single entry in a dynamic-input chain, carrying both topology metadata and the resolved value.
Nested child entries are accessible via Inputs (one per direct input of the dynamic input script).

The FInstancedStruct wrapper pattern (FNiagaraExt_DynamicInputChainRef declared before this struct)
avoids the UHT "struct recursion via arrays" restriction that blocks direct self-reference.
The schema generator detects the self-reference and emits a typed stub at the recursion boundary;
the wire format itself recurses to arbitrary depth.
Value:
动态输入链中的单个条目，同时携带拓扑元数据和已解析的值。
嵌套子条目可通过输入访问（动态输入脚本的每个直接输入都会对应一个子项）。

FInstancedStruct封装器模式（FNiagaraExt_DynamicInputChainRef在此结构体之前声明）
避免了UHT“通过数组进行结构体递归”的限制，该限制会阻止直接自引用。
模式生成器检测到自引用并在递归边界处发出类型化存根；
连线格式本身递归到任意深度。

Key:
A single resolved input value paired with its name.
Used within FNiagaraExt_ModuleInputValues to return all input values for a module in one call.
Value:
与它的名称配对的单个已解析输入值。
在FNiagaraExt_ModuleInputValues中使用，用于在一次调用中返回模块的所有输入值。

Value: 一个定义此输入值的右值HLSL表达式。必须是单个右值，不带变量定义或返回语句等。例如，颜色可以使用表达式“float4(1.0,(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)”

堆栈验证器报告的Niagara堆栈条目上的单个警告或错误问题。
位置和堆栈显示路径帮助AI识别堆栈中的问题所在。

获得此ID时的唯一标签。
在粒子消亡且另一粒子重新使用其索引时，利用此标签可在粒子间区分。

Key:

Key:
A value of 0 will prevent the surface normal from being randomized within a cone. A value of 1 will spread the normal's possibility space into a normal aligned hemisphere.

 Each subsequent particle is places in a monotonically increasing bucket, wrapped by partition count

Key:
Capture frames from the provided simulation into a SimCache until the simulation becomes inactive or completes.
Capture occurs at the end of each frame with the first frame being this frame.
CaptureRate allows you to reduce the rate of capture, i.e. a rate of 2 would capture frames 0, 2, 4, etc.
When AdvanceSimulation is true we will manually advance the simulation until the capture is complete inside a loop, rather than reading from the component each frame.
Value:
从提供的模拟中捕获帧到SimCache中，直到模拟变为不激活或完成。
捕获发生在每一帧的末尾，第一帧就是这一帧。
CaptureRate允许你减少捕获的速率，即2的速率将捕获0、2、4帧，以此类推。
当AdvanceSimulation为true时，我们将在循环中手动前进模拟，直到捕获完成，而非逐帧从组件读取。

Key:

Key:
Compose two transforms in order: A * B.

Order matters when composing transforms:
A * B will yield a transform that logically first applies A then B to any subsequent transformation.

Example: LocalToWorld = ComposeTransforms(DeltaRotation, LocalToWorld) will change rotation in local space by DeltaRotation.
Example: LocalToWorld = ComposeTransforms(LocalToWorld, DeltaRotation) will change rotation in world space by DeltaRotation.

@return New transform: A * B
Value:
按此顺序合成2个变换：A * B。

合成变换时，顺序至关重要：
A * B将产生一个变换，该变换逻辑上会先后将A与B应用到任何后续变换。

例如：LocalToWorld = ComposeTransforms（DeltaRotation，LocalToWorld）会利用DeltaRotation改变局部空间中的旋转。
例如：LocalToWorld = ComposeTransforms（LocalToWorld，DeltaRotation）会利用DeltaRotation改变场景空间中的旋转。

Compresses the texture source with JPEG.  This makes the uasset smaller on disk, but lower quality and slower to access.

JPEG does not make the runtime game asset smaller on disk, only the source uasset.  JPEG can only be used on simple 2d textures.

Only acts on texture sources that are 8 bit.  You may wish to use ConvertTo8bitTextureSource before this, optionally.

Only acts on textures larger than FilterThresholdValue.  Use FilterThresholdValue = 0 to disable filtering by size.

Returns Success if the action was done, returns AlreadyDone if the action did not need to be done because texture already met the goal.

使用JPEG压缩纹理源。这会使磁盘上的uasset更小，但质量更低，访问速度更慢。

Key: Decide whether to write the sending particles' position and velocity directly to the receiving event particles
Value: 决定是否将发送粒子的位置和速度直接写入接收事件的粒子。

Key: Decide whether to write to Particles.MeshOrientation or to simply pass the calculated Orientation value through as a module Output.

Declares the associated input is used as an inline edit condition toggle, so it should be hidden and edited as a

声明关联输入用作内联编辑条件切换，因此其应隐藏并被编辑为
      和指定为其编辑条件的输入内联的勾选框。

Key: Declaring a unique target for the "Sequencer Mixer Target" node in an Anim BP. Will match the node's name with the name specified here.
Value: 在Anim BP中为“Sequencer Mixer Target”节点声明一个唯一的目标。节点名称将与此处指定的名称匹配。

Key: Decouple the resolution of the lighting grids from the resolution of the attribute grid. The lighting grid can generally be smaller, saving memory and computations, at the cost of less crisp shadows.
Value: 将光照网格分辨率与属性网格分离。光照网格通常可更小，从而节省内存和计算，但阴影清晰度会降低。

Key: Decouple the resolution of the lighting grids from the resolution of the SCALAR grid. The lighting grid can generally be smaller, saving memory and computations.
Value: 将光照网格分辨率与标量网格分离。光照网格通常可以更小，从而节省内存和计算。

Key: Default addressing mode used when sampling the baked out texture. Can be overridden by material- and input-specific bake settings, see GLTFMaterialExportOptions.
Value: 采样烘焙的纹理时使用的默认寻址模式。可以被材质和输入特定的烘焙设置覆盖，参见GLTFMaterialExportOptions。

Key:
Default Cell Size. Can be overridden by users via the AccessContext.
Internal data and their spawned handler FX are bucketed internally in a world aligned grid of cells.
Value:
默认单元格大小。用户可以通过AccessContext重载。
内部数据及其生成的处理器FX在内部以世界对齐的单元格网格形式存储。

Key:
Default distribution LookupValueMode the enumeration used can be overridden using metadata on the property, i.e. DistributionLookupValueEnumPath="/Script/Niagara.ENiagaraDistributionLookupValueMode"
Random is a special value discovered when packing the distribution data, the max number of potential values is based on EFlags::LookupValueModeMask - 1
Meta data TimeRangeMode is used to drive how the time range will be calculated when not overriden by the user, see ENiagaraDistributionTimeRangeMode
Value:
默认分布LookupValueMode使用的枚举值可以使用属性上的元数据重载，即DistributionLookupValueEnumPath="/Script/Niagara.ENiagaraDistributionLookupValueMode"

Value: 采样烘焙的纹理时使用的默认过滤模式。可以被材质和输入特定的烘焙设置覆盖，参见GLTFMaterialExportOptions。

Key: Default found for {0}, but the parameter map source for default pins needs to be a {1} node, not a generic input node.
Value: 找到了{0}的默认项，但默认引脚的参数映射源必须是一个{1}节点，而非泛型输入节点。

Value: 在选定细节面板中使用下拉控件进行默认初始化。重载参数定义默认值。

Key: Default initialize using a value widget in the Selected Details panel. Overrides the parameter definition default value.
Value: 在选定细节面板中使用值控件进行默认初始化。重载参数定义默认值。

Key: Default lit material. Perfect for catching shadows and/or reflections, but poor alpha edge quality due to masked alpha.
Value: 默认光照材质。适合捕捉阴影/反射，但因Alpha遮罩导致Alpha边缘质量较差。

Key: Default Mesh is set but Source Mode is set to Default.  Verify you have not left it set incorrectly to avoid unused meshes being referenced.
Value: 已设置默认网格体，但源模式设为默认。请确认设置正确，以免引用未使用的网格体。

Key: Default Rotational Inertia to Mass in the case of Rotational Inertia being unset. Allows for more intuitive behavior when mass and rotational forces interact.
Value: 未设置转动惯量时，默认将其设为质量。质量与旋转力交互时可获得更直观行为。

Key: Default size of the baked out texture (containing the material input). Can be overridden by material- and input-specific bake settings, see GLTFMaterialExportOptions.
Value: 烘焙的纹理的默认大小（包含材质输入）。可以被材质和输入特定的烘焙设置覆盖，参见GLTFMaterialExportOptions。

Key:
Default System Bounds Padding. Can be overridden by users via the AccessContext.
Niagara Systems spawned by this NDC will have their bounds padded by this amount.
For attached systems, the bounds will be the component bounds + padding.

默认系统边界填充。可由用户通过AccessContext重载。
由此NDC生成的Niagara系统将按此值填充其边界。
对于附加系统，边界为组件边界+填充。
对于非附加系统，边界为CellSize+填充。

Key: Default Textures. At runtime, based on cook output, if ShouldStripUnusedDefaultTextures returns true.
Value: 默认纹理。在运行时，基于烘焙输出，如果ShouldStripUnusedDefaultTextures返回true。

Key: Default value for @@ on @@ has changed and this asset is from a version that may have had incorrect default value information - verify and resave
Value: @@ 上的 @@ 默认值已发生变化，此资产来自可能拥有错误默认值信息的版本——请验证并重新保存

Key:
Default value, used when the Interaction State is "None".
Optional to allow explicit un-setting, implying inheritance or some other value source.
Value:
默认值，当交互状态为“无”时使用。
可选，允许显式取消设置，暗示继承或其他值来源。

Key: Default view mode to use for child actor components in a Blueprint actor's component tree hierarchy (experimental).
Value: 默认视图模式，用于蓝图Actor组件树层级中的子Actor组件（实验性）。

Key: DEFAULT: If the loop count really did go up but we aren't using a delay, we need to decide on the new loop variables

Defaults to false. The user can populate this input with any equation that can be evaluated as true or false. Example: is X greater than Y?

Value: 默认为假，可填入任何可求值为真／假的表达式；Execute 首次满足触发条件时返回真，后续执行返回假。

Key: Defaults to Output.Collision.CombinedCollisionNormal. This vector defines the collision surfaces normal vector.
Value: 默认为 Output.Collision.CombinedCollisionNormal。此向量定义碰撞表面的法线向量。

Key: Defaults to Output.Collision.Valid. Determines when the particle's angular velocity should be dampened.
Value: 默认为 Output.Collision.Valid。确定何时应衰减粒子的角速度。

Key: DefaultValue branch does not match parameter '{0}' (declared type '{1}'). Pick the FNiagaraExt_VariableValue branch that matches the parameter's type.
Value: 默认值分支与参数“{0}”（声明的类型“{1}”）不匹配。选择与参数类型匹配的FNiagaraExt_VariableValue分支。

Key:
Define sub-subsurface used behavior of the slab. This option trades quality over performance and will result into visual differences.
 * For slab not sitting at the bottom of the topology (e.g. slabs stacked with a vertial operator), only the SimpleVolume SSS type is available.
 * In non-opaque blend modes, SSS Diffusion and SSS Diffusion Profile are not available and will fallback onto Wrap mode.
Value:
定义板的次表面使用行为。这个选项将以质量换取性能，会造成视觉上的差异。
* 对于不在拓扑底部的板（举例而言，使用垂直操作符堆叠的板），仅可使用SimpleVolumeSSS类型。
* 在非不透明混合模式下，SSS漫反射和SSS漫反射描述文件不可用，并将回退到“包裹”模式。

Key: Define the length of the reflected trace's debug line. The magnitude of the force will be used as the line's length if left unchecked.
Value: 定义反射追踪调试线的长度。未勾选时，使用力的大小作为线段长度。

Key:
Define the volume that the particles will occupy. 

See the "Dimensions Definition" drop down for additional information.
Value:
定义粒子占据的体积。

更多信息请参见“尺寸定义”下拉选项。

Key:
Defines a single token in a format for displaying dynamic input trees inline in the UI.  These tokens can represent the
      inputs to the dynamic input or additional text and layout options.
Value:
定义了单个标记的格式，用于显示在UI中内联的动态输入树。这些标记可以表示
到动态输入的输入或额外的文本和布局选项。

Key: Defines different modes for offsetting UVs by age when ordering ribbon particles using normalized age.
Value: 使用标准化年龄排序条带粒子时，根据年龄决定偏移UV的不同模式。

Key: Defines different modes for selecting the output numeric type of a function or operation based on the types of the inputs.
Value: 基于输入的类型而定义不同模式，以用于选择函数或运算的输出数字类型。

Key: Defines how quickly the band reaches 1.0. At zero the band ramps from 0-1 from Min to half way between Min and Max, then back down again by the time the scalar reaches Max. The band will hit 1.0 faster as the sharpness increases until it ends up as a box curve.
Value: 定义带状值达到 1.0 的速度；锐度越高越快达到 1.0，最终形成盒形曲线。

Key:
Defines how the material reacts on DBuffer decals (Affects look, performance and texture/sample usage).
Non DBuffer Decals can be disabled on the primitive (e.g. static mesh)
Value:
定义DBuffer贴花上的材质反应方式（影响外观、性能和纹理/采样使用）。
非DBuffer贴花可在基元上禁用（如静态网格体）

Key: Defines how the material reacts on DBuffer decals, later we can expose more variants between None and Default.
Value: 定义此材质在DBuffer贴花上的反应，之后可公开“空”和“默认”之间的更多变体。

Key:
Defines how traces tagged as 'Project Default' will be interpreted when using the AsyncGpuTrace data interface.
The system will go through (starting at element 0) to find the first provider that is available.
Value:
定义在使用AsyncGpuTrace数据接口时如何解译标记为“项目默认”的追踪。
系统将遍历（从元素0开始）以找到首个可用的提供者。

Key: Defines options for system life cycle for before the section is evaluating up to the first frame the section evaluates.
Value: 定义片段计算之前到片段计算第一帧时系统生命周期的选项。

Key: Defines options for system life cycle for when the section is evaluating from the 2nd frame until the last frame of the section.
Value: 定义片段从第二帧计算到片段最后一帧时系统生命周期的选项。

Key:
Defines the angle in degrees at which tessellation occurs.
Ranges from 1 to 180. Smaller values increase amount of tessellation.
If set to 0, use the maximum tessellation set above.

定义发生曲面细分时的角度（以度计）。
范围从1到180。较小值将增加曲面细分的数量。
如设为0，则使用以上的最大曲面细分集。

Value: 定义表面朝向摄像机时高光的颜色与亮度。F0低于0.02时，各高光贡献将逐渐衰减为黑色。（类型 = float3，单位 = 无量纲，默认值为塑料的0.04）

Value: 定义表面法线与视点方向90度的镜面高光的颜色。只保留色调和饱和度，亮度固定为1.0。当F0降到0.02以下时淡化为黑色。（类型 = float3、单位 = 无单位、默认为1.0f）

Key:
Defines the curve tension, or how long the curve's tangents are.
Ranges from 0 to 1. The higher the value, the sharper the curve becomes.
Value:
定义曲线张力，或曲线的切线长度。
范围从0到1。数值越高，曲线锐度越高。

Key: Defines the diffused albedo, the percentage of light reflected as diffuse from the surface. (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to 0.18)
Value: 定义漫反射反射率，从表面漫反射的光的百分比。（类型 = float3，单位 = 无单位，默认为0.18）

Key: Defines the originating space of the analytical collision plane variables before being transformed into the destination space of the emitter (world or localspace if the emitter "localspace" setting is checked).
Value: 定义解析碰撞平面变量在变换到发射器目标空间（世界或勾选局部空间时的局部空间）前的源空间。

Key: Defines the rate at which a spinning particle will come to rest after entering a rest state on the ground.
Value: 定义旋转粒子在地面上进入静止状态后停止转动的速率。

Key: Defines the start and end point for a ramp from one to zero. This is relative to the Age parameter value.
Value: 定义从一变为零的渐变起点和终点。相对于年龄参数的值。

Key: Defines the start and end point for a ramp from zero to one. This is relative to the Age parameter value.
Value: 定义从零变为一的渐变起点和终点。相对于年龄参数的值。

Key: Defines the surface's thickness when IsThinSurface is enabled on this node. Only available when Substrate is enabled for the project.
Value: 定义在此节点上启用IsThinSurface时表面的厚度。仅当为项目启用Substrate时才可用。

Key: Defines the tessellation mode allowing custom tessellation parameters or disabling tessellation entirely.
Value: 定义曲面细分模式，该模式允许自定义曲面细分参数或完全禁用曲面细分。

Key: Defines where to position the component (relative to its parent). If the component is left unattached, then the transform is relative to the world.
Value: 定义组件的位置（相对于其父项）。如果未附加组件，则将相对于世界场景进行变换。

Key: Defines whether the component should attach to the root automatically, or be left unattached for the user to manually attach later.
Value: 定义组件是否应自动附加到根，或不连接以便用户在之后手动连接。

Key: Defines which technique is used to resolve the trace - see 'AsyncGpuTraceDI/Provider Priority' in the Niagara project settings.
Value: 定义使用哪种技术来解算追踪——请参阅Niagara项目设置中的“AsyncGpuTraceDI/Provider Priority”。

Key: DELAY: Copy first round of loop duration and delay into LoopedAge, CurrentLoopDuration, and CurrentLoopDelay
Value: 延迟：将第一轮循环时长与延迟复制到 LoopedAge、CurrentLoopDuration 和 CurrentLoopDelay。

Key: DELAY: If the loop count really did go up, we need to factor in delays, decide on the new loop variables
Value: 延迟：如果循环次数确实增加，则需要考虑延迟，并确定新的循环变量。

Value: 将下一个生命周期的执行延迟此值。可使用随机数建立，每个循环会选择新的延迟。

Deletes all unreferenced objects, keeping only referenced objects (this command will be queued and happen at the end of the frame)
Note: This can be a slow operation, and should only be performed where a hitch would be acceptable
Value:
删除所有未引用的对象，只保留被引用的对象（此命令将排入队列并在帧末尾处发生）
注意：此操作运行速度慢，会引起卡顿，应谨慎使用

Key: Depending on the selected value, the random value returned will be a different one every frame or will be different only once per spawn evaluation.
Value: 根据所选值，返回的随机值可能每帧不同，也可能仅在每次生成求值时不同一次。

Key: Deprecate the Blueprint and all child Blueprints to make it no longer placeable in the World nor child classes created from it.
Value: 废弃该蓝图及其所有子蓝图，使其与自其创建的子类都无法被放置在世界场景中。

Key: Deprecate usage of this {FunctionOrCustomEvent}. Any nodes that reference it will produce a compiler warning indicating that it should be removed or replaced.
Value: 废除此{FunctionOrCustomEvent}的使用。引用它的所有节点都将生成一条编译器警告，说明其应被移除或替换。

描述Niagara发射器的完整结构（仅拓扑——无已解析的输入值）。

Key: Determine if the acceleration into the wall is purely due to constant forces. If so, remove restitution.
Value: 判断朝向墙面的加速度是否完全由恒力产生。如果是，则消除回弹。

Key: Determine if the acceleration into the wall/floor is purely due to constant forces. If so, remove restitution.
Value: 判断朝向墙面／地面的加速度是否完全由恒力产生。如果是，则消除回弹。

Key: Determine if this tri coordinate's triangle index is valid for this mesh. Note that this only checks the mesh index buffer size and does not include any filtering settings.
Value: 决定此三坐标的三角指数是否对此网格体有效。注意这只会检查网格体索引缓冲大小，不包含任何过滤设置。

Key: Determines how a sampled lifetime is applied. Overwrite stomps the current lifetime with the sampled value. Min takes whichever lifetime is smaller, Max takes whichever is larger.
Value: 确定采样生命周期的应用方式。覆盖用采样值替换当前生命周期；最小取较小值，最大取较大值。

Key: Determines how a sampled mass is applied. Overwrite stomps the current mass with the sampled value. Min takes whichever mass is smaller, Max takes whichever is larger.
Value: 确定采样质量的应用方式。覆盖会用采样值替换当前质量；最小取较小值；最大取较大值。

Key: Determines how a sampled velocity is applied. Overwrite stomps the current velocity with the sampled value. Add combines the sampled velocity with the existing particle velocity.
Value: 确定采样速度的应用方式。覆盖用采样值替换当前速度；添加则将采样速度与现有粒子速度合并。

Key:
Determines how important this emitter is for the runtime and rendering of the system.
An emitter with low priority does not block system execution or other emitters from rendering if its own materials are not yet done compiling.
A critical emitter can block both activation and rendering of the system until it's ready.
See also: readiness settings in the effect type.
Value:
确定此发射器对于系统的运行时和渲染的重要性。
如果其自身的材质尚未完成编译，则低优先级的发射器不会阻挡系统执行或阻挡其他发射器渲染。
关键发射器可以阻挡系统的激活和渲染，直到其准备就绪。
另请参阅：效果类型中的就绪设置。

Key:
Determines how new particles should be spawned.

ConditionalSpawn - Always spawn particles in a when a data channel entry fulfills the (optional) conditions.

DirectSpawn - The number of particles to spawn is read directly from an attribute in the data channel.
Value:
确定应如何生成新粒子。

ConditionalSpawn - 当数据通道条目满足（可选）条件时，始终生成粒子。

DirectSpawn - 直接从数据通道中的属性读取要生成的粒子数量。

Key:
Determines how the particle billboard orients itself relative to the camera.
Automatic mode will select FaceCamera or CustomFacingVector depending on if SpriteFacing binding is valid
Value:
确定粒子公告板如何相对于摄像机调整自身朝向。
自动模式将选择FaceCamera或CustomFacingVector，具体取决于SpriteFacing绑定是否有效

Key: Determines how this Emitter responds to incoming events. There can be more than one event handler stage per Emitter.
Value: 决定此发射器对即将发生事件进行响应的方式。每个发射器中可能存在多个事件处理器阶段。

Key:
Determines if any component is not a number (NAN)

@return true if one or more components is NAN, otherwise false.
Value:
确定是否任意组件并非一个数字（NAN）

@如果一个或多个组件为NAN，则返回true，否则返回false。

Key: Determines if supplied path uses a restricted/internal subdirectory.  Note that slashes are normalized and character case is ignored for the comparison.
Value: 确定提供的路径是否使用受限/内部子路径。注意：斜线将被标准化，忽略字符大小写以便进行对比。

Key: Determines if the geometry component will affect the engine's physics system with its collision shape.
Value: 确定几何体组件是否会用其碰撞形状影响引擎的物理系统。

Key: Determines if this pin's direction is compatible with another pin's direction. One needs to be an input, and the other an output.
Value: 确定此引脚的方向是否与另一个引脚的方向兼容。一个需要作为输入，另一个需要作为输出。

Key: Determines if transient objects (such as Sequencer Spawnables) should be shown in the list. False by default.
Value: 确定临时Object（如Sequencer可生成项）是否应该显示在列表中。默认为false。

Key:
Determines if vector is normalized / unit (length 1) within specified squared tolerance.

@return true if unit, false otherwise.
Value:
确定矢量是否已在指定的平方容差中标准化/确定单位（长度1）。

@如果单位已确定则返回true，否则返回false。

Key:
Determines if vector is normalized / unit (length 1).

@return true if normalized, false otherwise.
Value:
确定矢量是否已标准化/确定单位（长度1）。

@如果标准化则返回true，否则返回false。

Key: Determines if we want (or not) to generate constant material instances for each of the material instances found in the mutable instance
Value: 确定我们是否想要（或不）为可变实例中找到的每个材质实例生成常量材质实例

Key: Determines the best method to employ when generating motion vectors (accurate vs. approximate) based on project and renderer settings
Value: 在基于项目和渲染器设置生成运动向量时（精确与近似）采用的最佳方法

Key: Determines the cylinder height midpoint. 0 is the bottom of the cylinder, 0.5 is the middle, 1 is the top.
Value: 确定圆柱高度的中点位置。0 为圆柱底部，0.5 为中部，1 为顶部。

Key: Determines the extent the specular highlight is stretched along the tangent. Anisotropy from 0 to 1 results in a specular highlight that stretches from uniform to maximally stretched along the tangent direction.
Value: 决定高光度沿切线拉伸的范围。0到1之间的各向异性会形成高光，沿切线方向从统一到最大拉伸进行拉伸。

Key:
Determines the location of the pivot point of this particle. It follows Unreal's UV space, which has the upper left of the image at 0,0 and bottom right at 1,1. The middle is at 0.5, 0.5.
NOTE: This value is ignored if "Pivot Offset Binding" is bound to a valid attribute
Value:
决定此粒子的枢轴点位置。其会跟随虚幻的UV空间，其图像的左上角位于0,0，右下角位于1,1。中部位于0.5,0.5。
注意：如果将“枢轴点偏移绑定”绑定到一个有效属性，则将忽略此值

Key: Determines what happens when the warning is raised - warnings can be treated more strictly or suppressed entirely
Value: 决定警告出现时的操作——警告内容将被严格执行，或完全压制

Key: Determines whether or not we write the first dynamic material parameter. If unchecked, we use the existing value.
Value: 确定是否写入第一个动态材质参数。未勾选时使用现有值。

Key: Determines whether or not we write the fourth dynamic material parameter. If unchecked, we use the existing value.
Value: 确定是否写入第四个动态材质参数。未勾选时使用现有值。

Key: Determines whether or not we write the particles alpha particle color parameter. If unchecked, we use the existing value.
Value: 确定是否写入粒子颜色的透明度参数。未勾选时使用现有值。

Key: Determines whether or not we write the second dynamic material parameter. If unchecked, we use the existing value.
Value: 确定是否写入第二个动态材质参数。未勾选时使用现有值。

Key: Determines whether or not we write the third dynamic material parameter. If unchecked, we use the existing value.
Value: 确定是否写入第三个动态材质参数。未勾选时使用现有值。

Key:
Determines whether this widget blueprint can be initialized without
a valid player context (PlayerController, etc.).
Required to be true for use with UMG Widget Preview.
Value:
确定是否可以在没有有效播放器上下文（PlayerController等）的情况下
初始化此控件蓝图。
与UMG控件预览一起使用时需要为true。

Key: Determines whether to write the sampled position value to particle position. Can be used for dynamic "stick/unstick" behavior or to allow the module to sample attributes but not apply them.
Value: 确定是否将采样位置值写入粒子位置。可用于动态“粘附／脱离”，或仅采样属性而不应用。

Key:
Determines which method to use when deciding which attributes of the texture are important to the UV generation process.

By default, "bright" areas of the source texture are deemed important.
Value:
确定纹理属性中哪些内容对 UV 生成重要。

默认将源纹理的“明亮”区域视为重要区域。

Key: Directional Vector towards which the Mesh will orient. Respects Initial Mesh Orientation to change which axis of the mesh faces towards the Facing Direction.
Value: 网格体将朝向的方向向量。遵循初始网格体朝向，以改变网格体朝向朝向方向的轴。

Key: Directly set the position to the parametric torus radius attribute, which corresponds with the Surface Position of the torus.
Value: 通过参数化圆环体的半径属性直接设置位置，该属性对应圆环体的表面位置。

Key: Directly set the position to the parametric torus U attribute, which corresponds with the Large Radius of the torus, or the position on the circle in Ring mode.
Value: 通过参数化圆环体 U 属性直接设置位置，该属性对应圆环体的大半径，或环模式下圆周上的位置。

Key: Directly set the position to the parametric torus V attribute, which corresponds with the Handle Radius of the torus.
Value: 通过参数化圆环体的 V 属性直接设置位置，该属性对应圆环体的管截面半径。

Key:
Directly sets Particles.Color, with scale factors for the Float3 Color and Scalar Alpha components.
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Color/Color.Color
Value:
直接设置 Particles.Color，并分别为 Float3 颜色分量和标量 Alpha 分量提供缩放系数。
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Color/Color.Color

Key: Disable this to use the cloud shadow map instead of secondary raymarching. This is usually enough for clouds viewed from the ground and it result in a performance boost. Shadow now have infinite length but also becomes less accurate and gray scale.
Value: 禁用此选项可使用云阴影贴图，而非次要光线行进。对于从地面观看的云来说，这通常便已经足够，并且可以提高性能。阴影现在拥有无限的长度，且精确度和灰度将有所下降。

Key: Disabled due to scalability settings (Current Effects Quality: {0}). See Scalability options for valid range.
Value: 因可延展性设置（当前效果质量：{0}）而禁用。参见有效范围的可延展性选项。

Key:
Disables the ability to read / write from the same particle buffer, i.e. only update position and no other attributes.
By default this should not be changed, but can be used to debug issues.
Value:
禁用从同一粒子缓冲读取/写入的功能，即仅更新位置而不更新其他属性。
默认情况下不应该更改，但可以用于调试问题。

Key:
Disables two-sided forced rendering (Will still respect material settings)
MultiPlane will double geometry count to have triangles facing both sides. With this off MultiPlane will switch normal direction to face view.
3D Ribbons will render like normal meshes with backface culling enabled.
Value:
禁用双面强制渲染（仍将尊重材质设置）
MultiPlane将加倍几何体数量，使三角形面向两边。关闭后，MultiPlane将切换法线方向到面视图。
3D条带将像正常网格体那样渲染，启用背面剔除。

Key: Display by adding post process material via post process volume settings. Widget added only over area rendered by anamorphic squeeze.
Value: 通过后期处理体积设置添加后期处理材质来显示。仅在变形挤压渲染的区域上添加控件。

Key: Display value for EnumName. Often more descriptive and useful than the internal EnumName. For informational purposes only, the actual set value of the enum is EnumName.
Value: EnumName的显示值。通常比内部EnumName更具描述性且更有用。仅供参考，枚举的实际设置值为EnumName。

Key: Displays parameters that are context-sensitive to the active Scratch module document. Use this for renaming/editing local parameters to the module.
Value: 显示对激活Scratch模块文档上下文敏感的参数。使用它来重命名/编辑模块的本地参数。

Key:
Displays the built-in achievements GUI (iOS and Android only; this function may be renamed or moved in a future release)

@param SpecificPlayer Specific player's achievements to show. May not be supported on all platforms. If null, defaults to the player with ControllerId 0
Value:
显示内置成就GUI（仅限iOS和Andriod；此功能在未来版本中可能被重命名或被移动）

@param SpecificPlayer 指定显示的玩家成就。并非全平台支持。如为空，则默认为ControllerId 0的玩家

Key: Displays the built-in leaderboard GUI (iOS and Android only; this function may be renamed or moved in a future release)
Value: 显示内置排行榜GUI（仅限iOS和Andriod；此功能在未来版本中可能被重命名或被移动）

Key: Distance field surface normals are calculated by finding it's gradient at several locations. This value represents half of the distance between those sample locations.
Value: 通过在多个位置查找梯度计算距离场表面法线。此值表示这些采样位置之间距离的一半。

Key: Distance field surfaces will push particles away via a force. This is that force's maximum magnitude.
Value: 距离场表面会通过力将粒子推开。此值为该力的最大强度。

Key:
Distributes points in a grid based on a vector field. 

Optionally applies a local translate, rotate and scale transformation.

Note: Writes directly to Particles.Position and Particles.Scale
Value:
根据向量场在网格中分布点。

可选择应用局部平移、旋转与缩放变换。

注意：直接写入Particles.Position和Particles.Scale

Key:
Distribution of points along the cone axis. 

0 = Evently distribute points along the axis

1 = Points are only on the surface of the invisible sphere segment at the end of the cone
Value:
沿圆锥轴的点分布。

0 = 沿轴均匀分布点。

1 = 点仅位于圆锥末端不可见球体片段的表面。

Key: Dither opacity mask. When combined with Temporal AA this can be used as a form of limited translucency which supports all lighting features.
Value: 对不透明度遮罩进行抖动处理。与时间抗锯齿结合时，可实现支持全部光照功能的有限半透明效果。

Key: Divide increases the brightness of the base layer as the blend layer gets darker. Black and white both produce no change.
Value: 除法增加基础层的亮度，而混合层变暗。黑色和白色均不产生变化。

Key: Do not receive decals (Later we still can read the DBuffer channels to customize the effect, this frees up some interpolators).
Value: 不接收贴花（之后仍可将DBuffer通道读取到自定义效果，这能清理出一些插值器）。

Key: Do not search for existing existing materials. Deprecated replaced with boolean bReuseExistingMaterials
Value: 不搜索现有材质。已弃用，替换为布尔值bReuseExistingMaterials

Key: Do surface only band thickness by adding a random vector to each particle position once we place them perfectly on the surface
Value: 仅生成表面带状厚度：将每个粒子完美放置到表面后，向其位置添加随机向量。

Key: Do we optimize the LUT, this saves memory but may introduce errors.  Errors can be reduced modifying the threshold.
Value: 是否优化LUT，可节省内存，但可能发生错误。修改阈值可减少出错。

Key: Does a collision trace along the given line and returns all hits encountered up to and including the first blocking hit.
Value: 沿着给定线进行碰撞检测，并返回遇到的所有碰撞，包括第一个阻挡碰撞。

Key: Does this function need an exec pin for control flow because it has internal side effects that be seen by the script VM and could therefore be optimized out? If so, set to true. Default is false.
Value: 此函数是否需要执行引脚（因为它的内部副作用被脚本VM检测到并且可以被优化）？如果是，请设为true。默认为false。

Key:
Don't directly modify this property to change the palette category.  The actual value is stored
in the CDO of the UUserWidget, but a copy is stored here so that it's available in the serialized
Tag data in the asset header for access in the FAssetData.
Value:
请勿直接编辑此属性来修改控制板类别。实际值保存在
UUserWidget的CDO中，但此处将保存一个副本，在资产标头的
序列化标签数据中可用，便于在FAssetData中访问。

Key:
Draw lines, boxes or spheres on particles for debugging purposes.
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Utility/DebugDraw.DebugDraw
Value:
在粒子上绘制线条、方盒或球体，用于调试。
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Utility/DebugDraw.DebugDraw

Key: Draws a 2D Histogram of size 'DrawSize' based FDebugFloatHistory struct, using DrawLocation for the location in the world, rotation will face camera of first player.
Value: 绘制一个基于“DrawSize”大小的FDebugFloatHistory结构体的2D柱状图，将DrawLocation用作场景中的位置，旋转将朝向首个玩家的相机。

Key: Draws a 2D Histogram of size 'DrawSize' based FDebugFloatHistory struct, using DrawTransform for the position in the world.
Value: 绘制一个基于“DrawSize”大小的FDebugFloatHistory结构体的2D柱状图，将DrawTransform用作场景中的位置。

Key: Drives curve value (of usually morph target) using the transform of delta angle between base and twist frame to the direction of twist plane.
Value: 使用基础和扭曲帧之间的透明度角度变换向扭曲平面的方向驱动曲线值（此值通常属于变形目标）。

Key:
Drop the floating point portion of the incoming float by rounding towards 0.

1.3 becomes 1.
-1.3 becomes -1.
Value:
向 0 取整，舍去输入浮点数的小数部分。

1.3 变为 1。
-1.3 变为 -1。

Key: Due to a previous GPU codegen issue both particle spawn & update scripts were running on particle spawn when interpolated spawning is disabled.  This is now fixed for new content to match CPU behavior where only particle spawn will run when interpolated spawning is disabled.
Value: 由于之前的GPU代码生成问题，当插值生成被禁用时，粒子生成和更新脚本都在粒子生成时运行。现在修复了新内容与CPU行为匹配的问题，即当插值生成被禁用时，只会运行粒子生成。

Key: Due to large world coordinates, the simulation position can be shifted from the actual world position to allow for more accuracy. This is the tile the system is shifted by, so (SimulationPosition + Tile * TileSize) gives the original world position. The x,y,z components of this vector are the tile and the w component is the tile size.
Value: 由于世界坐标较大，模拟位置可以从实际世界位置移动，以获得更高的精度。这是系统移位的瓦片，所以（SimulationPosition + Tile * TileSize）给出了原始世界位置。此向量的x、y、z组件是瓦片，w组件是瓦片大小。

Key: Dummy class, used for easily getting a valid UFunction that helps prepare blueprint function graphs.
Value: 虚拟类，用于轻松获取有效UFunction，帮助准备蓝图函数图。

Key: Duplicate the given material and replace the target texture with the override texture on the newly-created material
Value: 复制给定材质，并将目标纹理替换为新创建的材质上的重载纹理。

Key: Duplication Error! {0} was touched when cloning for compilation. Please report this issue to the Niagara team!
Value: 复制错误！进行编译复制时触及{0}。请向Niagara团队报告此问题！

Key: Dynamic Inputs can not be dragged directly into the hierarchy. Please use the entire module input or individual inputs beneath.
Value: 动态输入不能被直接拖拽到层级中。请使用下方的整个模块输入或单个输入。

Key: Dynamically link a shared neighbor grid parameter. These are often generated at the emitter level as a new Neighbor grid variable.
Value: 动态链接共享的邻居网格参数。这些参数通常在发射器级别生成，作为新的 Neighbor 网格变量。

Key: Each particle's collision is calculated as if it were a sphere. This number sets that sphere's radius.
Value: 每个粒子都按球体计算碰撞，此值指定球体的半径。

Key:
Each particle's collision radius will be calculated for you, per frame, using the methods laid out below. 

Sprite - This option will leverage "Particles.SpriteSize" to calculate the particle's collision radius using the method chosen by the user in the subsequent drop down. 

Mesh - This option uses a user defined mesh dimensions vector and the "Particles.Scale" variable to calculate the particles collision radius. 

Custom - Custom allows the user to directly enter your own radius value.
Value:
每帧都会按下面选定的方法计算每个粒子的碰撞半径。

精灵：利用 Particles.SpriteSize，并按后续下拉框中指定的方法计算碰撞半径。

网格体：利用用户指定的网格体尺寸向量和 Particles.Scale 计算碰撞半径。

自定义：直接输入所需的半径值。

Key: Each Pin name will be written to the compiler output with an entry about the input value. The linked pin should ultimately route to a constant value or rapid iteration value. Anything else will result in a compile error.
Value: 每个引脚名称将与有关输入值的条目一起写入编译器输出。链接的引脚最终应路由到一个常量值或快速迭代值。其他任何情况都将导致编译出错。

Key: Editor Node Graph representation. Not strongly typed to avoid circular dependency between editor/runtime modules.
Value: 编辑器节点图表示。并非强类型，以避免编辑器/运行时模块之间出现循环依赖。

Key:
Editor subsystem that owns the flyweight UMaterialShaderValueTypeObject instances.
Lifetime tied to GEditor — flyweights are GC-traced via UPROPERTY and collected
naturally when the subsystem is destroyed during GEditor teardown.
Value:
拥有轻量级UMaterialShaderValueTypeObject实例的编辑器子系统。
生命周期与GEditor绑定——享元对象通过UPROPERTY进行GC追踪，并在GEditor销毁期间子系统被拆除时自然被回收。

Key:
EditorOnly version of the OverrideMaterial reference.
This is a hard reference, but is editoronly. We rely on -skiponlyeditoronly to avoid pulling this editoronly hard reference into the cook.
Value:
OverrideMaterial引用的编辑器专用版本。
这是一个硬引用，但为编辑器专用。我们依靠-skiponlyeditoronly来避免将此编辑器专用硬引用拉入烘焙。

Key:
Effects of this type will be culled when total active instances of the same NiagaraSystem exceeds this number.
If the effect type has a significance handler, instances are sorted by their significance and only the N most significant will be kept. The rest are culled.
If it does not have a significance handler, instance count culling will be applied at spawn time only. New FX that would exceed the counts are not spawned/activated.
Value:
当相同NiagaraSystem的激活实例总数超过此数量时，将剔除此类效果。
如果效果类型拥有重要性处理器，则实例将按其重要性排序，并且仅保留N个最重要的实例。其余的将被剔除。
如果没有重要处理器，则实例计数剔除将仅在生成时应用。不会生成/激活超过数量的新特效。

Key:
Effects of this type will be culled when total active instances using this same EffectType exceeds this number.
If the effect type has a significance handler, instances are sorted by their significance and only the N most significant will be kept. The rest are culled.
If it does not have a significance handler, instance count culling will be applied at spawn time only. New FX that would exceed the counts are not spawned/activated.
Value:
当使用相同EffectType的激活实例总数超过此数量时，将剔除此类效果。
如果效果类型拥有重要性处理器，则实例将按其重要性排序，并且仅保留N个最重要的实例。其余的将被剔除。

This struct intentionally exposes one opaque field rather than a list of typed properties,

Flag indicating that a read only duplicate of this blueprint is being created, used to disable logic in ::PostDuplicate,

This flag needs to be copied on duplication (because it's the duplicated object that we're disabling on PostDuplicate),
but we don't *need* to serialize it for permanent objects.

Without setting this flag a blueprint will be marked dirty when it is duplicated and if saved while in this dirty
state you will not be able to open the blueprint. More specifically, UClass::Rename (called by DestroyGeneratedClass)
sets a dirty flag on the package. Once saved the package will fail to open because some unnamed objects are present in
the pacakge.

This flag can be used to avoid the package being marked as dirty in the first place. Ideally PostDuplicateObject
would not rename classes that are still in use by the original object.

但*不需要*将其序列化为永久对象。

如果不设置此标记，蓝图被复制后将被标记为已修改；而如果在已修改状态下进行保存，

If "Override Seed" is checked, which allows a manual seed input, the user can optionally check "Fixed Override Seed" which will remove all additional seeding of the random number w/ Unique Particle ID or Engine.System.TickCount, allowing for a 100% stable random number based on the integer into the "Seed" input.

为浮点类型生成区间内均匀分布的随机数。

Value:
获取支持全屏分辨率的列表。
@return：如成功查询到可用分辨率的设备，则返回true。

Key:
Gets the list of windowed resolutions which are convenient for the current primary display size.
@return true if successfully queried the device for available resolutions.
Value:
获取适用于当前主显示尺寸的窗口化分辨率的列表。
@return：如成功查询到可用分辨率的设备，则返回true。

Key: Gets the members from the internal Struct of an FNDCAccessContextIns. Expanded on compile into individual per property calls to GetSinglePropertyInNDCAccessContextInstance.
Value: 从FNDCAccessContextIns的内部结构体中获取成员。编译后扩展为每个属性单独调用GetSinglePropertyInNDCAccessContextInstance。

Key:
Gets the memory size of the texture source top mip, in bytes, and the size on disk of the asset, which may be compressed.
Uses texture source, not available in runtime games.
Does not cause texture source to be loaded, queries cached values.
Returns zero for error.
Value:
获取纹理源顶层mip的内存大小（以字节为单位），以及资产在硬盘上的大小，这可能会被压缩。
使用纹理源，在运行时游戏中不可用。
不会导致纹理源被加载，查询缓存的值。
错误则返回0。

Key:
Gets the memory size of the texture, in bytes.
This is the size in GPU memory of the built platformdata, accounting for LODBias, etc.
Returns zero for error.
Value:
获取纹理的内存大小（以字节为单位）。这是编译平台数据在GPU内存中的大小，包括LODBias等。
错误则返回0。

Key: Gets the number of edges connected to this pin. May include invalid edges (which can happen if connected to an invalid node).
Value: 获取连接到此引脚的边数。可能包含无效边（如果连接到无效节点，则可能发生这种情况）。

Key: Gets the OpenXR runtime's supported environment blend modes, sorted in order from highest to lowest runtime preference.
Value: 获取OpenXR运行时支持的环境混合模式，按运行时偏好从高到低排序。

Key: Gets the overscanned resolution, which is the target output resolution scaled by any configured overscan amount
Value: 获取过扫描分辨率，即按任何配置的过扫描量缩放的目标输出分辨率。

Key: Gets the resolution that will be used by the engine when rendering a frame. Includes overscan and tiling
Value: 获取引擎渲染帧时将使用的分辨率。包含过扫描和平铺

Key:
Gets the runtime world bounds, which only includes actor descriptors that aren't editor only.
@return The runtime world bounds.
Value:
获取运行时世界边界，它只包含非纯编辑器的Actor描述符。
@return 返回运行时世界边界。

Key:
Gets the smallest Y resolution we want to support in the 3D view, clamped within reasons
@return value in pixels
Value:
获取需要在3D视图中支持的最小Y轴分辨率，根据理由进行限制
@return值（像素）

Key:
Gets the smallest Y resolution we want to support in the UI, clamped within reasons
@return value in pixels
Value:
获取需要在UI中支持的最小Y轴分辨率，根据理由进行限制
@return值（像素）

Key: Gets the Spawn Group from the current Spawn Info and sets it to the Index of a Niagara ID, for use as a Ribbon ID so each spawn group gets its own ribbon ID.
Value: 从当前生成信息获取生成组，将其设为Niagara ID的索引，并用作条带ID，使每个生成组具有独立的条带ID。

Key: Gets the transform for the socket at the passed index in the DI's filtered socket list. If the Source component is set it will respect the Relative Transform Space as well..
Value: 在DI的已过滤插槽列表中，获取已传递索引处的插槽变形。若已设置源组件，其同样将匹配相对变形空间。

Key: Gets the Uid of the material that should be assigned to the spawned HeterogeneousVolumeActor at its single material slot
Value: 获取应分配给生成的HeterogeneousVolumeActor在其单个材质槽位的材质的UID。

Key:
Gets whether or not the delta time used to tick the system instance when using desired age is locked to the seek delta.  When true, the system instance
      will only be ticked when the desired age has changed by more than the seek delta.  When false the system instance will be ticked by the change in desired
      age when not seeking.
Value:
获取在使用所需时长时，用于tick系统实例的增量时间是否锁定为查找增量（seek delta）。如为true，则只有在所需时长的变化幅度大于查找增量时，
      系统实例才会被tick。如为false，则系统实例将在未查找时通过
      所需时长的变更来tick。

Key:
Gets whether the parent body is not affected by it's child motion
     @param Accessor Constraint accessor to query
Value:
获取父体是否不受其子动作的影响
     @param Accessor 要查询的约束存取器

Key:
Given a valid barycentric coordinate on the edge of a triangle, the first triangle's edge index and the neighbor's triangle edge index we can translate the barycentric coordinates from one triangle to another's.

To find the neighbor's edge index use the "Get Triangle Neighor" function on a skeletal mesh di. 

To find the current Triangle's Edge Index use the "FindNearestBarycentricCoordinateEdge" function.
Value:
给定三角形边上的有效重心坐标、当前三角形边索引和相邻三角形边索引，可将重心坐标从一个三角形转换到另一个三角形。

要查找相邻三角形边索引，请使用骨骼网格体数据接口的“Get Triangle Neighor”函数。

要查找当前三角形边索引，请使用“FindNearestBarycentricCoordinateEdge”函数。

Key:
Given a valid barycentric coordinate, this function will return the closest edge. If all 3 edges are equally close the edge index will be invalid. The first edge will be returned in that case and the Equidistant bool will return true. 

Note that distances in this case are calculated in barycentric coordinate space.
Value:
给定有效重心坐标，此函数返回最近的边。如果3条边距离相等，边索引将无效；此时返回第一条边，且Equidistant布尔值为true。

注意：此处的距离在重心坐标空间中计算。

Key: Given a world space position and an element index, computes the static mesh's closest distance and velocity.
Value: 给定世界空间位置和元素索引，计算静态网格体的最近距离和速度。

Key: Given a world space position and an element index, computes the static mesh's closest point. Also returns normal and velocity for that point.
Value: 根据世界空间位置和元素索引，计算静态网格体上最近的点。同时返回该点的法线和速度。

Key: Given a world space position and element index, computes the distance to the closest point for the static mesh.
Value: 给定一个世界空间位置和元素索引，计算到静态网格体最近点的距离。

Key: Given a world space position, computes the accurate closest distance and velocity for static meshes.  The closest position is approximate and computed by proximity to the physics assets and not the mesh itself.
Value: 给定世界空间位置，计算静态网格体的准确最近距离和速度。最近的位置为近似，根据与物理资产的接近程度而并非网格体本身来计算。

Key: Given a world space position, computes the distance to the closest point for the static mesh, using the mesh's distance field.
Value: 给定一个世界空间位置，使用网格体的距离场来计算静态网格体到最近点的距离。

Key: Given a world space position, computes the static mesh's closest point. Also returns normal and velocity for that point.
Value: 给定世界空间位置，计算静态网格体上最近的点，同时返回该点的法线与速度。

Key: Given an editor utility widget blueprint, get the TabID for it. This will return None if the widget is not currently in a tab.
Value: 给定一个编辑器工具控件蓝图，获取其TabID。如果控件当前不在选项卡中，则返回None。

Key: Given an editor utility widget blueprint, get the widget it creates. This will return a null pointer if the widget is not currently in a tab.
Value: 给定编辑器工具控件蓝图，获取其创建的控件。如控件当前未在选项卡，此将返回空指针。

Key: Given same frame collisions one should be able to find the remaining tick delta after the collision and feed it into physics.delta time. Currently, we're just using delta time.
Value: 对于同帧碰撞，应能计算碰撞后的剩余更新步长并传入 physics.delta time；目前仅使用 delta time。

Key: Given some real-world geometry being tracked by the Augmented Reality system, draw it on the screen for debugging purposes (rudimentary)
Value: 给定一些正在被增强现实系统所追踪的真实场景几何体，将其在屏幕上绘制来用于调试（基本）

Key:
GPU collision trace results are a frame delayed. This optimization requires a number of approaches to be utilized to compensate for the delay. 

This number multiplies the particle's current velocity and force vectors to extend the particle's supposed trajectory in order to compensate for the collision result's frame delay.
Value:
GPU 碰撞检测结果会延迟一帧，因此需要采用补偿措施。

此值用于放大粒子当前的速度向量和力向量，以延长预测运动轨迹，补偿碰撞结果的一帧延迟。

Key:
GPU scripts were incorrectly running both particle spawn & update, CPU only runs spawn when interpolated spawning is disabled.
This flag allows backwards compatability so content does not change post the fix.
Value:
GPU脚本错误地运行粒子生成和更新，CPU只在插值生成被禁用时运行生成。
这个标记允许向后兼容，所以内容在修复后不会改变。

Key:
Gpu simulations run at different points in the frame depending on what features are used, i.e. depth buffer, distance fields, etc.
Opaque materials will run latent when these features are used.
Translucent materials can choose if they want to use this frames or the previous frames data to match opaque draws.
Value:
Gpu模拟在帧的不同点上运行，取决于什么功能被使用，例如深度缓冲、距离场等。
这些功能被使用时，不透明材质将运行延迟。
半透明材质可以选择是否要使用此帧或之前的帧数据来匹配不透明绘制。

Key: Gpu simulations will read the previous frames data if the simulation has to run in PostRenderOpaque.
Value: 如果模拟必须在PostRenderOpaque中运行，Gpu模拟将读取之前的帧数据。

Key:
Guid that uniquely identifies this material.
Any changes to the state of the material that do not appear separately in the shadermap DDC keys must cause this guid to be regenerated!
For example, a modification to the Expressions array.
Code changes that cause the guid to be regenerated on load should be avoided, as that requires a resave of the content to stop recompiling every load.
Value:
独立识别此材质的GUID。
如果对材质状态的修改未单独出现在着色器图DDC键中，则此GUID必须被重新生成！
举例而言，对表达式数组进行的修改。
应避免出现会导致GUID在加载时重新生成的代码修改，因为这需要重新保存内容，以停止在每次加载时重新编译。

Key:
HACK!  Data sets used to use the emitter name, but this isn't guaranteed to be unique.  This is a temporary hack
to allow the data sets to continue work with using names, but that code needs to be refactored to use the id defined here.
Value:
破解！使用发射器命名所用的数据集，但不保证唯一性。此为临时破解
以允许数据集使用命名继续工作，但需重构代码以使用此处定义的ID。

Key: Hair fiber base color resulting from single and multiple scattering combined. (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to black)
Value: 毛发纤维单次散射与多次散射组合得到的基础颜色。（类型 = float3，单位 = 无量纲，默认值为黑色）

Key: Hair Strands Asset used to sample from when not overridden by a source actor from the scene. Also useful for previewing in the editor.
Value: 发束资产用于在未被来自场景的源Actor重载时取样。也适用于在编辑器中预览。

Key: Handle re-targeting of IK Bone chain. Moves IK bone chain to meet FK hand bones, based on HandFKWeight (to favor either side). (0 = favor left hand, 1 = favor right hand, 0.5 = equal weight).
Value: 处理IK骨骼链的重定向。基于HandFKWeight（偏向任意一侧）移动IK骨骼链匹配FK手部骨骼（0 = 偏向左手、1 = 偏向右手、0.5 = 均衡权重）。

Key: Hard Mix adds the individual color channels together and rounds them, producing one of eight colors: black, red, green, blue, cyan, magenta, yellow, or white.
Value: 硬混合将各个颜色通道加在一起并取整，产生八种颜色之一：黑色、红色、绿色、蓝色、青色、洋红色、黄色或白色。

Key: has to be based off of position, should use total rotation, needs to carry on the previous offset...
Value: 必须基于位置，应使用总旋转量，并延续上一次的偏移……

Key: Haziness represent the amount of irregularity of the surface. A high value will lead to a second rough specular lobe causing the surface too look `milky`.
Value: 雾浊度表示表面的不规则程度。较高的值会产生第二个粗糙高光波瓣，使表面呈现乳浊外观。

Key: Helper class to allow the BP to call the custom setters and getters on FPCGAttributePropertySelector.
Value: 辅助类，允许BP调用FPCGAttributePropertySelector上的自定义setter和getter。

Key:
Helper property to handle upgrades from an old system of displaying pins for
     the override values that properties referenced as a conditional of being set in a struct
Value:
辅助属性，用于从旧的引脚显示系统升级。
旧系统为覆盖值显示引脚，并由属性引用这些值，作为结构体中字段是否已设置的条件。

Key: Hidden functions can not be placed but may be bound and used.  This is useful to hide functionality while developing.
Value: 隐藏函数不能放置，但可以绑定和使用。这适用于在开发时隐藏功能。

Key: Hide the node's Exec pins. The node will be Pure and will execute once for each node connected to an output pin.
Value: 隐藏节点的Exec引脚。此节点将是纯节点，并且将为连接到输出引脚的每个节点执行一次。

Key: Hides all modules except those that have unresolved issues. This action is only enabled when system and emitter nodes are selected in the graph, as it could potentially hide any selected modules.
Value: 隐藏所有模块，拥有未解决问题的除外。此操作仅在图中选择系统和发射器节点时启用，因为它可能会隐藏任何选定模块。

Key:
Hides the ad banner (iAd on iOS, or AdMob on Android). Will force close the ad if it's open
(iOS and Android only)
Value:
隐藏广告条幅（iOS上的iAd，或Android上的AdMob）。如广告开启，会强制将其关闭
（仅限iOS和Android）

Key: High quatliy distance field iso surfaces are calculated from 6 global distance field samples. Low quality vectors point  are based offf a single position's gradient sample.
Value: 高质量距离场等值面由 6 个全局距离场采样计算；低质量向量基于单个位置的梯度采样。

Key: Higher number is higher priority. If two water bodies overlap and they don't have a transition material specified, this will be used to determine which water body to use the material from. Valid range is -8192 to 8191
Value: 数字越大优先级越高。如果两个水体重叠并且没有指定过渡材质，这将用于确定使用哪个水体的材质。有效范围为-8192至8191

Key: Hint: Assign a material to see the landscape layers it handles. Use Auto-Fill button to populate layer assets.
Value: 提示：指定材质以查看其处理的地形层。使用自动填充按钮填充层资产。

Key: Holds position type source data to be later converted to LWC format. We use an array here instead of a map to save some memory and because linear search is faster with the few elements in here.
Value: 保存稍后转换为LWC格式的位置类型源数据。我们在此处使用数组来节约内存，而非映射，因为线性搜索在这里元素较少时线性搜索速度更快。

Key: Hours value {HoursValue} is greater than maximum hours TimeSpan can represent. Clamping to MaxValue.
Value: 小时值 {HoursValue} 大于TimeSpan所能代表的最大小时。将限定到MaxValue。

Key:
How do we want to capture attributes for the simulation cache.
The mode selected depends on what situations the cache can be used in.
Value:
我们希望如何捕获模拟缓存的属性。
选择的模式取决于缓存可以在什么情况下使用。

Key:
How effects of this type react when they fail the cull checks.
Applied to all effects using this effect type and can not be overridden per effect.
Value: 此类型的效果在剔除检查失败时的反应。应用于使用此效果类型的所有效果，并且不能按效果重载。

Key: How many frames to delay capture. If gathering performance data, this is how many frames will be collected.
Value: 延迟捕获的帧数。如果收集性能数据，这是将要收集的帧数。

Key: How many octave to use for the multiple-scattering approximation. This makes the shader more expensive so you should only use 0 or 1 for better performance, and tweak multiple scattering parameters accordingly. 0 means single scattering only. The maximum value is 2 (expenssive).
Value: 用于多散射近似的倍频数。这使得着色器开销更高，所以应该只使用0或1以获取更佳的性能，并相应地调整多个散射参数。0意味着仅单次散射。最大值为2（高开销）。

Key: How many pre-allocated islands to keep in the pool. Higher values will incur a larger standing memory cost but will reduce activation times for new islands.
Value: 池中保留多少预先分配的岛状区。较高的值会产生较大的内存开销，但会减少新岛状区的激活时间。

Key: How many seconds of warmup time to consider for positional offset when applying force to position. Can be thought of as a scale factor against the physics force value.
Value: 施力到位置时考虑的预热时间秒数。可将其视为物理力值的缩放因子。

Key: How many times each tick should the pressure solve be calculated. This is an accuracy vs speed tradeoff. If you feel the collisions are not accurate enough, try increasing this value.
Value: 每个更新步长计算压力求解的次数。这是在准确度与速度之间的权衡；碰撞不准确时可提高此值。

Key: How many times to loop around the cylinder which wraps itself around the main circle of the torus. (q)
Value: 绕缠绕于圆环主圆周围的圆柱旋转的圈数。(q)

Key:
How many units in each tile (if Tiling is on)
For Perlin noise functions, Tile Size must be a multiple of three
Value:
每个瓦片中的单元数（如平铺开启）
对Perlin噪点函数而言，瓦片大小必须为3的倍数

Key: How much light contributs when lighting hairs from the back side opposite from the view, only available for HairStrand rendering (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to 0.0)
Value: 从与视图相反的背面照亮毛发时光线的贡献度，仅可用于HairStrand渲染（类型 = float3、单位 = 无单位、默认值为0.0）

Key: How much should the collision be lofted from the spline (positive values go out from the spline, negative values go in to the spline)
Value: 碰撞自样条击飞的程度（正数即自样条飞出；负数即飞入样条）

Key: How often the flowing noise pattern. will reseed. Large values can cause artifacts like streak patterns.
Value: 流动噪声图案重新设定种子的频率。较大的值可能产生条纹等瑕疵。

Key:
How quickly time accumulates. 1 means one loop of the animation every second.

Can be scaled by the Play Rate Scale Curve.

Because time accumulates to a variable, negative scale can actually rewind playback.
Value:
时间累积速度。1 表示每秒播放一轮动画。

可由播放速率缩放曲线缩放。

由于时间累积到变量中，负缩放可倒放。

Key:
How should velocity by applied to the simulation.
If the comp mode equals ADD the simulation delta time will automatically be factored into the value.
Value:
应如何将速度应用到模拟。
如果合成模式为 ADD，模拟时间步长会自动计入该值。

Key: How should we allocate the buffer into which we write data. Currently only supports static allocation but in future will support more flexible allocation modes.
Value: 我们应该如何将缓冲分配到写入数据。目前仅支持静态分配，未来将支持更灵活的分配模式。

Key:
How should we calculate bounds for the emitter.
Note: If this is greyed out it means fixed bounds are enabled in the System Properties and these bounds are therefore ignored.
Value: 我们应该如何计算发射器的边界。注意：如果这是灰色，意味着在系统属性中启用了固定边界，因此这些边界将被忽略。

Key: How the decal will be aligned on the surface. There are also fallback modes for cases where alignment direction is parallel to the surface normal, this is found under advanced properties.
Value: 贴花在表面上的对齐方式。高级属性中还提供了朝向方向平行于表面法线时的回退模式。

Key:
How the time of the Sim Cache is defined.
You have the option to read the cache at a specific frame or an age value in seconds.
The age option can be useful when using an animating Sim Cache.
Value:
定义模拟缓存的时间。
可按指定帧或秒数年龄读取缓存。
使用动画模拟缓存时，年龄选项很有用。

Key: How to handle how Niagara rendered effects should generate motion vectors by default (can still be overridden on a case-by-case basis)
Value: 处理Niagara渲染效果如何默认生成运动向量（仍然可以根据具体情况重载）

Key: How to interpret the virtual texture contents. Note that the bound Virtual Texture should have the same setting for sampling to work correctly.
Value: 解译虚拟纹理内容的方法。注意：边界虚拟纹理应使用相同设置，以正确采样。

Key: How urgent it is that System's using this Effect Type are ready in time for activation and rendering. Settings controlling readiness and possible delays in rendering can be found in ReadinessSettings.
Value: 使用此效果类型的系统为激活和渲染及时准备就绪的紧迫程度。控制渲染准备就绪和可能延迟的设置可以在ReadinessSettings中找到。

Key:
Human-readable breadcrumb path from the stack root to the entry that owns this issue,
joined with '/'. Example: "FireEmitter/ParticleUpdate/AddVelocity".
Value:
从堆栈根到拥有此问题的条目的人类可读面包屑路径，
与'/'连接。示例："FireEmitter/ParticleUpdate/AddVelocity"。

Key:
Human-readable description of the fix that ran, copied from FNiagaraExt_StackIssueFix::Description.
Empty when bApplied is false.
Value:
运行的修复的易读描述，从FNiagaraExt_StackIssueFix::Description复制。
当bApplied为false时为空。

Key: ID of the currently executing Emitter. This can be used to access or otherwise target a specific emitter in certain Data Interface functions. This is only valid for Emitter and Particle scripts.
Value: 当前正在执行的发射器的ID。这可用于访问或以其他方式定位特定数据接口函数中的特定发射器。这仅对发射器和粒子脚本有效。

Key: Id of the Emitter Handle that generated the event. If all zeroes, the event generator is assumed to be this emitter.
Value: 生成此事件的发射器句柄ID。如果全部为零，则假定事件由当前发射器生成。

Key: If "Output Target Value on First Frame" is set to true, the function will rely on a bool called Transient.FirstFrame which is generated within the particle state module.
Value: “首帧输出目标值”为真时，函数依赖粒子状态模块生成的 Transient.FirstFrame 布尔值。

Key:
if a collision has occured then physics.force is 0. Velocity is then updated.

If a collision hasn't occured then neither velocity or force change. 


Either way the system attempts to find a collision plane along the path of the particle's motion
Value: 发生碰撞时 physics.force 为 0，随后更新速度；未碰撞时速度和力不变；系统始终尝试沿粒子运动路径查找碰撞平面。

Key: If a collision is rejected, how many times do we attempt to retrace from that collision point forward to find a new, valid collision.
Value: 如果一个碰撞被拒绝，我们会从碰撞点向前发出多少次射线，以便找到一个新的有效碰撞。

Key: If a particle is smaller than the value specified here it's DataInstance.alive variable will be set to false.
Value: 如果粒子小于此处指定的值，其 DataInstance.alive 变量将设为 false。

Key: If a particle's acceleration is in opposition to it's current velocity a course redirection force can be applied to curve the particle's trajectory.
Value: 如果粒子加速度与当前速度方向相反，可施加粗略转向力使粒子轨迹弯曲。

Key: If a render visibility tag is present, particles whose tag matches this value will be visible in this renderer.
Value: 存在渲染可见性标签时，标签与此值匹配的粒子将在该渲染器中可见。

Key: If a script version we reference goes away we select a fallback version, but save the original version to generate warnings.
Value: 如果我们引用的脚本版本消失了，我们会选择一个备用版本，但会保存原始版本以生成警告。

Key:
If a system is ticking multiple times in a single frame (for example due to fixed tick delta time or because the user is scrubbing the desired time in the timeline),
it is usually not desirable to also spawn new particles every tick for the data channel entries, as the data channel itself doesn't change.

When enabled, the emitter will only spawn particles on the last subtick of the frame.
Value:
如果系统在单个帧中多次tick（例如由于固定的tick时间差，或由于用户在时间轴中拖动所需时间），
通常不需要在每个tick都为数据通道条目生成新的粒子，因为数据通道本身不会改变。

启用后，发射器将仅在帧的最后一个子tick生成粒子。

Key:
If a system is ticking multiple times in a single frame (for example due to fixed tick delta time or because the user is scrubbing the desired time in the timeline),
it is usually not desirable to also write data channel entries for each subtick, as consumers reading on the next frame will potentially see a huge number of entries.

When enabled, the emitter will only execute write functions on the last subtick of the frame.
Value:
如果系统在单个帧中多次tick（举例而言，由于固定的tick差量时间，或由于用户在时间轴中拖动所需时间），
通常不需要为每个子tick写入数据通道条目，因为读取下一个帧的消费者可能会看到大量的条目。

启用后，发射器将仅在帧的最后一个子tick上执行写入函数。

Key:
If a user only enables 1 axis and it's at a right angle to the surface normal invalid math will be performed. 
We track this and work around it later with an arbitrary offset.
Value:
如果用户仅启用一个轴且该轴与表面法线成直角，会执行无效数学运算。
我们会记录此情况，之后通过任意偏移进行规避。

Key:
If above zero, the set will only happen if the index is within the range of the grid cells available.
If the index is left at zero it is assumed that the cell indices are valid and no check will be made.
Value: 大于零时，仅当索引位于可用网格单元范围内才执行设置；索引为零时，假定单元索引有效，不进行检查。

Key:
If activated, the system ticks with a fixed delta time instead of the varying game thread delta time. This leads to much more stable simulations.
When the fixed tick delta is smaller than the game thread tick time the simulation is substepping by executing multiple ticks per frame.
Note that activating this feature forces the system to tick on the game thread instead of an async task in parallel.

The max number of substeps per frame can be set via fx.Niagara.SystemSimulation.MaxTickSubsteps
Value:
如果激活，系统将以固定差量时间tick，而非变化的游戏线程差量时间。这导致了更稳定的模拟。
当固定的tick增量小于游戏线程的tick时间时，模拟将通过每帧执行多个tick进行分步。
注意，激活此功能会强制系统在游戏线程上tick，而并非在并行异步任务中tick。

每帧异步的最大数量可以通过fx.Niagara.SystemSimulation.MaxTickSubsteps来设置

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the given sound cue parameter will be set on it.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则将在其上方设置给定的sound cue参数。

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the this will adjusts its pitch multiplier.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则此项将调整其音高乘数。

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the this will adjusts its rotation in the world.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则此项将调整其在世界中的旋转。

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the this will adjusts its volume multiplier.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则此项将调整其音量乘数。

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the this will adjusts its world position.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则此项将调整其在世界中的位置。

Key: If an active audio effect can be found for the given handle then the this will either pause or unpause the effect.
Value: 若在给定句柄上能找到激活的音频效果，则此项将暂停/取消暂停效果。

Key:
If an effect class in this array is currently playing, do not play this effect.
Useful for preventing multiple similar or expensive camera effects from playing simultaneously.
Value:
如果此数组中的一个效果类当前正在播放，则不播放此效果。
用于防止多个相似或高开销的摄像机效果同时播放。

Key: If an emitter is inheritable, new emitters based on an inheritable emitter, or Niagara Systems using an inheritable emitter, will automatically inherit changes made to the original emitter.
Value: 如果发射器可继承，则基于可继承发射器的新发射器或使用可继承发射器的Niagara系统将自动继承对原始发射器所进行的变更。

Key:
If any of the Tick functions is implemented, how often should they be ticked.
    Values < 0 mean 'every tick'.
Value:
如果实现了任何一个Tick函数，其被tick的频率。
    如值小于0，则代表“每次tick”。

Key:
If Applying the sampled color, acts as a mask on which color channels to apply to the Particle Color.

By default, it applies RGB and skips A.
Value:
应用采样颜色时，作为应用到粒子颜色的通道掩码。

默认应用 RGB，跳过 A。

Key:
If BlendMode is BLEND_Masked, the surface is not rendered where OpacityMask < OpacityMaskClipValue.
If BlendMode is BLEND_Translucent, BLEND_Additive, or BLEND_Modulate, and "Output Depth and Velocity" is enabled,
the object velocity is not rendered where Opacity < OpacityMaskClipValue.
Value:
如BlendMode为BLEND_Masked，OpacityMask < OpacityMaskClipValue时表面不会被渲染。如果BlendMode为BLEND_Translucent、BLEND_Additive或BLEND_Modulate，并且启用了“输出深度和速度”选项，
则不透明度小于OpacityMaskClipValue时将不会渲染Object的速度。

Key:
If bound to a valid user parameter object of type UNiagaraDataInterfaceAudioPlayerSettings, then configured settings like sound attenuation are set via the user parameter. This allows the sound settings to be dynamically changed via blueprint or C++.
Only used by persistent audio, one-shot audio ignores this option.
Value: 如果绑定到UNiagaraDataInterfaceAudioPlayerSettings类型的有效用户参数Object，那么配置的设置（如声音衰减）将通过用户参数设置。这允许声音设置通过蓝图或C++动态变更。只用于持久音频，一次性音频将忽略此选项。

Key: If checked, a linear force will be added to the particle's force parameter. This will be masked by a spherical falloff.
Value: 勾选后，向粒子的力参数添加线性力，并通过球形衰减进行掩码处理。

Key: If checked, directly set the receiving particle's position and velocity to the parent position  and velocity.
Value: 勾选后，将接收粒子的位置和速度直接设为父粒子的位置和速度。

Key: If checked, materials will be updated on export to ensure that odd-numbered material IDs correspond to internal faces, and this will be used on re-import to assign correct material IDs
Value: 如果勾选，将在导出时更新材质，以确保奇数编号的材质ID对应内部面，并在重新导入时使用它们来分配正确的材质ID。

Key: If checked, use the above constant factor. Otherwise, adaptively select the tessellation factor based on the below parameters.
Value: 如勾选，使用以上常量因子。否则基于以下参数适应性选择曲面细分因子。

Key:
If checked, will override the default behavior of using the global foliage material list and instead use the Override Foliage Terrain Materials defined here.
If the override is used, you must manually provide ALL materials this procedural foliage spawner should spawn on top of.
Value:
如果勾选，将重载使用全局植被材质列表的默认行为，而是使用此处定义的重载植被地貌材质。
如果使用重载，你必须手动提供这个程序化植被生成器应该在上方生成的所有材质。

Key: If choosing Random, the system will determine the number of elements in the mesh array and randomly index into them.
Value: 若选择随机模式，系统将确定网格数组的元素总数，并随机索引访问其中的元素。

Key: If collision was predicted to be valid move the particle to the collision location and prepare for a fractional solver update
Value: 如果预测碰撞有效，则将粒子移至碰撞位置，并准备执行部分时间步的求解器更新。

Key: If Condition is true, the output value will be the True pin, otherwise output will be the False pin.
Value: 如条件为true，输出值将为True引脚，否则输出将为False引脚。

Key:
If drawing a value from a grid attribute, this defines the grid to read from.
If drawing a vector directly, this grid defines the location of each sample in space.
Value: 从网格属性读取时，此项定义读取网格；直接绘制向量时，此网格定义每个采样在空间中的位置。

Key: If Dynamic Pins is enabled in the BP settings, override this function to provide the type for the given pin. You can use "GetTypeUnionOfIncidentEdges" from the settings to get the union of input types on a given pin. Use the bitwise OR to combine multiple types together.
Value: 如果在蓝图设置中启用了动态引脚，则重载此函数以提供给定引脚的类型。你可以使用设置中的“GetTypeUnionOfIncidentEdges”来获取给定引脚上输入类型的并集。使用按位或将多种类型组合在一起。

Key:
If enabled Input Action nodes will hide unsupported trigger pins and give warnings when using unsupported triggers.
This warning only works with triggers set up in an Input Action, not Input Mapping Contexts.
Value:
如启用，输入操作节点将隐藏不支持的触发器引脚，并在使用不支持的触发器时发出警告。
此警告只适用于在输入操作中设置的触发器，而非输入映射上下文。

Key: If enabled, a material input may be baked out to a texture (using a simple quad). Baking is only used for non-trivial material inputs (i.e. not simple texture or constant expressions).
Value: 如启用，材质输入可以被烘焙为纹理（使用简单四边形）。烘焙只用于非琐碎材质输入（即非简单纹理或常量表达式）。

Key: If enabled, assets containing Blueprint instances (e.g. maps) will not be marked dirty when default values are edited, unless it results in the instance becoming realigned with the new default value.
Value: 如果启用，默认值被编辑时，包含蓝图实例的资产（例如地图）不会被标记为dirty，除非这会导致实例与新的默认值重新对齐。

Key: If enabled, bake size is based on the largest texture used in the material input's expression graph. If none found, bake size will fall back to the explicit dimensions.
Value: 如果启用，烘焙尺寸基于材质输入表达式图中使用的最大纹理。如果没有找到，烘焙尺寸将回退到显式尺寸。

Key: If enabled, blueprint nodes in the event graph will display with unique names rather than their display name.
Value: 启用后，事件图表中蓝图节点将显示唯一的命名，而非显示的命名。

Key: If enabled, by default, the Out pin type will have the union of In pin types. Default only works if the pins are In and Out. For custom behavior, implement DynamicPinTypesOverride.
Value: 如果启用，默认情况下，Out引脚类型将拥有In引脚类型的并集。默认仅在引脚为In和Out时才有效。对于自定义行为，请实现DynamicPinTypesOverride。

Key: If enabled, deprecated functions will be visible in the context menu and will be available for override implementation. By default, functions marked as deprecated are not exposed in either case.
Value: 启用后，已废弃的函数将显示在快捷菜单中，可用于重载实现。被标记为已废弃的函数默认不会在任何情况下被公开。

Key: If enabled, invoking the Blueprint graph context menu with one or more compatible assets selected in the Content Browser will generate an additional set of pre-bound menu actions when the "Context Sensitive" option is enabled. For example, selecting a Static Mesh asset in the Content Browser will result in an extra "Add Static Mesh Component" menu action that's already bound to the selected asset.
Value: 如启用，启用“上下文敏感”选项时，在内容浏览器中选择一个或多个兼容资产调用蓝图图上下文菜单将生成一组额外的预绑定菜单操作。举例而言，在内容浏览器中选择一个静态网格体资产将导致一个额外的“添加静态网格体组件”菜单操作，此操作已经绑定到选定资源。

Key: If enabled, materials imported with the Interchange-glTF importer will be directly mapped for the Exporter. bExport material options below will be ignored.
Value: 如启用，使用Interchange-glTF导入器导入的材质将直接映射到导出器。下方的bExport材质选项将被忽略。

Key: If enabled, materials that have a proxy defined in their user data, will be exported using that proxy instead. This setting won't affect proxy materials exported or referenced directly.
Value: 如启用，将改用代理导出在其用户数据中定义此代理的材质。该设置不会影响直接导出或引用的代理材质。

Key: If enabled, materials using the Importer's SpecularGlossiness material function will be exported. Uses extension KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness.
Value: 如启用，将导出使用导入器的SpecularGlossiness材质函数的材质。使用扩展KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness。

Key: If enabled, materials with shading model clear coat will be properly exported. Uses extension KHR_materials_clearcoat.
Value: 如果启用，拥有着色模型透明涂层的材质将被正确导出。使用扩展名KHR_materials_clearcoat。

Key: If enabled, materials with shading model cloth will be properly exported. Uses extension KHR_materials_sheen.
Value: 如果启用，带有着色模型布料的材质将正确导出。使用扩展KHR_materials_sheen。

Key: If enabled, materials with shading model thin translucency will be exported. Export is only partial. Uses extension KHR_materials_transmission.
Value: 如启用，将导出拥有着色模型薄半透明度的材质。仅部分导出。使用扩展KHR_materials_transmission。

Key: If enabled, materials with shading model unlit will be properly exported. Uses extension KHR_materials_unlit.
Value: 如启用，带有着色模型无光照的材质将被正确导出。使用扩展KHR_materials_unlit。

Key: If enabled, nodes with execution pins can be disabled via context menu. Disabled nodes will not be compiled, but also will not break existing connections.
Value: 如果启用，拥有执行引脚的节点可以通过上下文菜单被禁用。被禁用的节点不会参与编译，但也不会破坏现有连接。

Key: If enabled, the editor will load packages to look for soft references to actors when deleting/renaming them. This can be slow in large projects so disable this to improve performance but increase the chance of breaking blueprints/sequences that use soft actor references
Value: 启用后，编辑器将加载包来查找在删除/重命名actor时对其的软引用。此操作在大型项目中可能运行缓慢，禁用此项可提升性能，但使用软actor引用的蓝图/序列被打破的可能性将变大。

Key: If enabled, then a separate section with your Blueprint favorites will be pinned to the top of the context menu.
Value: 如果启用，则会将一个包含你的蓝图收藏夹的独立分段固定到上下文菜单的顶部。

Key: If enabled, then ALL component functions are exposed to the context menu (when the contextual target is a component owner). Ignores "ExposeFunctionCategories" metadata for components.
Value: 启用后，所有组件函数将公开为快捷菜单（情境目标是组件拥有者时）。忽略组件的“ExposeFunctionCategories”元数据。

Key: If enabled, then call-on-member actions will be spawned as a single node (instead of a GetMember + FunctionCall node).
Value: 启用后，“成员上调用”操作将被生成为单个节点（而非GetMember + FunctionCall节点）。

Key: If enabled, then placed cast nodes will default to their "pure" form (meaning: without execution pins).
Value: 启用后，放置的投射节点将默认为其“纯”形式（代表无执行引脚）。

Key: If enabled, then you'll be able to directly connect arbitrary object pins together (a pure cast node will be injected automatically).
Value: 启用后，能够直接将任意对象引脚连接在一起（纯投射节点将被自动注入）。

Key: If enabled, then your Blueprint favorites will be uncategorized, leaving you with less nested categories to sort through.
Value: 启用后，蓝图收藏夹将不会被分类，进行分类的嵌套类型更少。

Key: If enabled, tooltips on action menu items will show the associated action's signature id (can be used to setup custom favorites menus).
Value: 启用后，操作菜单项目的提示文本将显示关联操作的签名ID（可用于设置自定义收藏夹菜单）。

Key: If enabled, we'll save off your chosen target setting based off of the context (allowing you to have different preferences based off what you're operating on).
Value: 启用后，将基于情境保存选择的目标设置（基于操作内容拥有不同的偏好设置）。

Key: If enough time has passed to exceed our noise time interval setting, change direction. Otherwise, stay the course
Value: 如果经过的时间超过噪声时间间隔设置，则改变方向；否则保持当前方向。

Key: If Event send rate is set, accumulate a timer which determines when a new event is ready to be sent, and enable the condition on the event to send it.
Value: 设置事件发送速率时，累计计时器以确定何时可发送新事件，并启用事件发送条件。

Key: If false then it the audio component keeps playing after the niagara component was destroyed. Looping sounds are always stopped when the component is destroyed.
Value: 如为false，Niagara组件被销毁后，音频组件将继续播放。组件被销毁时，循环音效将固定停止。

Key:
If false then this version is not visible in the version selector dropdown menu of the stack. This is useful to hide work in progress versions without removing the module from the search menu.
The exposed version is always visible to users.
Value:
如为false，则此版本在堆栈的版本选择器下拉菜单中不可见。这有助于隐藏正在进行的工作版本，而无需从搜索菜单中移除模块。
公开版本固定对用户可见。

Key:
If Forces/Drag have been converted to Velocity, 
zero out Transient.PhysicsForce and Transient.PhysicsDrag to allow for post-solve accumulation
Value: 如果力／阻力已转换为速度，则将 Transient.PhysicsForce 和 Transient.PhysicsDrag 清零，以允许求解后累积。

Key: If it extracts materials, we can specify override materials. It needs to have the same number of material overrides than there are materials on the static mesh.
Value: 如果提取材质，我们可以指定重载材质。它需要拥有与静态网格体上材质相同数量的重载材质。

Key: if it's valid write to 2 - there are always 0 or 2 results. If there are 2 the second number will be written lastly
Value: 如果有效，则写入 2；结果始终为 0 个或 2 个。如果有 2 个，第二个数最后写入。

Key: if its occluded but not set to kill turn off collision because the returned normals and position will be wrong
Value: 如果已被遮挡但未设为销毁，则关闭碰撞，因为返回的法线和位置会不正确。

Key: If killing particles by age is disabled, this will loop the particle lifetime over and over, allowing features that index into Particles.Age or Particles.NormalizedAge to still function even as the particle itself lives forever.
Value: 禁用按年龄销毁时，循环粒子生命周期，使依赖 Particles.Age 或 Particles.NormalizedAge 的功能继续工作。

Key:
If LoopedAge > LoopDuration then increment loop count and store the remainder in LoopedAge. 
The Emitter is still delayed if LoopedAge < 0.0.
Value:
如果 LoopedAge > LoopDuration，则递增循环次数并将余数存入 LoopedAge。
当 LoopedAge < 0.0 时，发射器仍会延迟。

Key: If multiple nodes with the same  type are inserted at the same point, this defined order and if they get combined, only used if domain is PostProcess
Value: 如相同类型的多个节点在相同点插入，这将定义排序，如果其被组合，则只在域为PostProcess时使用

Key: If no existing materials are found, whether to automatically create Unreal materials for materials found in the FBX scene
Value: 如未找到现有材质，是否为FBX场景中找到的材质自动创建虚幻材质

Key:
If no regions are specified, we'll sample the whole mesh at this LODIndex.
-1 will use the lowest quality LOD available, i.e. Number of LODs - 1.
Value:
如未指定区域，将采样此LODIndex处的整个网格体。
-1将使用可用的最低质量LOD，即LOD数量 - 1。

Key: If non-zero, overrides r.Material.PreshaderGapInterval for this material.  Workaround for a platform specific register overflow bug.
Value: 如果非零，则重载此材质的r.Material.PreshaderGapInterval。平台特有的寄存器溢出错误的解决方法。

Key: If Ribbon Facing mode is set to Custom on the Ribbon Renderer, the ribbon normal will align to this vector.
Value: 如果条带渲染器的条带朝向模式设为“自定义”，条带法线将对齐到此向量。

Key: If set interface functions will always show in the overrides menu, even if they are already shown in the interfaces menu
Value: 如设置，即使接口函数已在接口菜单中显示，其将固定显示在重载菜单中

Key: If set then the parent class will be listed next to the override function name in the overrides function menu
Value: 如设置，在重载函数菜单中，父类将显示在重载函数名旁

Key:
If set to 1.0 each axis is distributed separately. 
If set to 0.0 the axis distribution is unified which can be useful for scale parameters.
Axis variation can be increased to taste by using values between 0.0 and 1.0.
Value: 1.0 时各轴独立分布，0.0 时统一分布；可用 0.0-1.0 调节轴向变化。

Key: If set to false the loop will continue with the next iteration and execute no code - will be evaluated at the *start* of every iteration.
Value: 如果设为false，循环将继续进行下一次迭代，并且不执行任何代码 - 将在每次迭代的 *开始* 处计算。

Key: If set to true then values will not be updated while typing, only when committing the input field. This is useful for values that cause big downstream changes and computational overhead, like grid size or spawned particles.

Key: If set to true, Particles.Velocity's magnitude will not exceed the value specified in "Maximum Velocity"

Key: If set to true, prevent MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified to do its job. Use that only when you will call MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified or equivalent later.
Value: 如设为true，则阻止MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified执行其任务。仅当稍后会调用MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified或等效函数时才会使用。

Key: If set to true, quaternion attributes will be interpolated via slerp instead of lerp in interpolated spawn scripts.
Value: 如果设为true，四元数属性将通过球面插值而并非插值生成脚本中的插值进行内插。

Key: If set to true, this value will be used to initialize thie interpolated output. If left unchecked the target value will initialize the output.
Value: 启用时，使用此值初始化插值输出；未勾选时，使用目标值初始化输出。

Key:
If set to true, types like positions and vectors cannot be assigned to each other without an explicit conversion step.
If false, type checks are loosened and some types can be implicitly converted into each other.
It is recommended to not disable this when working with large world coordinates.
Value:
如果设为true，位置和向量这样的类型没有显式转换步骤就不能彼此赋值。

Key: If set we will use the FrictionCombineMode of this material, instead of the FrictionCombineMode found in the project settings.

Key: If set we will use the RestitutionCombineMode of this material, instead of the RestitutionCombineMode found in the project settings.

Value: 如果设置，则在为此轨道记录新缓存时，引擎可延展性设置将被此值重载

Key: If specified, the function that is created for this entry point will have this name.  Otherwise, it will have the function signature's name
Value: 指定后，为此进入点创建的函数将被设为该命名。否则，其将被设为函数签名的命名

Key: If specified, the reference can be left unbound, otherwise the State Tree compiler report error if the reference is not bound.
Value: 如果指定，引用可以保持未绑定状态，否则如果引用未绑定，状态树编译器将报告错误。

Key: If specified, this icon will be used for the given bool if it evaluates to False. If OverrideName isn't empty, the icon takes priority.

Key: If specified, this icon will be used for the given bool if it evaluates to True. If OverrideName isn't empty, the icon takes priority.

Key: If specified, this icon will be used for the given enum entry. If OverrideName isn't empty, the icon takes priority.
Value: 如果指定，此图标将用于给定枚举条目。如果OverrideName不为空，图标将优先。

Key: if the acceleration direction is sufficiently in opposition of the previous velocity we will say this is a stalemate condition
Value: 如果加速度方向与上一帧速度充分相反，则判定为僵持状态。

Key: If the amount of movement on a given frame is below this threshold, don't spawn any particles. Prevents small emitter movements from spawning particles.
Value: 如果某帧的移动量低于此阈值，则不生成粒子，避免发射器的小幅移动生成粒子。

Key: If the emitter is further than this away from the nearest camera it will be culled. Also used to define Emitter.Scalability.DistanceFraction
Value: 如果发射器距离最近摄像机超过此值，则会被剔除。也用于定义 Emitter.Scalability.DistanceFraction。

Key: If the emitter is nearer than this to the nearest camera it will be culled. Also used to define Emitter.Scalability.DistanceFraction
Value: 如果发射器距离最近摄像机小于此值，则会被剔除。也用于定义 Emitter.Scalability.DistanceFraction。

Key:
If the Emitter is not calculating its own Scalablity but scalability is still being used, Bypass all the logic 
and pass the System level scalability settings down to the emitter level
Value: 如果发射器不计算自身可扩展性但仍在使用可扩展性，则绕过所有逻辑，将系统级可扩展性设置传递到发射器级别。

Key: If the emitter moves further than this value in a single frame,  stop spawning particles on that frame.
Value: 如果发射器在单帧内移动的距离超过此值，则该帧停止生成粒子。

Value: 如果发射器在单帧内的速率超过此值，则该帧停止生成粒子。

Key: If the emitter which owns these infinitely lived particles becomes inactive (either from being deactivated in script or from scalability such as distance culling), allow the particles to live out the remainder of their lifetimes normally.
Value: 拥有无限生命周期粒子的发射器因脚本或可扩展性变为非活动时，让粒子正常完成剩余生命周期。

Key: if the friction is greater than the current forward velocity on the plane then remove the forward velocity - (enter a positive value to be subtracted)
Value: 如果摩擦力大于平面上的当前前向速度，则移除前向速度（输入要减去的正值）。

Key: If the length of the vector between the origin and the particle postion is 0 then this vector will be used.
Value: 如果原点与粒子位置之间的向量长度为 0，则使用此向量。

Key: If the length of the vector between the two positions is zero or almost zero, inject a bit of randomness to make sure that the particles still behave as expected
