Key: If the loop count really did go up, we need to decide on the new loop variables, also calculate normalized age here.
Value: 如果循环次数确实增加，则需要确定新的循环变量，同时在此计算归一化年龄。

Key: If the Niagara compiler sees that a script writes to a namespace that is read only (e.g. a particle script writing to a system attribute), what should it do.
Value: 如果Niagara编译器发现脚本写入只读命名空间（例如粒子脚本写入系统属性），它应该执行什么操作。

Key: If the object we are bound to is an actor it will return root component inverse transform, or the component class we bound to
Value: 如果我们绑定的Object是一个Actor，它将返回根组件逆变换，或我们绑定的组件类

Key: If the object we are bound to is an actor it will return root component transform, or the component class we bound to
Value: 如果我们绑定到的Object是一个Actor，它将返回根组件变换，或者我们绑定到的组件类

Key: If the particle position lies within a cone, defined by the parameters, a value of 1 will be returned. Various level's of overlap will be returned via a unit space float.
Value: 粒子位置位于参数定义的圆锥内时返回1。不同程度的重叠通过单位范围浮点值返回。

Key: if the particle starts off within a collision surface move it out of there and feed the necessary data to the system
Value: 如果粒子初始位于碰撞表面内部，则将其移出，并向系统提供必要数据。

Key: if the particle's new velocity is purely due to acceleration forces against the collision surface remove the objects restitution to avoid bouncing
Value: 如果粒子新速度完全由作用于碰撞表面的加速度力产生，则移除物体恢复系数以避免弹跳。

Key: If the proposed vector cannot be remapped to the cone axis, this vector will be returned. This can happen when it's length is 0, the cone axis' length is 0 or the two vectors are completely in opposite directions.
Value: 如果无法将提议向量重映射到圆锥轴，则返回此向量。向量长度为 0、圆锥轴长度为 0 或两者完全相反时可能发生。

Key: If the quaternions are pointing in two different directions, negate the new rotation to better align with the old.
Value: 如果四元数指向两个不同方向，则对新的旋转取负，使其更好地与旧旋转对齐。

Key: If the query was successful this returns the non-normalized direction to the nearest surface, otherwise returns (0, 0, 0).
Value: 如果查询成功，则此项将非标准化方向返回到最近的表面，否则返回（0，0，0）。

Key: If the query was successful, this returns the world normal at the sample point. Otherwise returns (0, 0, 1).
Value: 如果查询成功，这将返回取样点处的世界法线。否则返回（0，0，1）。

Key: If the query was successful, this returns the world position that was recalculated from the scene depth. Otherwise returns (0, 0, 0).
Value: 如果查询成功，则返回根据场景深度重新计算的世界位置。否则返回（0，0，0）。

Key: If the rejection critera is passed, kill the particle. If not killing, the rejection state is still written to a particle attribute boolean output for later use.
Value: 如果满足拒绝条件，则销毁粒子；不销毁时，仍将拒绝状态写入粒子布尔属性供后续使用。

Key: If the source data is greater than the threshold, replace the simulation data with the source. Vector length is used for the comparison where appropriate.
Value: 如果源数据大于阈值，则用源数据替换模拟数据；适用时使用向量长度比较。

Key:
If the system is being set by scalability then allow the emitter it's own state.
Otherwise override with the system state
Value:
如果系统状态由可扩展性设置决定，则允许发射器使用自身状态；
否则以系统状态覆盖。

Key:
If the system manages state, make some decisions based
on CompleteOnInactive as set at the system level
Value: 如果由系统管理状态，则根据系统级设置的 CompleteOnInactive 作出相应决策。

Key: If the user has chosen for the emitter to complete first, then kill, pass through an inactive state first, wait for everything to die/complete, then pass through the desired kill state.
Value: 如果用户选择先完成发射器再销毁，则先经过非活动状态，等待所有内容死亡／完成，再进入所需销毁状态。

Key: if the variables are uninitialized just orient them correctly based on the mesh quat ... but then the quat should be updated...
Value: 如果变量未初始化，则仅根据网格体四元数正确设置朝向……但之后应更新四元数。

Key: If there is more than one mesh in the Mesh Array of your mesh renderer, you can index into the different elements of that array here.
Value: 若网格渲染器的网格数组中包含多个网格，可在此处索引访问该数组的不同元素。

Key: If this array has entries, we will create a MaterialInstanceDynamic per Emitter instance from Material and set the Material parameters using the Niagara simulation variables listed.
Value: 如果此数组包含条目，我们将根据Material创建每个Emitter实例的一个MaterialInstanceDynamic，并使用列出的Niagara模拟变量来设置Material参数。

Key: If this BP is just a duplicate created for a specific compilation, the reference to original GeneratedClass is needed
Value: 如果此蓝图只是针对特定编译而创建的副本，则需要对原始GeneratedClass的引用

Key: If this input can auto-bind to system parameters and emitter attributes. Will never auto bind to custom parameters.
Value: 此输入是否可自动绑定到系统参数和发射器属性。从不自动绑定到自定义参数。

Key:
If this interface should read the current frame's data from the Data Channel. If false, the interface will read from the previous frame if it's available.

Reading the current frame allows us to use the most current data and have the least possible latency from the source.
However, it introduces a tick order dependency between this read and the Blueprints, Game Code or other Niagara Systems writing into this Data Channel.
If this interface reads data before those writing to the Data Channel have executed, then that data will be missed.

Reading the previous frame allows us to avoid this tick order dependency.
We can be sure we are reading all data that is written to the Data Channel, regardless of when the writes happened in the frame.
However it does introduce a 1 frame delay in the data being read and so can cause latency/lag.
Value:
此接口是否要从数据通道读取当前帧的数据。如为false，则接口将从上一帧（如果可用）读取。

读取当前帧使我们能够使用最新的数据并尽可能减少源的延迟。
然而，它引入了此读取与写入此数据通道的蓝图、游戏代码或其他Niagara系统之间的Tick顺序依赖性。
如果此接口在写入数据通道的操作执行之前读取数据，则此数据将丢失。

读取前一帧可以让我们避免这种Tick顺序依赖性。
我们可以确定我们正在读取写入数据通道的所有数据，无论写入何时发生在帧中。
然而，它确实在读取数据时引入了1帧延迟，因此可能导致延迟/滞后。

Key: If this is a bitmask, choose an optional enumeration type for the flags. Note that changing this will also reset the default value.
Value: 若此为一组位掩码，请为标记选择一项任选枚举类型。请注意，变更此类型将重置默认值。

Key: If this is an object reference literal, keep a reference here so that it can be updated as objects move around
Value: 若此为文字对象引用，将引用保持在此处，以便对象移动时对其进行更新

Key: If this is checked, found actors that are outside component bounds will not trigger a refresh. Only works for tags for now in editor.
Value: 如果勾选此项，在组件边界之外找到Actor将不会触发刷新。目前只对编辑器中的标签有效。

Key: If this is not an override, allow user to specify a name for the function created by this entry point
Value: 如此不为重载，用户可指定该进入点创建的函数命名

Key:
If this script is displayed inline in the overview (dynamic input in the overview node for example), use this display name.
Should be short and concise.
Value:
如果此脚本在概览中以内联方式显示（例如概览节点中的动态输入），请使用此显示名称。
应简短精炼。

Key: If true and bCullByViewFrustum is enabled, we allow view frustum checks in pre-culling. Meaning we can cull off screen systems before they even spawn.
Value: 如为true，并且bCullByViewFrustum被启用，我们允许在预剔除中查看视锥体检查。这意味着我们可以在它们生成之前就把屏幕系统剔除掉。

Key: If true and in a non-default facing mode, will lock facing direction to an arbitrary plane of rotation
Value: 如为true且处于非默认朝向模式，则将朝向固定到旋转的任意平面

Key: If true Particle attributes will be removed from the DataSet if they are unnecessary (are never read by ParameterMap)
Value: 如为true，真正的粒子属性在不必要时将从DataSet中移除（永远不会被ParameterMap读取）

Key: If true ParticleReads will not absolutely prevent attribute trimming - User must ensure that the appropriate attributes are preserved on the source emitter!
Value: 如为true，ParticleReads不会绝对阻止属性修剪——用户必须确保适当的属性被保留在源发射器上！

Key: If true the compilation environment will be changed to remove the global COMPILE_SHADERS_FOR_DEVELOPMENT flag.
Value: 如为true，编译环境将被修改，移除整体COMPILE_SHADERS_FOR_DEVELOPMENT标签。

Key: If true the script will form a trace between point A and B. Otherwise, the trace will start at A and move along the vector provide for the number of units specified by "Max Trace Length."
Value: 启用时，在点 A 与点 B 之间形成追踪；禁用时，从 A 沿提供的向量移动指定“最大追踪长度”单位。

Key: If true the sprites volume will be calculated as Height * Width * (the smallest of the two dimensions). If false the volume will be calculated as H * W * (the largest dimension).
Value: 启用时，精灵体积按 高×宽×两者较小值 计算；禁用时按 高×宽×较大尺寸 计算。

Key: If true then a python script will be executed when changing from this script to the selected deprecation recommendation. This allows the current script to transfer its inputs to the new script.
Value: 如为true，则从该脚本变更为选定弃用建议时将执行python脚本。这允许当前脚本将其输入转移到新脚本。

Key: If true then active effects rebase the simulation positions to not lose precision. Can be turned off if not needed to skip unnecessary rebasing calculations.
Value: 如为true，那么激活效果将以模拟位置重设基准，以不失去精度。如果不需要，可以关闭，以跳过不必要的重设基准计算。

Key:
If true then components will not be automatically assigned to the first particle available, but try to stick to the same particle based on its unique id.
Disabling this option is faster, but a particle can get a different component each tick, which can lead to problems with for example motion blur.
Value:
为true时，组件不会自动分配给首个可用粒子，而是尝试根据唯一ID持续绑定到同一个粒子。
禁用此选项速度更快，但粒子每次更新可能分配到不同组件，从而导致运动模糊等问题。

Key:
If true then components will only be activated when newly acquired. e.g. on particle spawn or when the particle enables/disables the component.
If false, components will be always kept active while they are used by an enabled particle.
This can be useful for component types that can internally activate and deactivate during their lifetimes while still being used by an enabled particle.
For example NiagaraComponents that deactivate/reactivate according to scalability settings.
This setting is only valid when bAssignComponentsOnParticleID is true.
Value:
如为true，则组件仅在新获取时才被激活。例如粒子生成时或粒子启用/禁用组件时。
如为false，当组件被已启用粒子使用时，它们将始终保持激活状态。
这对于那些可以在生命周期内内部激活和禁用的组件类型很有用，同时它们仍然被启用的粒子使用。
例如根据可延展性设置禁用/重新激活的NiagaraComponents。
此设置仅在bAssignComponentsOnParticleID为true时有效。

Key: If true then emitter and system nodes will show a simplified representation on low zoom levels. This improves performance and readablity when zoomed out of the system overview graph.
Value: 如为true，发射器和系统节点将在低缩放级别上进行一个简化显示。这在缩小系统概览图表时提升了性能和可读性。

Key: If true then min and max spawn counts are multiplied by emitter spawn count scale, similar to existing spawn modules like spawn rate or spawn burst.
Value: 如为true，则最小和最大生成数量将乘以发射器生成数量比例，类似于现有的生成模块，例如生成速率或生成爆发。

Key:
If true then new components can only be created on newly spawned particles. If a particle is not able to create a component on it's first frame (e.g. because the component
limit was reached) then it will be blocked from spawning a component on subsequent frames.
Value:
如为true，则只能在新生成的粒子上创建新组件。如果粒子无法在其第一帧上创建组件（例如因为达到了组件上限），
则会阻止它在后续帧中生成组件。

Key: If true then position inputs are automatically transformed from simulation space to world space, so the write works correctly for localspace emitters.
Value: 如为true，位置输入会自动从模拟空间变换到世界空间，因此本地空间发射器的写入工作正常。

Key: If true then position inputs are automatically transformed from world space to simulation space, so the read works correctly for localspace emitters.
Value: 如为true，位置输入会自动从世界空间变换到模拟空间，因此本地空间发射器的读取工作正常。

Key: If true then position inputs are automatically transformed from world space to simulation space, so the spawning works correctly for localspace emitters.
Value: 如为true，位置输入会自动从世界空间变换到模拟空间，因此本地空间发射器的生成工作正常。

Key: If true then position type values will be rebased on system activation to fit into a float precision vector. This needs to be turned off when using a custom data interface or renderer that does not support the rebasing.
Value: 如为true，那么位置类型值将在系统激活时重设基准，以匹配一个浮点精度向量。当使用不支持重设基准的自定义数据接口或渲染器时，需要关闭此功能。

Key: If true then the "link input" menu will also show variables of different types, as long as there is a conversion script for them.
Value: 如为真，“连接输入”菜单也会显示不同类型的变量，只要存在针对它们的转换脚本。

Key: If true then the check is not emitter-wide, but only within the same context (e.g. particle update).
Value: 如为true，则检查不是发射器范围内，而是仅在同一上下文内（例如粒子更新）。

Key: If true then the mesh velocity is taken from the mesh component's physics data. Otherwise it will be calculated by diffing the component transforms between ticks, which is more reliable but won't work on the first frame.
Value: 如为true，则从网格体的物理数据中获取网格体速度。否则将通过比对tick之间的组件变换来进行计算，这种方法更为可靠，但无法用于第一帧。

Key: If true then the section properties might still be changed (so the section itself is not locked), but the cache cannot be rerecorded to prevent accidentally overriding the data within
Value: 如为true，则分段属性可能仍会变更（因此分段本身未锁定），但无法重新记录缓存以防止意外重载其中的数据

Key:
If true then the trace will be skipped completely.
This can be used as a performance optimization, as branch nodes in the graph still execute every path.
Value:
如果为true，则将完全跳过追踪。
这可以用作性能优化，因为图表中的分支节点仍会执行每条路径。

Key: If true then these parameters will appear as top level entry in add menus (e.g. in the module editor)
Value: 如为true，则这些参数将作为顶层条目出现在添加菜单中（例如在模块编辑器中）

Key: If true then this data interface only processes sounds during active gameplay. This is useful when you are working in the preview window and the sounds annoy you.
Value: 如为true，则此数据接口只会在激活的游戏进程中处理声音。如果在预览窗口中工作时有烦躁的声音，这将非常实用。

Key: If true then this data interface will also read and write intermediate bones or geometry, otherwise only leaf nodes are considered

Key:
Important usage notes: 

This module must be placed immediately before a Solve Forces and Velocity module. 

Simulation stage usage: 
A Solve Forces and Velocity module should be placed at the end of particle update. This module can be placed in a simulation stage. The simulation stage should operate on particles and perform 1 iteration. A Solve Forces and Velocity module should be placed immediately after this module. That module's "Write to Intrinsic Properties" Bool should be driven by [Transient]CollisionValid.

When used in CPU emitters, the module will cast rays to calculate it's collision with the world. 

When used with GPU emitters, the module will either use the scene depth,  global distance field, or GPU Ray Tracing to find collision surfaces.

GPU Ray Tracing Notes: You must have a gpu ray tracing enabled video card, the project settings also have to allow gpu ray traces.

Key:
Manages Particle Age/Lifetime.

Takes the current Particles.Age attribute and updates it by adding Engine.DeltaTime. 

If "Enable Particle Lifetime Looping" is set and "Kill Particles When Lifetime Has Elapsed" is unset then Particles.Age will wrap around to 0 after exceeding Particles.Lifetime.  

Else if "Kill Particles When Lifetime Has Elapsed" is disabled the particle lives indefinitely.

Otherwise the particle is killed when Particles.Age exceeds Particles.Lifetime.

A normalized version of Particles.Age is stored in Particles.NormalizedAge, where a value 0.0 is the birth of the particle and 1.0 is a full lifetime. This is convenient in animated ranges.
Value:
管理粒子的年龄和生命周期。

读取当前 Particles.Age 属性，并加上 Engine.DeltaTime 来更新粒子年龄。

如果启用“粒子生命周期循环”，并且未启用“生命周期结束时销毁粒子”，则 Particles.Age 超过 Particles.Lifetime 后会回绕到 0。

否则，如果未启用“生命周期结束时销毁粒子”，粒子将无限存活。

其余情况下，当 Particles.Age 超过 Particles.Lifetime 时，粒子会被销毁。

Particles.Age 的归一化值存储在 Particles.NormalizedAge 中：0.0 表示粒子刚出生，1.0 表示已度过完整生命周期。该值便于驱动随生命周期变化的动画。

Key:

材质实例可用于修改材质外观，不会触发高开销的材质重编译。

Key: Material output expression to switch logic according to whether distance fields renderering is supported on this project and feature level.

Key: Material output expression to switch logic according to whether virtual texturing is supported on this project, platform and feature level.
Value: 材质输出表达式根据该项目、平台和特征等级是否支持虚拟纹理以切换逻辑。

Key: Material output expression to switch logic for a path that renders to runtime virtual texture pages.
Value: 切换路径逻辑的材质输出表达式，该路径渲染到运行时虚拟纹理页面。

Material parameter track for element at index {0}, asset {1}.

Material state attribute struct

Stores material state value, whether state is set and whether it overrides child state.

材质状态属性结构体

材质颜色状态值，状态是否被设置以及是否重载子状态。

Key:
Material switcher for element at index {0} 
 Binding references missing Material Slot Name {1}. This can be rebound in right-click menu.
Value:
索引{0}处元素的材质切换器
绑定引用缺失材质槽位名称{1}。这可以在右键菜单中反弹。

Key:
Material that performs ray marching.  Note this must have certain parameters in order
to work correctly
Value:
执行光线行进的材质。注意：这必须拥有特定参数
才能正确工作

Key: Material to set for internal faces on fracture. 'Automatic' will use the most common 'internal' material in each geometry, or the last valid material if no internal faces are found

Key: Material to use instead of the original material; only available when Override is selected as material mode

Key: Material to use when PSOs are still compiling for a component and UseFallbackMaterialUntilPSOPrecached is set for EPSOPrecacheProxyCreationStrategy.

Key: Material used for visualizing level membership in lit view port modes. Uses shading to show axis directions.
Value: 用于在光照视口模式中显示关卡成员关系的材质。用着色来显示轴方向。

Key: Material used for visualizing level membership in unlit view port modes.  Uses shading to show axis directions.
Value: 用于在无光照视口模式中显示关卡成员关系的材质。用着色来显示轴方向。

Key: Material used to render landscape components with holes. If not set, LandscapeMaterial will be used (blend mode will be overridden to Masked if it is set to Opaque)

Key: Material {0} had the option "Use Half Precision" from Float Precision Mode checked. This option was not working as intended before so it's being reverted to Default to maintain previous behaviour.

Key: Max trace length is present to avoid removing it from the ui when it's later usage is culled via a static switch.
Value: 保留最大追踪长度，是为了避免其后续用途被静态开关剔除时，此项也从界面中消失。

Value: 来自物理解算器的数据每次被处理时，用于生成粒子的碰撞/中断/拖尾条目的最大数量

Key: MCP (Anthropic's Model Context Protocol) Tool Libraries are containers of functions which will be automatically exposed as MCP tools for LLM's to use.
Value: MCP（Anthropic的模型上下文协议）工具库是函数的容器，这些函数将自动暴露为供LLM使用的MCP工具。

Key: Measure gpu runtime cost of scripts. Can be expensive for simulation stages with lots of iterations.
Value: 测量脚本的GPU运行时开销。用于迭代较多的模拟阶段时可能开销较高。

Key: Merge A and B into a single material by mixing their inputs rather than their evaluation. This makes lighting evaluation cheaper (Default: off)
Value: 通过混合输入而非其计算，将A和B合并为一个单一材质。这使得光照计算开销更低（默认为关闭）

Key: Merge Background and Foreground into a single material by mixing their inputs rather than their evaluation. This makes lighting evaluation cheaper (Default: off)
Value: 通过混合输入而非其计算，将背景和前景合并为一个单一材质。这使得光照计算开销更低（默认为关闭）

Key: Merge Top and Base into a single material by mixing their inputs rather than their evaluation. This makes lighting evaluation cheaper (Default: off)
Value: 通过混合输入而非其计算，将顶部和底部合并为一个单一材质。这使得光照计算开销更低（默认为关闭）

Key: Merged all the different mesh orientation module concepts into one module for ease of experimentation and discoverability.
Value: 将不同网格体朝向模块的功能合并为一个模块，以便试验和发现功能。

Key: Mesh parameter binding can be either an Actor (in which case we find the component), static mesh component or a static mesh.
Value: 网格体参数绑定可以是Actor（在这种情况下我们找到组件）、静态网格体组件或静态网格体。

Key: Mesh particles will align to the analytical plane's normal using this mesh space vector as the target alignment axis.
Value: 网格体粒子将使用此网格体空间向量作为目标对齐轴，对齐到解析平面的法线。

Key: Mesh used to sample from when not overridden by a source actor from the scene. Only available in editor for previewing. This is removed in cooked builds.
Value: 未被场景中源actor重载时用于采样的网格体。仅可在编辑器中预览。此设置在烘焙版本中被移除。

Key: Mesh used to sample from when not overridden by a source actor from the scene. This mesh is NOT removed from cooked builds.
Value: 未被场景中的源Actor覆盖时用于采样的网格体。此网格体不会从烘焙构建中移除。

Key: Message sent from a debugger client to a connected debugger containing the results of a sim cache capture.
Value: 从调试器客户端发送到连接的调试器的消息，其中包含模拟缓存捕获的结果。

Key: Message sent from the debugger to a client to request a sim cache capture for a particular component.
Value: 从调试器发送到客户端的消息，请求特定组件的模拟缓存。

Key:
Messaged broadcast from debugger to request a connection to a particular session.
If any matching client is found and it accepts, it will return a FNiagaraDebuggerAcceptConnection message to the sender.
Value:
从调试器发送消息广播，以请求到特定会话的连接。
如果找到任何匹配的客户端并且它接受，它将向发送者返回一条FNiagaraDebuggerAcceptConnection消息。

Key: Migrate the assets that were tagged using tags from this Tag Definitions assets to the new User Asset Tag system.
Value: 将使用此标签定义资产中的标签所标记的资产，迁移到新的用户资产标签系统中。

Key: Milliseconds value {MillisecondsValue} is greater than maximum milliseconds TimeSpan can represent. Clamping to MaxValue.
Value: 毫秒值 {MillisecondsValue} 大于TimeSpan所能代表的最大毫秒。将限定到MaxValue。

Key: Milliseconds value {MillisecondsValue} is less than minimum milliseconds TimeSpan can represent. Clamping to MinValue.
Value: 毫秒值 {MillisecondsValue} 小于TimeSpan所能代表的最小毫秒。将限定到MinValue。

Key: Mimic's a material editor function by the same name. Performs a well controlled threshold operation. The output should produce visible results as soon as the alpha is above 0.
Value: 模拟材质编辑器中的同名函数，执行精确可控的阈值处理。Alpha刚大于0时，输出就应产生可见效果。

Key: Minutes value {MinutesValue} is greater than maximum minutes TimeSpan can represent. Clamping to MaxValue.
Value: 分钟值 {MinutesValue} 大于TimeSpan所能代表的最大分钟。将限定到MaxValue。

Key: Minutes value {MinutesValue} is less than minimum minutes TimeSpan can represent. Clamping to MinValue.
Value: 分钟值 {MinutesValue} 小于TimeSpan所能代表的最小分钟。将限定到MinValue。

Key: Missing allocated node for {0} while searching for node links - likely due to the node having outstanding errors.
Value: 搜索节点链接时缺失已分配的节点 {0}——可能是由于节点存在未处理的错误。

Key: Mode determining if and how to export material variants that change the materials property on a static or skeletal mesh component.
Value: 模式确定是否以及如何导出变更静态或骨骼网格体组件上材质属性的材质变体。

Key:
Modeled after FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2AssignDelegate for the newer Blueprint
menu system. Acts simply as a UK2Node_AddDelegate with an attached custom-
event node (spawned in PostPlacedNewNode).

在较新蓝图菜单系统的FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2AssignDelegate
之后建模。以附加自定义事件节点用作UK2Node_AddDelegate（在PostPlacedNewNode中生成）。

Key: Modification: Add a depth culling because the material will do a smooth for depth in the pixel shader, and doing the depth culling before the smooth can save a lot of sample cost in the pixel shader
Value: 修改：添加深度剔除，因为材质会在像素着色器中平滑深度，平滑前进行深度剔除可节省采样开销。

Key: Modification: Output thickness because we want to do a smooth for thickness in the pixel shader, calc thickness before smooth will save a lot of sample cost in pixel shader
Value: 修改：输出厚度，因为希望在像素着色器中平滑厚度；先计算厚度再平滑可节省像素着色器采样开销。

Key: Modify the quaternion to ensure that the delta between it and B represents the shortest possible rotation angle.
Value: 修改四元数，确保其和B之间的差量代表了最短的旋转角度。

Key:
Module for setting and getting the local bounds.
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Emitter/EmitterBounds.EmitterBounds
Value:
用于设置和获取局部边界的模块。
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Emitter/EmitterBounds.EmitterBounds

Value: 如为true，模块脚本中定义的模块注释将默认展开。如果你熟悉Niagara且不需要模块注释，请考虑将其设为false。

Key: Module.PreviousVelocity needs to replace Particles.RotationalVelocity as soon as transient parameters can be used to drive module input defaults
Value: 一旦可以使用临时参数驱动模块输入默认值，就应使用 Module.PreviousVelocity 替换 Particles.RotationalVelocity。

Key:
More bounding vertices results in reduced overdraw, but adds more triangle overhead.
The eight vertex mode is best used when the SubUV texture has a lot of space to cut out that is not captured by the four vertex version,
and when the particles using the texture will be few and large.
Value:
边界顶点越多，过度绘制便越少，但会增加更多三角形开销。
八顶点模式的最佳使用情况是SubUV纹理拥有大量未被四顶点版本捕获的空间需要裁减时，以及使用纹理的粒子数量较少且体积较大时。

Key: More overridden materials ({OverridenCount}) on static mesh component than are referenced ({ReferencedCount}) in source mesh '{MeshName}'
Value: 静态网格体组件上的重载材质（{OverridenCount}个）比源网格体“{MeshName}”中引用的材质（{ReferencedCount}个）更多。

Key: Motion Matching is intended to only act as a leader in a sync group. Internally, only the most recent blend stack sample will have sync information for other asset players to follow and the rest of blend stack samples will tick without syncing.
Value: 运动匹配仅充当同步组中的领导者。在内部，只有最新的混合堆栈样本才会拥有其他资产播放器需要遵循的同步信息，而其余的混合堆栈样本将在不同步的情况下tick。

Key:
Motion vector offset in world space in the previous frame.

The input is added as a per-pixel offset to the motion vector generated by the velocity pass.

Non-Nanite (Non-basepass velocity supported).
Value:
前一帧世界空间中的运动向量偏移。

将输入作为逐像素偏移添加到速度通道生成的运动向量中。

非Nanite（支持非基础通道速度）。

Key:
Motion vectors generated are precise (ideal for motion blur and temporal anti-aliasing).
Requires relevant emitters to store more data per particle, and may affect vertex processing performance.
Value:
生成的运动向量较为精确（对于运动模糊和临时抗锯齿而言较为理想）。
要求相关发射器每个粒子存储更多数据，并可能影响顶点处理性能。

Key: Move the value of this input to a shared transient parameter and show that parameter value inline here.
Value: 将此输入的值移至共享临时参数，并在此处内联显示该参数值。

Key:
Moves particles that are outside the camera view a position that is inside the camera view.
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Camera/ViewRecycler.ViewRecycler
Value:
将摄像机视野外的粒子移到视野内的位置。
路径：/Niagara/Modules/Update/Camera/ViewRecycler.ViewRecycler

Key: Moves the sample position via Emitter Age plus a random float generated by the determinism flag to create a more random feeling sample.
Value: 通过发射器年龄加上由确定性标志生成的随机浮点数移动采样位置，使采样感觉更随机。

Key: Multi-scattering approximation: represents how much contribution each successive octave will add. Evaluated per pixel. Valid range is [0,1], from low to high contribution. Defaults to ConstMultiScatteringContribution from properties panel if not specified. Evaluated per pixel (globally).
Value: 多重散射近似：表示每个连续倍频将增加多少贡献度。每个像素计算。有效范围为[0,1]，从低到高贡献度。如未指定，则默认为来自属性面板的ConstMultiScatteringContribution。每个像素计算（全局）。

Key: Multi-scattering approximation: represents how much occlusion will be reduced for each successive octave. Evaluated per pixel. Valid range is [0,1], from low to high occlusion. Defaults to ConstMultiScatteringOcclusion from properties panel if not specified. Evaluated per pixel (globally).
Value: 多重散射近似：表示每个连续倍频的相位将减少的遮挡量。每个像素计算。有效范围为[0,1]，从低到高遮挡。如未指定，则默认为来自属性面板的ConstMultiScatteringOcclusion。每个像素计算（全局）。

Key: Multi-scattering approximation: represents how much the phase will become isotropic for each successive octave. Evaluated per pixel. Valid range is [0,1], from anisotropic to isotropic phase. Defaults to ConstMultiScatteringEccentricity from properties panel if not specified. Evaluated per pixel (globally).
Value: 多重散射近似：表示每个连续倍频的相位将变为各向同性的程度。每个像素计算。有效范围为[0,1]，从各向异性到各向同性相位。如未指定，则默认为来自属性面板的ConstMultiScatteringEccentricity。每个像素计算（全局）。

Key: Multiple entry pin possibilities. Unable to convert to a function. Make sure that selection either has only 1 entry pin or exactly 1 entry pin has a connection.
Value: 可能有多个入口引脚。无法转换为函数。请确保选项只拥有1个入口引脚；或只有1个入口引脚拥有连接。

Key:
Multiplies (Spawn Rate * Number of Particles in Sampled Emitter) to create a situation where each sampled lead particle is spawning the same number of follower particles, per second.

Ideal for ribbons behind lead particles and other cases where consistent counts is required from each leader.
Value: 将生成速率乘以采样发射器粒子数，让每个采样前导粒子每秒生成相同数量跟随粒子。

Key:
Multiplies (Spawn Rate * Number of Particles in Sim Cache) to create a situation where each sampled lead particle is spawning the same number of follower particles, per second.

Ideal for ribbons behind lead particles and other cases where consistent counts is required from each leader.
Value: 将生成速率乘以模拟缓存粒子数，让每个采样前导粒子每秒生成相同数量跟随粒子，适合条带等需要一致数量的场景。

Key: Multiplies against the Jitter Offset to create an offset vector which is applied to particle position
Value: 与抖动偏移相乘，生成应用于粒子位置的偏移向量。

Key:
Multiplies all values of the matrix by a float.
If your Matrix represents a Transform that you wish to scale you should use Apply Scale instead
Value:
将矩阵的所有值乘以一个浮点值。
如果你的矩阵代表一个需要缩放的变换，则应使用“应用缩放”

Key:
Multiply Particle.RibbonWidth by the module calculated scale value
This can be a constant, random or curve indexed by Particle.NormalizedAge
Value:
将Particle.RibbonWidth乘以模块计算的比例值，
可以是常数、随机数或由Particle.NormalizedAge索引的曲线。

Key:
Multiply Particle.Scale by the module calculated scale value
This can be a constant, random or curve indexed by Particle.NormalizedAge
Value:
将Particle.Scale乘以模块计算的比例值
这可以是由Particle.NormalizedAge索引的常量、随机或曲线

Key:
Multiply Particle.SpriteSize by the module calculated scale value

This feature can be used to stabilize difficult scenarios in which particles may endlessly bounce back and forth.

较小的值使粒子更容易进入静止状态，较大的值使其更少进入静止状态。

可用此功能稳定粒子持续来回弹跳等难以收敛的情况。

Key:
Per Material override to change floating point precision in the pixel shader (ALU and uniforms precision)
Full-precision (highp) is slower than (half-precision/mediump) but can be used to work around precision-related rendering errors.
Use:
'Default' to take the precision set by the project wide cvar r.Mobile.FloatPrecisionMode. It defaults to 0 (half precision)
'Full-precision for MaterialExpressions only' if you still want to keep half precision in.ush/.usf shaders (global shaders)
'Full-precision for every float' to force every float and uniform to full-precision
'Half-precision' to try to use half precision ALU and uniforms where appropriate
'Half-precision including shader parameters' same behaviour as 'Half-precision' but it also uses half precision for uniforms with custom parameters like PreshaderBuffer uniform
Value:
每个材质重载，用于变更像素着色器中的浮点精度（ALU和uniforms精度）
全精度（highp）比（半精度/mediump）慢，但可用于解决与精度相关的渲染错误。
使用：
“默认”以采用项目级cvar r.Mobile.FloatPrecisionMode设置的精度。默认为0（半精度）
如果仍想在.ush/.usf中保持半精度，则为“仅用于材质表达式的全精度”着色器（全局着色器）
“每个浮点的全精度”以强制每个浮点和uniform为全精度
“半精度”以尝试在适当的情况下使用半精度ALU和uniform
“包含着色器参数的半精度”与“半精度”行为相同，但它也对带自定义参数的uniform使用半精度，例如PreshaderBuffer uniform

如果操作无法应用（因为纹理类型不合适），或者在处理过程中遇到意外错误，则返回错误。

Key:
Returns a string describing the LCS difference between two strings, First and Second.
This function is editor only because it is expensive for large strings. Examples:

("A", "") -> "- [ 0001 |      ] A"
("", "") -> ""
("The quick brown fox", "The quick red fox") -> "~ [ 0001 | 0001 ]
                  The quick brown fox
                            ~~~~~
                  The quick red   fox"

The numbers between the [], separated by |, are the line numbers in the First and Second string at
which the difference occurs. Preceding the line number information is a symbol identifying the type
of difference: A tilde (~) indicates a modification, a minus (-) indicates a removal from First, and
a plus (+) indicates an addition to second.

@param First - The string to treat as basis
@param Second - The string to treat as change
@return the LCS difference between the First and Second string
Value:
返回一个字符串，描述两个字符串First和Second之间的LCS差异。
此函数仅适用于编辑器，因为它对于大型字符串而言开销较大。示例：

("A", "") -> "- [ 0001 |      ] A"
("", "") -> ""
("The quick brown fox", "The quick red fox") -> "~ [ 0001 | 0001 ]
                  The quick brown fox
                            ~~~~~
                  The quick red   fox"

[]之间的数字（以|分隔）是First和Second字符串中发生差异的行号。行号信息前面是一个标识差异类型的符号：
波浪号（~）表示修改，减号（-）表示从First中移除，
加号（+）表示添加到Second。

@param First - 要视为基础的字符串
@param Second - 要视为变更的字符串
@return 返回First和Second字符串之间的LCS差异

Returns Either the Particle Unique ID, The Particle ID Index, or the Particle ID Acquire Tag.

Particles.UniqueID is an Integer which simply increases for each particle that spawns. This is a useful way to sample a unique value for every particle in your individual emitter.

Particles.ID is a more complex combination of two integers. 

The Index is similar to the UniqueID above, an ever increasing ID integer. 

The Acquire Tag is roughly akin to the frame on which the particles were born.

Together, these two numbers can ensure particles have a unique ID across ALL the emitters in a given system, and are required for event communication between emitters. 

Particles.UniqueID is generated automatically, Particles.ID is only generated if the emitter properties checkbox is checked requiring persistent IDs, and is more costly.
Value:
返回粒子唯一ID、粒子ID索引或粒子ID获取标签。

Particles.UniqueID是一个整数，每生成一个粒子就递增一次，适合为单个发射器内的每个粒子取得唯一值。

Particles.ID是更复杂的双整数组合。

索引类似上述UniqueID，是持续递增的ID整数。

获取标签大致相当于粒子生成时所在的帧。

两者结合，可确保粒子在同一系统的所有发射器之间具有唯一ID，也是发射器间事件通信所必需的。

Particles.UniqueID自动生成；Particles.ID仅在发射器属性中勾选需要持久ID时生成，开销也更高。

Key:
Scripts are function graphs that define the runtime execution for a Niagara system (similar to a Blueprint).

There are three types of scripts:
1) Module: can be added as a standalone part to the emitter stack and encapsulates a single behavior, for example "Add Velocity"
2) Dynamic input: has a single output value and can be added to any input in the stack to compute such a value, for example "Random Vector"
3) Function: usually reserved for helper functions; can only be called from within modules or dynamic inputs
Value:
脚本是定义Niagara系统运行时执行的函数图（类似于蓝图）。

脚本分为三种类型：
1)模块：可以作为独立部分添加到发射器堆栈并封装单个行为，例如“添加速度”
2)动态输入：拥有单个输出值，可以添加到任何输入到堆栈中来计算这样的值，例如“随机向量”
3)函数：通常为辅助函数保留；只能从模块内部或动态输入调用

一个不同的点。这通常用于支持依赖于静态几何体和/或
光照的AR场景。

未锁定或不可移动（静态或静止）的内容将显示为移动状态。

Specifies the max world position offset of the material. Use this value to resolve issues with culling and self-occlusion caused by
World Position Offset, and/or to restrict how much offset is permitted (i.e. values are clamped on each axis).
NOTE: A value of 0.0 effectively means "no maximum", and will not clamp the offsets, however it will also not extend culling bounds.
Value:
指定材质的最大世界位置偏移。用此值来解决世界位置偏移造成的剔除和自遮挡问题，和/或限制允许的偏移量（即值被限制在每根轴上）。
注意：0.0值有效地代表“无最大值”，并且不会限制偏移，但它也不会扩展剔除边界。

Key:
Specifies the overal rendering/shading model for a material
@warning Check UMaterialInstance::Serialize if changed!
Value:
指定材质的整体渲染/着色模型
@warning：修改后须检查UMaterialInstance::Serialize！

Key:
Specifies the separate pass in which to render translucency.
This can be used to avoid artifacts caused by certain post processing effects.
Value:
指定要在其中渲染半透明度的单独通道。
这可以用来避免由某些后期处理效果造成的瑕疵。

Key: Specifies the type of property to reference together with ReferenceType, used for Enums, Structs, Objects and Classes.
Value: 指定与ReferenceType一起引用的属性类型，用于枚举、结构体、Object和类。

Key: Specifies the type of property to reference together with RefType, used for Enums, Structs, Objects and Classes.
Value: 指定与RefType一起引用的属性类型，用于枚举、结构体、Object和类。

Key: Specifies the type of the referenced property. The referenced property is bound using property binding in Scene State.
Value: 指定引用属性的类型。引用的属性已使用场景状态中的属性绑定进行绑定。

Key:
Specifies the version constraint that module providing the dependency must fulfill.
Example usages:
'1.2' requires the exact version 1.2 of the source script
'1.2+' requires at least version 1.2, but any higher version is also ok
'1.2-2.0' requires any version between 1.2 and 2.0
Value:
指定模块提供的版本约束，依赖性必须实现。
用例：
“1.2”需要确切的1.2版源脚本
“1.2+”需要至少1.2版，但任何更高版本也适用
“1.2-2.0”需要1.2到2.0之间的任何版本

Key: Specifies what should happen to the niagara system from before the section evaluates up until the first frame of the section.
Value: 指定片段往回计算到片段的第一帧时niagara系统将作何反应。

Key: Specifies what should happen to the niagara system when section is evaluating from the 2nd frame until the last frame.
Value: 指定片段从第二帧计算到最后一帧时niagara系统将作何反应。

Key: Specifies which material purbose to use when parsing USD material bindings, in addition to the "allPurpose" fallback.
Value: 指定除了“allPurpose”回退之外，在解析USD材质绑定时要使用的材质目的。

Key: Specifies which material purpose to use when parsing USD material bindings, in addition to the "allPurpose" fallback
Value: 指定除了“allPurpose”回退之外，在解析USD材质绑定时要使用哪个材质目的

Key: Specify 0 if no matter (cloud or participating media) can be found within the area, otherwise should be set > 0.
Value: 如果区域中未找到物质（云或参与媒介），则指定0，否则设为大于0。

Key: Specify a custom HLOD material to apply to the HLOD mesh. Specifying an HLOD Material Override will result in no texture being baked for the HLOD mesh.
Value: 指定要应用于HLOD网格体的自定义HLOD材质。指定HLOD材质重载将导致不会为HLOD网格体烘焙纹理。

Key: Specify a draw order for different materials in a spline. Smaller draw orders are drawn first, negative values are allowed.
Value: 指定样条中不同材质的绘制顺序。优先绘制较小绘制顺序，允许出现负数。

Key: Specify a user generated scene texture as output, overriding the default output implied by "Blendable Location", only used if domain is PostProcess
Value: 指定用户生成的场景纹理作为输出，重载“可混合位置”隐含的默认输出，仅在域为PostProcess时使用

Key: Specify an alternate material to use for a given LOD level (for example, to use a simpler material at a distance) This is not effective on Nanite landscape.
Value: 为给定LOD等级指定要使用的备用材质（例如，在远处使用更简单的材质）此设置对Nanite地形无效。

Key: Specify how Slate material shaders should be compiled to balance GPU performance and number of shaders. This can be overridden using per-platform configuration files.
Value: 指定如何编译Slate材质着色器，以平衡GPU性能和着色器数量。这可以使用逐平台配置文件进行覆盖。

Key: Specify the number of degrees between the curl noise vector and the velocity vector before the curl noise force is masked.
Value: 指定卷曲噪声向量与速度向量之间的角度阈值，达到该阈值时屏蔽卷曲噪声力。

Key:
Specify which RVT texture to read. 

If a User Parameter binding is required, create a parameter of type Object.
Value:
指定要读取的 RVT 纹理。

如果需要绑定用户参数，请创建 Object 类型的参数。

Key: SpecularProfile, for modulating specular appearance and simulating more complex visuals such as iridescence.
Value: SpecularProfile，用于调制高光度外观并模拟更复杂的视觉效果（如彩虹色）。

Key: Sprites will clip with the near camera plane if exactly aligned to it. This offset allows one to increase the distance slightly to avoid that issue.
Value: 精灵与近摄像机平面完全对齐时会发生裁剪。此偏移可略微增加距离以避免问题。

Key: Standard material property settings for tools that visualize materials on existing meshes (e.g. to help show UVs)
Value: 用于显示现有网格体材质的工具的标准材质属性设置（例如帮助显示UV）

Key: Start recording audio. By leaving the Submix To Record field blank, you can record the master output of the game.
Value: 开始录制音频。将“录制副路混合”域留空，便可录制游戏的主输出。

Key: Start spectrum analysis of the audio output. By leaving the Submix To Analyze blank, you can analyze the master output of the game.
Value: 开始音频输出的频谱分析。将“要分析的副路混合”留空，便可分析游戏的主输出。

Key: Static Friction value of surface, controls how easily things can slide on this surface (0 is frictionless, higher values increase the amount of friction)
Value: 表面的静态摩擦力值，控制物体在此表面上滑行的容易程度（0为完全无摩擦；值越高，摩擦力越强）

Key: Static switch pins reflect outdated enum entries. While the static switch is fully functional, a node refresh is advised.
Value: 静态开关引脚反映了过时的枚举条目。当静态开关功能完整时，建议刷新节点。

Key: Static variable is not set to a consistent value. Please ensure that all values are equal.  Parameter: {0}
Value: 静态变量未设为一致的值。请确保所有值都相等。参数：{0}

Key:
Stength of  the turbulence relative to the wind speed. 

At a value of 1.0 the turbulence is as strong as the wind.
Value:
相对于风速的湍流强度。

值为 1.0 时，湍流与风的强度相同。

Key: Stop adding child content to the parent row. This must be called no matter the result of BeginTableRowChildren()
Value: 停止向父行添加子内容。无论BeginTableRowChildren()的结果如何，都必须调用此项

Key: Stop recording audio. Path can be absolute, or relative (to the /Saved/BouncedWavFiles folder). By leaving the Submix To Record field blank, you can record the master output of the game.
Value: 停止录制音频。路径可为绝对或相对（相对于/Saved/BouncedWavFiles文件夹）。将“录制副路混合”域留空，便可录制游戏的主输出。

Key: Stop sending events if the particle is below a certain speed (based on the length of the velocity vector)
Value: 当粒子速率低于指定值时停止发送事件（根据速度向量的长度判断）。

Key: Stops all subtitles in a subtitle asset, regardless of whether they're already queued or if they have a delayed start.
Value: 停用字幕资产中的所有字幕，无论是否已加入队列或延迟开始。

Key: Stops capturing FPS charts only if StartHealthSnapshotChart has first been called. Does nothing if FPS charts are not running. HealthSnapshots captured after this is called will not include performance stats.
Value: 仅首先调用StartHealthSnapshotChart时停止捕捉FPS图表。若未运行FPS图表则无操作。调用此后捕捉的HealthSnapshots将不包括性能状态。

Key: Stops the caching process from where ever it is, can be started back up where it left off when needed.
Value: 从当前处暂停缓存进程，需要时可从中断处继续缓存。

Key:
Storage class containing actual runtime buffers to be used by the VM and the GPU.
Is not the actual source for any parameter data, rather just the final place it's gathered from various other places ready for execution.
Value:
包含VM和GPU要使用的实际运行时缓冲的保存类。
非参数数据的实际源，仅为从其他准备执行的不同区域中收集的最终区域。

Key:
Storage for nanite material override.
An override material can be selected, and the override material can be used according to the current settings.
We handle removing the override material and its dependencies from the cook on platforms where we can determine
that the override material can never be used.
Value:
存储纳米材质覆盖。
可以选择覆盖材质，并能根据当前设置使用覆盖材质。
将处理从平台的烘焙中移除覆盖材质及其依赖性，
以便确定覆盖材质永远不能被使用。

Key:
Storage for the set of variables that are represented by this ParameterStore.  Shouldn't be accessed directly, instead use
      ReadParameterVariables()
Value:
保存着此ParameterStore所代表的变量集。不要直接访问，
      而应使用ReadParameterVariables()访问

Key: Store the version of the Substrate's auto-conversion applied to this material if any (default, no conversion =-1).
Value: 存储应用于此材质的Substrate自动转换版本（如有）（默认，无转换 = -1）。

Key:
Stored flag to set whether we apply this override.
This is useful when evaluating an override along a hierachy of settings.
We default to true to always override.
Value:
存储编辑来设置我们是否应用此覆盖。
沿着设置的层级计算覆盖时，这非常有用。
默认为true，以始终覆盖。

Key: Stores duplicates of the MID's provided by the engine subsystem, allowing level actors to reference them.
Value: 存储引擎子系统提供的MID的副本，允许关卡Actor引用它们。

Key: Stores information about a function that this material references, used to know when the material needs to be recompiled.
Value: 保存此材质引用的函数信息，用于了解材质何时需要被重新编译。

Key: Stores information about a parameter collection that this material references, used to know when the material needs to be recompiled.
Value: 保存此材质引用的参数集合信息，用于了解材质何时需要被重新编译。

Key: Stores per-connection copies of a main actor list. Skips and removes elements from per connection list that are fully dormant
Value: 存储主Actor列表的每个连接副本。跳过并移除每个连接列表中完全休眠的元素

Key: Storing a value of how far the emitter has traveled over its life, and wrap it by a large number to prevent precision loss in cases where the emitter lives for an extended duration
Value: 存储发射器生命周期内移动的距离，并用大数包裹，以防发射器持续时间很长时精度损失。

Key: Strong ptr to the previously assigned material interface (used when Sequencer.UseSoftObjectPtrsForPreAnimatedMaterial is false)
Value: 到先前分配材质接口的强指针（在Sequencer.UseSoftObjectPtrsForPreAnimatedMaterial为false时使用）

Key: Struct containing all of the data necessary to look up a NiagaraScript's VM executable results from the Derived Data Cache.
Value: 包含在派生数据缓存中查找NiagaraScript VM可执行文件结果所需的全部必要数据的结构体。

Key: Struct containing usage information about a script. Things such as whether it reads attribute data, reads or writes events data etc.
Value: 包含脚本相关使用信息的结构体。此类信息包括如其是否读取属性数据，读取或写入事件数据等。

Key:
Struct type generated by the anim BP compiler. Used for sparse class data and mutable data area.
Only really needed to hide the struct from the content browser (via IsAsset override)
Value:
动画蓝图编译器生成的结构体类型。用于稀疏类数据和可变数据区域。
只需要在内容浏览器中隐藏结构体（通过IsAsset重载）

Key:
Struct used to define information for terminal types, e.g. types that can be contained
by a container. Currently can represent strong/weak references to a type (only UObjects),
a structure, or a primitive. Support for "Container of Containers" is done by wrapping
a structure, rather than implicitly defining names for containers.
Value:
用于定义终端类型（例如可被容器拥有的类型）信息的
结构体。当前可代表对一个类型（仅限UObjects）、一个结构或一个基元
的强/弱引用。通过包裹结构来实现对“容器的容器”的支持，
而非隐式地定义容器的命名。

Key: Structure linking a material expression input with a physical material. For use by UMaterialExpressionLandscapePhysicalMaterialOutput.
Value: 将材质表达式输入与物理材质链接的结构。由UMaterialExpressionLandscapePhysicalMaterialOutput使用。

Key: Structure linking a material expression input with a physical material. For use by UMaterialExpressionPhysicalMaterialOutput.
Value: 将材质表达式输入与物理材质链接起来的结构。供UMaterialExpressionPhysicalMaterialOutput使用。

Key:
Structure to enable shader environment defines per external code declaration.
E.g. the external code declaration for "ParticleColor" enables the define "NEEDS_PARTICLE_COLOR" when used in the pixel stage.
Value:
用于启用每个外部代码声明定义的着色器环境的结构。
例如在像素阶段使用时，外部代码声明“ParticleColor”启用了“NEEDS_PARTICLE_COLOR”定义。

Key:
Structure used to automatically convert blueprintcallable functions (that have blueprint parameter) calls (in bp graph)
into their never versions (with class param instead of blueprint).
Value: 用于自动将蓝图可调用的函数（其拥有蓝图参数）调用（在蓝图图表中）转换为其永不执行版本（拥有类参数，而非蓝图）。

Key:
Structured reference to the emitter/script/module that owns this issue.
EmitterName, ScriptName, and ModuleName may be NAME_None if the issue is above that level.
Value:
拥有此问题的发射器/脚本/模块的结构化引用。
如果问题出在该级别以上，EmitterName、ScriptName和ModuleName可能为NAME_None。

Key: SubsurfaceProfile, for Screen Space Subsurface Scattering. The profile needs to be set up on both the Substrate diffuse node, and the material node at the moment.
Value: 用于屏幕空间次表面散射的SubsurfaceProfile。此时需要同时在Substrate漫反射节点和材质节点上设置描述文件。

Key: Subtract subtracts the blend layer's color from the base layer. As the blend layer gets brighter, the base layer gets darker.
Value: 减法从基础层中减去混合层的颜色。随着混合层变亮，基础层变暗。

Key: Summons the Summary Editor that lets you define what inputs, renderers and properties (and more) should be displayed when looking at the Emitter Summary.
Value: 呼出摘要编辑器，以便定义在查看发射器摘要时应该显示哪些输入、渲染器和属性（以及更多内容）。

Key: Supply a bool that is true on the first frame and false on subsequent frames to properly initialize variables.
Value: 提供一个首帧为真、后续帧为假的布尔值，以正确初始化变量。

Key: Supply a matrix of your choosing to transform the grid's points from grid local space to world space.
Value: 提供自选矩阵，将网格点从网格局部空间变换到世界空间。

Key:
Supply a reference to a user variable that you will then later reference throughout the rest of your script.

This module will populate the variable with a list of appropriate rigid bodies.
Value:
提供用户变量引用，之后可在脚本其余部分引用。

模块会将适当刚体列表填充到该变量。

Key: Surface metallic value to transition from a dielectric to a conductor. (type = float, unit = unitless, defaults to 0.0)
Value: 从绝缘体过渡到导体的表面金属度值。（类型 = 浮点，单位 = 无单位，默认值为0.0）

Key:
Switch which asset the component is using.
This requires Niagara to wait for concurrent execution and the override parameter store to be synchronized with the new asset.
By default existing parameters are reset when we call SetAsset, modify bResetExistingOverrideParameters to leave existing parameter data as is.
Value:
切换组件正在使用哪个资产。
这要求Niagara等待并发执行，并要求重载参数存储与新资产同步。
当我们调用SetAsset时，现有参数会默认重置，修改bResetExistingOverrideParameters以保持现有参数数据不变。

Key:
System and Emitter Level Scalability
(Distance Culling, Frustum Culling, Spawn Count Scaling Setup)
Value:
系统与发射器级可扩展性
（距离剔除、视锥剔除、生成数量缩放设置）

Key: System Life Cycle - This can be passed to emitter scripts as an optimization as they now no longer have to manage their own life cycle and can share the system calculations.
Value: 系统生命周期可作为优化传入发射器脚本，使发射器无需管理自身生命周期并可共享系统计算。

Key:
System responsible for animating material parameter entities.

Visits any BoundMaterial with the supported parameter names and either a BlendChannelOutput component
or no BlendChannelInput, and applies the resulting parameter to the bound material instance.
Value:
负责对材质参数实体设置动画的系统。

访问拥有支持的参数名称和BlendChannelOutput组件
或无BlendChannelInput的任意BoundMaterial，并将结果参数应用于绑定的材质实例。

Key:
System responsible for tracking material parameter entities.

Tracks any BoundMaterial with a MaterialParameterInfo, as well as deprecated ScalarParameterName,
ColorParameterName or VectorParameterName.
Manages adding BlendChannelInputs and Outputs where multiple entities animate the same parameter
on the same bound material.
BoundMaterials may be a UMaterialInstanceDynamic, or a UMaterialParameterCollectionInstance.
Value:
系统负责追踪材质参数实体。

使用MaterialParameterInfo以及已弃用的ScalarParameterName、
ColorParameterName或VectorParameterName追踪任意BoundMaterial。
管理添加BlendChannelInputs和Outputs，其中多个实体在同一绑定材质上对同一参数设置动画。
BoundMaterials可以是一个UMaterialInstanceDynamic或UMaterialParameterCollectionInstance。

Key:
System that resolves MPC components into BoundMaterial components that can be used by downstream
parameter systems
Value: 将MPC组件解析为BoundMaterial组件的系统，可被下游参数系统使用

Key: Tags are sorted by asset sort order first, then individually. That means tags of asset with sort order [0] come before tags of asset with sort order [1].
Value: 标签首先按资产排序顺序来排序，然后单独排序。这意味着排序顺序为[0]的资产标签位于排序顺序为[1]的资产标签之前。

Key: Take a snapshot of the Material Designer Material with the current values and export it as a Texture asset with a resolution of {0} pixels.
Value: 使用当前值拍摄材质设计器材质的快照，并将其导出为分辨率为{0}像素的纹理资产。

Key: Take a snapshot of the Material Designer Material with the current values and export it as a Texture asset.
Value: 使用当前值拍摄材质设计器材质的快照，并将其作为纹理资产导出。

Key: Take a surface tangent as input. The tangent is considered tangent or world space according to the space properties on the main material node. (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to vertex tangent)
Value: 以表面切线作为输入。根据主材质节点的空间属性，将其视为切线空间或世界空间切线。（类型 = float3，单位 = 无量纲，默认值为顶点切线）

Key: Take the specified Queue, duplicate it and write it to disk in the ../Saved/MovieRenderPipeline/ folder. Returns the duplicated queue.
Value: 获取指定队列，复制并将其写入硬盘，位置：../Saved/MovieRenderPipeline/文件夹。返回重复的队列。

Key: Take the surface normal as input. The normal is considered tangent or world space according to the space properties on the main material node. (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to vertex normal)
Value: 以表面法线作为输入。根据主材质节点的空间属性，将其视为切线空间或世界空间法线。（类型 = float3，单位 = 无量纲，默认值为顶点法线）

Key: Take the tangent output node as input. The tangent is considered tangent or world space according to the space properties on the main material node. (type = float3, unit = unitless, defaults to vertex tangent)
Value: 将切线输出节点作为输入。根据主材质节点上的空间属性，切线将被视为切线空间或世界空间。（类型 = float3、单位 = 无单位、默认为顶点切线）

Key:
Takes a fully pathed string and eliminates relative pathing (eg: annihilates ".." with the adjacent directory).
Assumes all slashes have been converted to TEXT('/').
For example, takes the string:
      BaseDirectory/SomeDirectory/../SomeOtherDirectory/Filename.ext
and converts it to:
      BaseDirectory/SomeOtherDirectory/Filename.ext
Value:
获取完整的路径字符串并消除相对路径（如用相邻目录替换“..”）。
假设所有斜线都已转换为TEXT('/')。
举例而言，获取字符串：
      BaseDirectory/SomeDirectory/../SomeOtherDirectory/Filename.ext
并将其转换为：
      BaseDirectory/SomeOtherDirectory/Filename.ext

Key: Takes a screenshot of the game's viewport, from a particular camera actors POV.  Does not capture any UI.
Value: 从特定相机actor视点对游戏视口截图。不捕获UI。

Key: Takes a start position, end position, and a distance, and returns a 0-1 value between those two positions and the provided distance.
Value: 接收起点、终点与一个距离，返回该距离相对于两点间距离的0-1值。

Key: Takes a velocity vector and maintains its magnitude, while picking a random axis to align it to, with an optional time interval between updates (in seconds)
Value: 保持速度向量的大小，随机选取一个轴并将向量对齐到该轴。可设置更新之间的时间间隔，单位为秒。

Key:
Takes care of spawning UK2Node_AddComponent nodes. Acts as the "action"
portion of certain FBlueprintActionMenuItems. Evolved from
FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2AddComponent.
Value:
处理UK2Node_AddComponent节点的生成。用作特定FBlueprintActionMenuItems
的“操作”部分。由FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2AddComponent
进化而来。

Key:
Takes care of spawning variable getter/setter nodes. Serves as the "action"
portion for certain FBlueprintActionMenuItems. Evolved from
FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2Var, and can spawn nodes for both member-variables and
local function variables.
Value:
负责生成变量getter/setter节点。用作特定FBlueprintActionMenuItems的“操作”部分。从
FEdGraphSchemaAction_K2Var进化而来，可生成成员变量和
本地函数变量的节点。

Key:
Takes care of spawning various bound nodes. Acts as the
"action" portion of certain FBlueprintActionMenuItems.
Value:
负责生成诸多绑定节点。用作特定
FBlueprintActionMenuItems的“操作”部分。

Key:
Takes care of spawning various field related nodes (nodes associated with
functions, enums, structs, properties, etc.). Acts as the "action" portion
for certain FBlueprintActionMenuItems.

Key:
These data interfaces are populated via InvalidateAndEmptyDefaultDataInterfaces().  This helps avoid naming conflicts of the DataInterfaces stored within
CachedDefaultDataInterfaces.  When we are updating the compiled data we end up creating new DataInterfaces but we want to ensure that they are deterministically
named, and simply having the original DI become unreferenced leaves us in a state where a non-deterministic GC during the cook process could free the DI, but
is not guaranteed.  We resolve this by renaming our invalidated DI, thus creating room for the newly created DI to be named properly.  The last caveat is that
we have to be careful about when we rename the DI as the package containing the DI may get reloaded, which would recreate the DI (with the original name) leaving
us, once again, in a state where the named slot is taken.
Value:
这些数据接口通过InvalidateAndEmptyDefaultDataInterfaces()填充。这有助于避免存储在CachedDefaultDataInterfaces中的DataInterface发生命名冲突。更新编译数据时，我们最终会新建DataInterface，但我们希望确保它们的名称拥有确定性，
而如果原始DI被取消引用，则会导致烘焙过程中的非确定性GC释放DI，
但这并不能保证。我们通过重命名失效的DI来解决这个问题，从而为新创建的DI留出正确命名的空间。最后一个需要注意的是，
重命名DI时必须小心，因为包含此DI的包可能会被重新加载，这将重新创建DI（使用原始名称），
导致我们再次处于命名槽位被占用的状态。

Key:
This module will pack the particles into a Neighbor Grid using the simulation to unit transform. 

Simply put, particles positions will be transformed into a 3D grid's 0-1 space. If a particle falls into one of those grid's voxels, it's id will be stored. Other modules can then query the grid to effeciently find all of the nearest particle neighbors. 
 
Use: 
Enable simulation stages. 
Create an Emitter level Neighborgrid variable. 

Create a new particle iteration simulation stage. 

Add this module to the new stack and reference the previously created Neighbor Grid variable.
Value:
此模块使用模拟空间到单位空间的变换，将粒子填入邻居网格。

简单来说，粒子位置会转换到3D网格的0-1空间。若粒子落在某个体素内，其ID就会被存储。其他模块随后可查询网格，高效查找最近的所有粒子邻居。

用法：
启用模拟阶段。
创建发射器层级的邻居网格变量。

创建新的粒子迭代模拟阶段。

将此模块加入新堆栈，并引用之前创建的邻居网格变量。

Key:
This module will pack the particles into a Neighbor Grid using the simulation to unit transform. 

Simply put, particles positions will be transformed into a 3D grid's 0-1 space. If a particle falls into one of those grid's voxels, it's id will be stored. Other modules can then query the grid to effeciently find all of the nearest particle neighbors. 
 
Use: 
Enable simulation stages. 
Create an Emitter level Neighborgrid variable.

创建一个发射器级别的邻居网格变量。

Particles.CollisionRadius
Particles.Position

Key:
To reproduce a skeletal mesh with this module do the following: 

-Place this module in the particle update stack
 
-Place the "Initialize_MeshReproductionSprite" module in the particle spawn stack 

-Set the sprite's render alignment setting to custom alignment

-Set the facing mode to Custom 

-Set the custom facing vector mask to 1,1,1  

-Within your material, use "Niagara_MeshReproductionSpriteUVs" to sample the mesh's uvs 

If "Module.Overwrite Intrinsic Variables" is set to false make sure that this module's output variables are used to drive the particle's position, alignment, etc.

Note: this workflow will change as Niagara progresses.
Value:

- 将精灵渲染对齐设置设为自定义对齐。

- 将朝向模式设为自定义。

- 在材质中使用“Niagara_MeshReproductionSpriteUVs”采样网格体UV。

To rotate an object in 3D space we define a plane on which the rotation will take place. That can be done with two vectors. 

This vector defines rotation plane's Normal. The Y axis of the plane will be derived from the cross product of the X Axis vector and this Rotation Axis vector.

Key:

Toggles whether or not emitters within this system will try and compress their particle attributes.
      In some cases, this precision change can lead to perceivable differences, but memory costs and or performance (especially true for GPU emitters) can improve.

切换此系统中的发射器是否尝试压缩其粒子属性。
      在某些情况下，这种精度变化可能导致可察觉的差异，但是内存开销和/或性能（对GPU发射器而言尤其如此）可以提升。

Value: 切换此发射器中的粒子是否与发射器原点相关或是在全局空间中。

Key: Toggles whether or not the simulation is rerun to the current time when making changes while paused.
Value: 切换暂停时进行变更后模拟是否重新运行到当前时间。

It is still possible to tweak individual random to be deterministic or not. Transform a direction vector by the supplied transform - will not change its length.

Transform a position by the supplied transform.

Transform a rotator by the supplied transform.

将一个位置从世界转换到视图，但假设视图位置在原点。

从当前剪辑空间位置到最后一帧剪辑空间位置的变换。

Key:
Transient cache of dependent blueprints - i.e. blueprints that call
functions declared in this blueprint. Used to speed up compilation checks

This is intentionally marked 'duplicatetransient' so that it won't carry
over to a duplicated Blueprint object. However, the post-duplicate compile
path will not regenerate this set, since it is populated by each dependent
Blueprint's compile. In this case, a duplicated Blueprint equates to a
new Blueprint, so it won't initially have any dependents to include here.
Value:
依赖蓝图的临时缓存——
即调用了在此蓝图中声明函数的蓝图。用于加速编译检查。

这被刻意标记为“duplatetransient”，
这样它就不会传递到复制的蓝图Object。然而，
复制后的编译路径不会重新生成这个集合，
因为它由每个依赖蓝图的编译填充。在本例中，复制的蓝图相当于新蓝图，
所以它最初不会包含任何依赖性。

Key:
Transient flag that indicates whether or not the internal dependency
cache needs to be updated. This is not carried forward by duplication so
that the post-duplicate compile path is forced to reinitialize the cache.
Value:
临时标记，说明内部依赖性缓存是否需要更新。
这并非通过复制进行，
所以复制后的编译路径被强制重新初始化缓存。

使用模糊值避开最差情况，理想情况下应重新审视 FirstFrame。

Key:
UTextureAssetActionsBlueprintFns provides BluePrint exposure of the TextureAssetActions functions.

TextureAssetActions provide utilities to modify the UTexture Source data which is stored in the uasset after import.

They do not modify the original source bitmap files on disk.  Those are not used by UE after import unless a reimport is done.

Modifying the UTexture Source data is in contrast to the UTexture Properties, which affect how the runtime GPU is build.

For example the UTexture property "MaxTextureSize" or "StretchToPowerOfTwo" may resize to limit GPU texture size, or stretch the GPU output to power of 2,
but they do not modify the Source bitmap in the uasset.  To modify the source uasset, use TextureAssetActions::ResizeTextureSource and ResizeTextureSourceToPowerOfTwo.

After these functions modify the Texture Source, the changed asset may need to be saved to retain those changes.
Value:
UTextureAssetActionsBlueprintFns提供TextureAssetActions函数的蓝图公开。

它们不会修改磁盘上的原始源位图文件。在导入后，UE不会使用这些内容，除非执行重新导入。

修改UTexture源数据与修改UTexture属性不同，UTexture属性会影响运行时GPU的构建方式。

例如UTexture属性"MaxTextureSize" 或"StretchToPowerOfTwo" 可能会调整大小以限制GPU纹理大小，或者将GPU输出拉伸到2的次方，
但是它们不会修改uasset中的源位图。要修改源uasset，请使用TextureAssetActions::ResizeTextureSource和ResizeTextureSourceToPowerOfTwo。

在这些函数修改纹理源之后，可能需要保存已变更的资产以保留这些变更。
