Key: What changed in this version compared to the last? Displayed to the user when upgrading to a new script version.
Value: 此版本与上个版本相比有什么变化？在升级到新脚本版本时对用户显示。

Key:
What material to use as reference material when creating material instances from USD materials.
You can swap these with your own materials, but make sure that the replacement materials have parameters with
the same names and types as the ones provided by the default material, otherwise the instances will not have
the parameters filled with values extracted from the USD material when parsing.
Value:
从USD材质创建材质实例时，使用的参考材质。
可替换为自己的材质，但替代材质必须具有与默认材质
相同名称和类型的参数，否则解析USD材质时提取的数值
不会填入实例参数。

Key: What quality level to use when baking the simulation, where None means use the current quality level.
Value: 烘焙模拟时使用什么质量级别，“无”表示使用当前的质量级别。

Key: When  true, position, sprite alignment, sprite facing and sprite size will all be set align a sprite particle with the clip space bounding box. One must make sure that the sprite alignment and orientation vectors are set to custom for this to work correctly.
Value: 启用时设置位置、精灵对齐、朝向和大小，使精灵对齐裁剪空间包围盒；需将对齐和朝向设为自定义。

Key:
When > 0 this is the maximum number of attributes we will display that contain a NaN,
there could be more but the display will be truncated to this amount.  This is to reduce generating long strings.
Value:
当大于0时，这是我们将显示的包含NaN的属性的最大数量，
可能有更多，但显示将被截断到这个量。这用于减少生成长字符串。

Key:
When a simulation moves greater or equal to the number of tiles specified in fx.LWCTileRecache the simulation will be reset.
This means all particles are cleared and we start the system from time 0 again.
Value:
当模拟移动的瓦片数量大于或等于fx.LWCTileRecache中指定的瓦片数量时，模拟将被重设。
这意味着所有粒子都将被清除，我们将从时间0重新启动系统。

Key:
When a simulation moves greater or equal to the number of tiles specified in fx.LWCTileRecache we will trigger a rebase.
A rebase will move all Position type attributes by the difference in tiles.
This is not guaranteed to cover everything, such as data inteface, matrix attributes, etc, and is therefore could result in simulation errors.
Value:
当模拟移动的瓦片数量大于或等于fx.LWCTileRecache中指定的瓦片数量时，我们将触发重放置。
重放置会将所有位置类型的属性移动瓦片数量的差值。
这不能保证涵盖所有内容，例如数据接口、矩阵属性等，因此可能会导致模拟错误。

Key: When a structural material change is made, whether to automatically recompile the preview material to show this change.
Value: 当结构材质发生变化时，是否自动重新编译预览材质以显示此变更。

Key: When adding arguments to the node, their names are placed here and are generated as pins during construction
Value: 将参数添加到节点时，参数命名将被放置于此并在构造时生成为引脚

Key:
When an actor is bound as the object we will also search for a component of this type to bind properties to.
For example, setting this to a UPointLightComponent when binding properties we will first look at the actor
then look for a component of UPointLightComponent and look at properties on that also.
If no class is specified here we look at the RootComponent instead.
Value:
当一个Actor被绑定为Object时，我们还会搜索这个类型的组件来绑定属性。
举例而言，绑定属性时，将此设为UPointLightComponent，我们将首先查看Actor，
然后查找UPointLightComponent的组件，并查看其上方的属性。
如果这里没有指定类，我们将转而查看RootComponent。

Key: When an emitter is in localspace, the entire coordinate system rotates with the actor transform. This option undoes that rotation and allows a worldspace quaternion to drive the rotation on its own.
Value: 发射器处于局部空间时，整个坐标系会随 Actor 变换旋转。此选项撤销该旋转，使世界空间四元数独立驱动旋转。

Key:
When an instance of this effect is retriggered (because more than one instance is not allowed)
should the particle system be explicitly reset? Activate(bReset = true);
Value:
当此效果的一个实例被重新触发时（因为不允许有多个实例），
粒子系统是否应该被显式重设？激活(bReset = true);

Key:
When automatically deriving the frame range of the SubUV Animation, a renderer must be specified as the SubUV XY dimensions are defined there. 

This allows the user to choose whether the module will look at sprite renderers or mesh renderers for this information.
Value: 自动推导子 UV 动画帧范围时必须指定渲染器；此选项决定从精灵还是网格体渲染器读取 XY 尺寸。

Key: When blending is not enabled, offset by a fractional frame to end on a non blended end frame when clamping
Value: 未启用混合时，偏移一个小数帧，以便钳制时停在未混合的结束帧上。

Key:
When both Play and Rewind booleans are enabled, the Rewind Boolean has no effect

------

When both Play and Rewind booleans are enabled, the Rewind Boolean takes over and begins to rewind the timeline

------

When both Play and Rewind booleans are enabled, pause the timeline
Value: 播放和倒带同时启用时：第一种状态倒带无效；第二种状态倒带接管并倒放时间轴；第三种状态暂停时间轴。

Key: When both Play and Rewind booleans are enabled, the Rewind Boolean takes over and begins to rewind the timeline
Value: 同时启用“播放”和“倒带”布尔值时，“倒带”优先，并开始倒放时间轴。

Key: When caching to SVT a voxel needs to be empty to be discarded. If density is less than this threshold we assume it is empty and force it to zero. This allows for better savings when going to the sparse format.
Value: 缓存到 SVT 时体素必须为空才能丢弃。密度低于此阈值时视为空并强制设为零，以便转换为稀疏格式时节省更多空间。

Key: When changing data channel types we cache the old channel and attempt to copy over any common properties from one to the other.
Value: 当变更数据通道类型时，我们缓存旧通道，并尝试将任何公共属性从一个通道拷贝到另一个。

Key: When checked, the particles will ignore the physical material properties of the underlying surface and only use their friction and restitution settings.
Value: 勾选后，粒子忽略底层表面的物理材质属性，仅使用自身的摩擦力和恢复系数设置。

Key: When checked, will treat 'ParticleMesh' as the first frame of the flipbook, and will use the other mesh flipbook options to find the other frames
Value: 勾选后，会将“ParticleMesh”视为图像序列视图的第一帧，并将使用其他网格体图像序列视图选项来查找其他帧

Key: When checked, will treat the alpha value of the particle's color as a multiplier of the light's brightness.
Value: 勾选后，会将粒子颜色的透明度值视为光源亮度的乘数。

Key: When clearing the light func, e.g. because the light is made static, this field remembers the last value
Value: 当清除光照函数时，举例而言，因为光源为静态，此域将记住最后的值

Key: When comparing the two colors, the difference needs to be less than this parameter for the condition to be true.
Value: 比较两种颜色时，其差异必须小于此参数，条件才为真。

Key: When cutting material boundaries, tolerance distance at which to snap material boundary to existing geometry rather than cutting the mesh
Value: 切割材质边界时，将材质边界对齐到现有几何体而非切割网格体的容差距离

Key: When dealing with blueprint classes, you might want to filter for a base class which can't be picked by asset registry if you derive from a blueprint class
Value: 在处理蓝图类时，如果从蓝图类派生，你可能需要过滤资产注册表无法选择的基类

Key: When deriving the current particle radius we need to know the mesh's local bounds and it's current scale.
Value: 计算粒子当前半径时，需要知道网格体的局部包围盒及其当前缩放。

Key: When disabled the mesh batches do not contribute to the hit proxy, i.e. they are not part of editor selection.
Value: 禁用时，网格体批次不会对命中代理做出贡献，即它们不是编辑器选择的一部分。

Key:
When disabled the renderer will not cast shadows.
The component controls if shadows are enabled, this flag allows you to disable the renderer casting shadows.
Value:
禁用后，此渲染器不投射阴影。
组件控制是否启用阴影，此标志允许单独禁用渲染器的阴影投射。

Key:
When disabled we will generate a RandomSeed per instance on reset which is not deterministic.
When enabled we will always use the RandomSeed from the system plus the components RandomSeedOffset, this allows for determinism but variance between components.
Value:
当禁用时，我们将在重设时为每个实例生成一个RandomSeed，这是不确定的。
当启用时，我们总是使用来自系统的RandomSeed和组件RandomSeedOffset，这允许确定性，但组件之间存在差异。

Key: When disabled, nothing will be drawn in the viewport. This is useful when you only want to use things like single frame stepping or data validation.
Value: 禁用时，视口中不会绘制任何内容。当你只想使用单帧步进或数据验证等功能时，这将非常实用。

Key: When dropping a texture in the viewport, create an instance of this material instead of creating a new material. Populate MaterialParamsForDroppedTextures to specify the parameter names.
Value: 将纹理放入视口中时，创建该材质的一个实例，而非新建材质。填充MaterialParamsForDroppedTextures以指定参数名称。

Key: When dropping a texture in the viewport, determines which material parameter to assign for each found texture type. Only relevant if MaterialForDroppedTextures is assigned.
Value: 在视口中放入一个纹理时，确定要为每个找到的纹理类型指定的材质参数。MaterialForDroppedTextures被指定时才相关。

Key: When editing instances, we must track which parameters are overridden so we can pull in any changes to the default.
Value: 编辑实例时，必须追踪被覆盖的参数，以便拉入对默认值的变更。

Key: When enable constant values are baked into the scripts while editing the system, this will increase iteration times but improve performance.
Value: 启用后，编辑系统时常量值将烘焙到脚本中，这将增加迭代次数，但提升性能。

Key:
When enabled (default), AcquireTag is tracked through the counting sort for compaction-safe
neighbor lookups via GetPositionByID. The emitter must have Persistent IDs enabled.
When disabled, AcquireTag buffers are not allocated and GetParticleNeighbor returns 0 for
AcquireTag. Only disable if you know compaction will not reorder particles.
Value:
启用时（默认设置），AcquireTag会通过计数排序进行追踪，以便通过GetPositionByID实现
紧凑安全的邻居查找。发射器必须启用 “持久ID”。
禁用时，AcquireTag缓冲不会被分配，GetParticleNeighbor为
AcquireTag返回0。仅在你知道紧凑不会对粒子进行重新排序时才禁用。

Key:
When enabled all Niagara systems that pass the filter will have the particle data buffers validation.
i.e. we will look for NaN or other invalidate data  inside it
Note: This will have an impact on performance.
Value:
启用后，所有通过过滤器的Niagara系统都将验证粒子数据缓冲。
即我们将在其中查找NaN或其他无效数据
注意：这将对性能产生影响。

Key:
When enabled all Niagara systems that pass the filter will have the simulation data buffers validation.
i.e. we will look for NaN or other invalidate data  inside it
Note: This will have an impact on performance.
Value:
启用后，所有通过过滤器的Niagara系统都将验证模拟数据缓冲。
即我们将在其中查找NaN或其他无效数据
注意：这将对性能产生影响。

Key:
When enabled all support types for interpolation will be included, this set may increase in future releases.
When disabled we only interpolate Position / Quat attributes.
Value:
启用时，将包含所有支持的插值类型，未来版本可能增加此集合。
禁用时，我们仅对位置/四元数属性进行插值。

Key:
When enabled all validation errors will be sent to the log as warnings.
This can be useful to try and narrow down the exact source of an invalid value in the data buffers as often
they will cascade from the first frame where one is generated into other attributes in the subsequent frames.
Value:
启用后，所有验证错误都将作为警告发送到日志。
这适用于尝试缩小数据缓冲中无效值的确切来源，
因为它们通常会从生成无效值的第一帧级联到后续帧中的其他属性。

Key:
When enabled allows the SimCache to be re-based.
i.e. World space emitters can be moved to the new component's location
Value:
当启用时，允许SimCache重设基准。
即世界空间发射器可以移动到新组件的位置

Key: When enabled and profiling is active choose how we compile the system.  Edit mode is worse performance but won't recompile when tweaking parameters.
Value: 启用并激活分析功能后，选择我们如何编译系统。编辑模式性能较差，但在调整参数时不会重新编译。

Key: When enabled cutouts for SubUVs will generated like there is a single frame rather than atlasing the texture.
Value: 启用后，SubUV的切口将生成，就像有一个单帧，而不是图集化纹理。

Key:
When enabled Data Interface data will be stored in the SimCache.
This can result in a large increase to the cache size, depending on what Data Interfaces are used
Value:
启用后，数据接口数据将保存在SimCache中。
这可能会导致缓存大小的大幅增加，这取决于使用的是什么数据接口

Key:
When enabled GPU particle data will be copied from the GPU to the CPU.
Warning: This has an impact on performance & memory since we copy the whole buffer.
The displayed data is latent since we are seeing what happened a few frames ago.
Value:
启用后，将把GPU粒子数据从GPU拷贝到CPU。
警告：由于我们拷贝了整个缓冲，这对性能和内存有影响。
显示的为潜在数据，因此我们看到的是几帧之前的情况。

Key: When enabled if all emitters don't require script execution and the system script is empty / constant we can invoke a faster CPU path.
Value: 启用后，如果所有发射器不需要执行脚本并且系统脚本为空/常量，我们可以调用更快的CPU路径。

Key: When enabled overrides the format used to store data inside the grid, otherwise uses the project default setting.  Lower bit depth formats will save memory and performance at the cost of precision.
Value: 启用后，将重载用于在网格内存储数据的格式，否则使用项目默认设置。比特位深度较低的格式将以精度为代价降低内存和性能的开销。

Key:
When enabled particle attributes will display with the system information
rather than in world at the particle location. Only enabled if system is set up to display information as well.
Value:
启用后，粒子属性将与系统信息一起显示，
而不是在粒子位置的世界中显示。仅当系统设为显示信息时才启用。

Key: When enabled shows a live preview of what will be rendered, this may not be accurate with all visualization modes.
Value: 启用后，将显示渲染内容的实时预览，但这在所有可视化模式中可能并不准确。

Key:
When enabled texture parameters (size / etc) are taken from the user provided render target.
If no valid user parameter is set the system will be invalid.
Note: The resource will be recreated if UAV access is not available, which will reset the contents.
Value:
启用后，纹理参数（大小等）将取自用户提供的渲染目标。
如果没有设置有效的用户参数，系统将无效。
注意：如果UAV访问不可用，将重新创建资源，这将重置内容。

Key: When enabled the capture will time out if we reach the defined number of frames without anything new to capture.
Value: 启用后，如果达到定义的帧数而没有任何新内容可捕获，则捕获将超时。

Key:
When enabled the emitter will always include UniqueID in the output attributes.
You should not need to modify this with the exception of debugging / testing and as it will impact cooked performance and memory
Value:
启用后，发射器将始终在输出属性中包含UniqueID。
除了调试/测试之外，你不需要修改它，因为它会影响烘焙的性能和内存

Key:
When enabled the emitter will output all available attributes.
You should not need to modify this with the exception of debugging / testing and as it will impact cooked performance and memory
Value:
启用后，发射器将输出所有可用属性。
除了调试/测试之外，你不需要修改它，因为它会影响烘焙的性能和内存

Key:
When enabled the particle index will be displayed along with any attributes.
Note: This is the index in the particle data buffer and not the persistent ID index.
Value:
启用时，粒子索引将与任何属性一起显示。
注意：这是粒子数据缓冲中的索引，而不是持久ID索引。

Key: When enabled the ribbons normals will follow the shape of the geometry rather than being aligned to screen / custom facing.
Value: 启用后，条带法线将遵循几何体的形状，而并非与屏幕/自定义面对齐。

Key: When enabled the ribbons renderer will not override how backface culling works depending on shape type, but instad use the material culling mode
Value: 启用后，带状渲染器不会根据形状类型重载背面剔除的工作方式，而是使用材质剔除模式

Key: When enabled the scene capture component will be automatically moved to the location of the NiagaraComponent with an optional offset.
Value: 启用后，场景捕获组件将自动移动到NiagaraComponent的位置，并带有可选偏移。

Key:
When enabled the static mesh data interface is allowed to sample from the distance field data (if present) on the GPU.
Enabling this feature will move all systems that contain static mesh samples into PostRenderOpaque tick group regardless of the features used.
Changing this setting requires restarting the editor.
Value:
启用后，允许静态网格体数据接口在GPU上从距离场数据（如果存在）进行取样。
启用此功能后，无论使用了哪些功能，包含静态网格体样本的所有系统都将移入PostRenderOpaque tick组。
变更此设置需要重新启动编辑器。

Key: When enabled the the list of compatible nodes will be shown when a connection is attempted between incompatible pins
Value: 启用后，当尝试在不兼容的引脚之间建立连接时，将显示兼容节点列表。

Key:
When enabled this is the default value set on the component.
Adjusts the translucent object sorting priority, see PrimitiveComponent description for more details.
Value:
启用时这是组件上设置的默认值。
要调整半透明Object的排序优先级，参见PrimitiveComponent描述了解更多细节。

Key:
When enabled this is the default value set on the component.
Modifies the sort distance for translucent objects, see PrimitiveComponent description for more details.
Value:
启用时这是组件上设置的默认值。
要修改半透明Object的排序距离，参见PrimitiveComponent描述了解更多细节。

Key:
When enabled this is the default value set on the component.
Optionally write this 0-255 value to the stencil buffer in CustomDepth pass (Requires project setting or r.CustomDepth == 3)
Value:
启用时，这是在组件上设置的默认值。
选择性地将这个0-255的值写入CustomDepth通道中的模板缓冲（需要项目设置或r.CustomDepth == 3）

Key:
When enabled this is the default value set on the component.
This primitive has bRenderCustomDepth enabled.
Value:
启用时，这是在组件上设置的默认值。
这个图元启用了bRenderCustomDepth。

Key:
When enabled this is the default value set on the component.
Whether the primitive receives decals.
Value:
启用时，这是在组件上设置的默认值。
图元是否接收到贴花。

Key:
When enabled we allow the cache to be generated for extrapolation.
This will force the velocity attribute to be maintained.
Value:
当启用时，我们允许生成用于外插值的缓存。
这将强制维持速度属性。

Key:
When enabled we allow the cache to be generated for interpolation.
This will increase the memory usage for the cache slightly but can allow you to reduce the capture rate.
Value:
当启用时，我们允许为插值生成缓存。
这将略微增加缓存的内存使用，但允许你降低捕获率。

Key: When enabled we capture NumFrames number of frames, otherwise the capture will continue until cancelled or the simulation is complete.
Value: 启用后，我们捕获NumFrames帧数，否则捕获将继续，直到取消或模拟完成。

Key:
When enabled we force the dispatch to be linear (i.e. one dimension is used).
NOTE: Cannot be used with OverrideGpuDispatchType.
Value:
启用后，强制调度为线性（即使用一维）。
注意：不能与OverrideGpuDispatchType一起使用。

Key:
When enabled we iterate over the subset of particles that satisfy the binding & range selected.
For example, if the binding was set to Particles.MyStateIndex and the range was 1-3 only the particles
with values of 1, 2 or 3 for Particles.MyStateIndex would run the script, all others would be ignored.
Value:
当启用时，我们在满足选定绑定和范围的粒子子集上迭代。
举例而言，如果绑定被设为Particles.MyStateIndex和范围是1-3，只有粒子的值为1，
Particles.MyStateIndex为2或3将运行此脚本，所有其他将被忽略。

Key:
When enabled we use the owner actor's velocity for the first frame.
If we do not have an owner actor, or this is disable then the first frame's velocity will be zero.
Value:
启用后，我们使用拥有者Actor的速度作为第一帧。
如果我们没有拥有者Actor，或者这是禁用的，那么第一帧的速度将为零。

Key: When enabled we will append to the existing simulation cache rather than destroying the existing contents.
Value: 启用后，我们将附加到现有的模拟缓存，而不是销毁现有内容。

Key:
When enabled we will attempt to export the materials used with each section
When disabled no materials will be assigned, so the default material will be used
Value:
启用后，我们将尝试导出每个部分使用的材质
禁用后，将不分配任何材质，因此将使用默认材质

Key:
When enabled we will capture all the requested frames immediatly.
This will capture the simulation outside of the main work tick, i.e. if you request a 10 frame capture we will loop capturing 10 frames on the capture call rather than over 10 world ticks.
Value:
启用后，我们将立即捕获所有请求的帧。
这将捕获主要工作tick之外的模拟，即如果请求10帧捕获，我们将在捕获调用上循环捕获10帧，而不是超过10次世界tick。

Key:
When enabled we will read deformed geometry if available, i.e. data from the deformed graph / skin cache
When disable we will only read from the default vertex data which does not include morph targets, skin, etc.
Changing this setting requires restarting the editor.
Note: Enabling this does add additional branches to the skel mesh data reading.
Value:
启用时，我们将读取变形的几何体（如可用），即来自变形图/蒙皮缓存的数据。
禁用时，我们将仅读取默认顶点数据，其中不包括变形目标、皮肤等。
变更此设置需要重新启动编辑器。
注意：启用此项确实会向骨骼网格体数据读取添加额外的分支。

Key:
When enabled we will read update the sockets transforms each frame.
This is not required in all cases as the sockets might not be able to move.
Value:
启用后，我们将读取更新每个帧的插槽变换。
并非在所有情况下都需要这样做，因为插槽可能无法移动。

Key: When enabled we will update at the simulation frame rate.  I.e. only ever tick once per frame even if the application frame rate is lower, this will result in the sim slowing down.
Value: 启用后，我们将以模拟帧率进行更新。即即使应用程序帧率较低，每帧也只tick一次，这将导致sim速度减慢。

Key:
When enabled you can restrict the LOD range we consider for LOD calculation.
This can be useful to reduce the performance impact, as it reduces the number of draw calls required.
Value:
启用后，你可以限制我们考虑用于LOD计算的LOD范围。
这适用于降低性能影响，因为它减少了所需的绘制调用数量。

Key: When enabled, if a blueprint has compiler errors, then the graph will jump and focus on the first node generating an error
Value: 启用后，如蓝图拥有编辑器错误，图表将跳至并聚焦于生成错误的首个节点

Key: When enabled, Max Effect Type Instances is scaled down by the global budget use based on this curve. Allows us to cull more aggressively when performance is poor.
Value: 启用后，最大效果类型实例将基于此曲线按全局预算使用进行缩放。允许我们在性能较差时更积极地进行剔除。

Key: When enabled, Max System Instances is scaled down by the global budget use based on this curve. Allows us to cull more aggressively when performance is poor.
Value: 启用后，最大系统实例将基于此曲线按全局预算使用进行缩放。允许我们在性能较差时更积极地进行剔除。

Key: When enabled, MaxDistance is scaled down by the global budget use based on this curve. Allows us to cull more aggressively when performance is poor.
Value: 启用后，MaxDistance将基于此曲线按全局预算使用进行缩放。允许我们在性能较差时更积极地进行剔除。

Key: When enabled, the Material and X Range for this generation are sourced automatically from the connected Trunk Texture Setup pin, matched by generation index.
Value: 启用后，当前世代的材质和X范围将自动从连接的“主干纹理设置”引脚获取，并按世代索引进行匹配。

Key:
When enabled, the maximum number of particles to show information about.
When disabled all particles will show attributes, this can result in poor performance & potential OOM on some platforms.
Value:
启用时，显示有关信息的粒子的最大数量。
禁用时，所有粒子都将显示属性，这可能导致性能不佳，且某些平台上可能出现OOM。

Key: When enabled, UI material parameters (Skin, Eyes, Makeup, Teeth & Eyelashes) and source textures are applied on top of the override materials. When disabled, override materials are used as-is.
Value: 启用后，UI材质参数（皮肤、眼睛、化妆、牙齿和睫毛）和源纹理将应用在重载材质之上。禁用时，重载材质将按原样使用。

Key:
When enabled, we follow the settings on the UNiagaraComponent for tick order. When this option is disabled, we ignore any dependencies from data interfaces or other variables and instead fire off the simulation as early in the frame as possible. This greatly
      reduces overhead and allows the game thread to run faster, but comes at a tradeoff if the dependencies might leave gaps or other visual artifacts.
Value:
启用后，我们将按照UNiagaraComponent上的设置按序tick。禁用此选项后，我们将忽略来自数据接口或其他变量的任何依赖性，而是尽早在框架中启动模拟。这样可以大大降低开销，
      让游戏线程更快地运行，但如果依赖性可能留下空白或其他视觉瑕疵，则需要权衡取舍。

Key: When enabled, whole quads are filled by the material without automatically stenciling the text - this needs to be done within the material (using Font Signed Distance node).
Value: 启用后，整个四边形将由材质填充，而不会自动模板化文本——这需要在材质内完成（使用Font Signed Distance节点）。

Key: When enabled, will only allow sampling/spawning from another emitter particle if that particle's age is greater than the value here.
Value: 启用时，仅当另一个发射器粒子的年龄大于此处的值，才允许从该粒子采样／生成。

Key: When enabled, will only allow sampling/spawning from another emitter particle if that particle's age is less than the value here.
Value: 启用时，仅当另一个发射器粒子的年龄小于此处的值，才允许从该粒子采样／生成。

Key: When FacingMode is FacingCameraDistanceBlend, the distance at which the sprite is fully facing the camera plane.
Value: FacingMode为FacingCameraDistanceBlend时，sprite完全朝向摄像机平面的距离

Key: When FacingMode is FacingCameraDistanceBlend, the distance at which the sprite is fully facing the camera position
Value: FacingMode为FacingCameraDistanceBlend时，sprite完全朝向摄像机位置的距离

Key:
When fading via percentage, this value will represent the minimal reduction in value over the span of 1 second. 

This helps avoid an issue with which the target value can never be reached
Value:
按百分比淡出时，此值表示 1 秒内数值的最小减少量。

有助于避免目标值永远无法达到。

Key: When generating pre-bound "Add Component" actions, any selected assets that are not yet loaded will be synchronously loaded as part of building the Blueprint Graph context menu. Enabling this option will ensure that all pre-bound actions for all selected assets are included in the menu, but load times may also affect editor UI responsiveness while the context menu is building.
Value: 当生成预绑定的“添加组件”操作时，任何尚未加载的选定资产将作为构建蓝图图上下文菜单的一部分同步加载。启用此选项将确保所有选定资产的所有预绑定操作都包含在菜单中，但是在构建上下文菜单时，加载时间也可能影响编辑器UI的响应性。

Key: When greater than 0 sets the maximum number of elements the array can hold, only relevant when using operations that modify the array size.
Value: 大于0时，设置数组可以容纳的最大元素数量，仅在使用修改数组大小的操作时才有相关性。

Key: When in CVar mode, the CVar condition to replace this device profile entry with when the profile entry is in the Disabled state.
Value: 在CVar模式下，当描述文件条目处于禁用状态时，替换此设备描述文件条目的CVar条件。

Key: When in CVar mode, the CVar condition to replace this device profile entry with when the profile entry is in the Enabled state.
Value: 在CVar模式下，当描述文件条目处于启用状态时，替换此设备描述文件条目的CVar条件。

Key:
When pixel coverage is enabled this allows you to control the blend of the pixel coverage color adjustment.
i.e. 1.0 = full, 0.5 = 50/50 blend, 0.0 = none
Value:
当像素覆盖启用时，这允许你控制像素覆盖颜色调整的混合。
即1.0 = 完全，0.5 = 50/50混合，0.0 = 无

Key: When querying values in the grid we can use Linear or Cubic interpolation to find it. Cubic is more expensive but more accurate and therefore retains more detail.
Value: 查询网格值时可使用线性或三次插值。三次插值开销更大但更准确，能保留更多细节。

Key: When rewinding is true, instantly sets the time value to Timeline Beginning. If Timeline Beginning is unset, will set the time to 0.
Value: 倒带为真时，立即将时间值设为时间轴起点；如果未设置时间轴起点，则设为 0。

Key: When set to true it will generate MaterialInstanceDynamic for each components, so material can be changed at runtime
Value: 设为true后，将为每个组件生成MaterialInstanceDynamic，因此可在运行时修改材质

Key:
When set we capture the batches from the view index provided
When unset we capture batches from all views
Value:
设置后，我们从提供的视图索引中捕获批次
取消设置后，我们从所有视图中捕获批次。

Key: When set we will use the override from NaniteOverrideMaterial. Otherwise we inherit any override on the parent.
Value: 设置时我们将使用来自NaniteOverrideMaterial的覆盖。否则我们将继承父项上的任何覆盖。

Key: When set, the event generator will stop sending events when the particle velocity (the length of the velocity vector) is below this threshold.
Value: 设置后，当粒子速度（速度向量长度）低于此阈值时，事件生成器将停止发送事件。

Key: When stamping fluids_source_density particle attribute into the grid's Density attribute, apply this multiplier to the value.
Value: 将粒子属性 fluids_source_density 写入网格的 Density 属性时，对该值应用此倍率。

Key: When stamping fluids_source_temperature particle attribute into the grid's Density attribute, apply this multiplier to the value.
Value: 将粒子属性 fluids_source_temperature 写入网格 Density 属性时，对该值应用此倍率。

Key: When stamping fluids_source_temperature particle attribute into the grid's Temperature attribute, apply this multiplier to the value.
Value: 将粒子属性 fluids_source_temperature 写入网格 Temperature 属性时，对该值应用此倍率。

Key: When stamping fluids_source_velocity particle attribute into the grid's velocity attribute, apply this multiplier to the value.
Value: 将粒子属性 fluids_source_velocity 写入网格 Velocity 属性时，对该值应用此倍率。

Key: When stamping fluids_source_velocity particle attribute into the grid's Velocity attribute, apply this multiplier to the vector.
Value: 将粒子属性 fluids_source_velocity 写入网格 Velocity 属性时，对该向量应用此倍率。

Key: When stamping particles into the grid this determines if the particle data should be added to the existing source data or replace it if greater.
Value: 将粒子写入网格时，确定粒子数据应添加到现有源数据，还是仅在更大时替换源数据。

Key: When stamping volume textures into the grid this determines if the particle data should be added to the existing source data or replace it if greater.
Value: 将体积纹理写入网格时，确定粒子数据应添加到现有源数据，还是仅在更大时替换源数据。

Key: When the Blueprint graph context menu is invoked (e.g. by right-clicking in the graph or dragging off a pin), do not block the UI while populating the available actions list.
Value: 当蓝图图上下文菜单被调用时（例如通过右键点击图或从引脚连出引线），在填充可用操作列表时不要阻塞UI。

Key: When the cache section is stretched in the track it will dilate the input time so the cached data is stretched once over the full section
Value: 当缓存部分在轨道中拉伸时，它会扩大输入时间，因此缓存数据在整个部分上拉伸一次

Key: When the class generated by this blueprint is loaded, it will be recompiled the first time.  After that initial recompile, subsequent loads will skip the regeneration step
Value: 加载此类生成的蓝图时，其将首次被重新编译。完成首次重编译后，随后的加载讲过跳过重生成步骤

Key: When the decal is smaller than this screen size fade out the decal, can be used to reduce the amount of small decals drawn.
Value: 当贴花小于此屏幕尺寸淡出贴花时，可用于减少小贴花的绘制量。

Key:
When the engine scalability value matches this setting the Override parameters will be applied. Otherwise the Default Settings are used.
This is especially useful for MRQ as it automatically switches to Cinematic scalability when it runs.
Value: 引擎可扩展性值匹配此设置时应用覆盖参数，否则使用默认设置；对 MRQ 尤其有用。

Key: When the preview material is recompiled, whether to automatically also apply those changes to the source material.
Value: 重新编译预览材质时，是否自动将这些变更应用于源材质。

Key:
When the time before the section evaluates the particle system's component will be deactivated and on the first frame of the section the
       system's component will be activated.
Value:
计算片段之前的时间时，粒子系统的组件将被停用；在片段的第一帧上，
       系统的组件将被停用。

Key: When the VisualizeCalibrationColor show flag is enabled, this path will be used as the post-process material to render. The post-process material's Blendable Location property must be set to "After Tonemapping" for proper calibration display.
Value: VisualizeCalibrationColor显示标记被启用时，该路径将被用作渲染的后期处理材质。后期处理材质的可混合位置属性必须设为“色调映射后”进行正确的校准显示。

Key: When the VisualizeCalibrationCustom show flag is enabled, this path will be used as the post-process material to render. The post-process material's Blendable Location property must be set to "After Tonemapping" for proper calibration display.
Value: VisualizeCalibrationCustom显示标记被启用时，该路径将被用作渲染的后期处理材质。后期处理材质的可混合位置属性必须设为“色调映射后”进行正确的校准显示。

Key: When the VisualizeCalibrationGrayscale show flag is enabled, this path will be used as the post-process material to render. The post-process material's Blendable Location property must be set to "After Tonemapping" for proper calibration display.
Value: VisualizeCalibrationGrayscalEDisplay标记被启用时，该路径将被用作渲染的后期处理材质。后期处理材质的可混合位置属性必须设为“色调映射后”进行正确的校准显示。

Key: When this and "Write to Intrinsic Value" is true, the current values values will be output to particles.position.
Value: 此项与“写入内置值”均启用时，将当前值输出到 particles.position。

Key: When this emitter reawakens after being put to sleep by scalability,  it will reset its' emitter age so that burst spawns will refire and the life cycle of the emitter will begin again.
Value: 发射器因可扩展性休眠后重新唤醒时，会重置发射器年龄，使爆发生成重新触发并重新开始生命周期。

Key: When this module sets Particles.Velocity it is recommended that you add "Solve Forces And Velocity" to the particle update stack.
Value: 此模块设置 Particles.Velocity 时，建议在粒子更新堆栈中添加“求解力与速度”。

Key: When this number is smaller than the Curl Noise Cone Mask Angle the user will see a soft falloff of force contribution between this angle and the final Curl Noise Cone Mask Angle.
Value: 当此数值小于卷曲噪声锥形掩码角度时，用户将在此角度与最终角度之间看到力贡献的柔和衰减。

Key:
When this option is disabled, we use the previous frame's data for the camera and issue the simulation early. This greatly
      reduces overhead and allows the game thread to run faster, but comes at a tradeoff if the dependencies might leave gaps or other visual artifacts.
Value:
禁用此选项后，我们将使用摄像机的前一帧数据，并提前开始模拟。
      这样可以大大降低开销，并使游戏线程运行得更快，但代价是，依赖项可能会导致空白或出现其他视觉瑕疵。

Key:
When this option is disabled, we use the previous frame's data for the skeletal mesh and can often issue the simulation early. This greatly
      reduces overhead and allows the game thread to run faster, but comes at a tradeoff if the dependencies might leave gaps or other visual artifacts.
Value:
禁用此选项时，会使用上一帧的骨骼网格体数据，通常可以更早启动模拟。这能显著
降低开销并加快游戏线程，但依赖关系可能因此产生间隙或其他视觉伪影。

Key: When true the GPU simulation debug display will enabled, allowing information used during simulation to be visualized.
Value: 设为true时，将启用GPU模拟调试显示，从而显示模拟中使用的信息。

Key: When true the location is a world location, when false it's relative to the player and is in camera space.
Value: 为true时，位置是一个世界位置；为false时，它相对于播放器，且在摄像机空间中。

Key: When true the particle will sample the custom depth buffer rather than the traditional depth buffer.
Value: 启用时，粒子将采样自定义深度缓冲区，而非常规深度缓冲区。

Key:
When true the plane will remain attached to the near clip plane. 

Otherwise it will place the sprite closer to the bounding box in world space. It will not touch the outter edge of the bounding box at all times. This can be used to reduce overdraw.
Value: 启用时平面保持附着近裁剪面；否则将精灵放在世界空间包围盒附近，可减少过度绘制。

Key: When true, a rest state can only be achieved when the colliding surface's normal aligns with a user defined vector.
Value: 为真时，仅当碰撞表面的法线与用户指定的向量对齐时，才允许进入静止状态。

Key: When true, allows the user to tweak the vector variable by using a 3D transform widget in the viewport (usable when varible is public/enabled).
Value: 当该项为true时，允许用户通过视口中的3D变换控件调整向量变量（变量为公开或已启用状态时即可使用此控件）。

Key: When true, allows to share Lumen Cards between different instances even when material uses world position or per instance data, which may change material look per instance. All materials on a component needs this flag set for sharing to work.
Value: 为true时，即使材质使用世界位置或每个实例的数据，也允许在不同实例之间共享Lumen卡，这可能会变更每个实例的材质外观。组件上的所有材质都需要设置此标记才能共享。

Key: When true, current value will transition to the target value at a set rate rather than as a percentage of the delta over time.
Value: 启用时，当前值将按设定速率过渡到目标值，而不是按时间差的百分比过渡。

Key: When true, each emitter will randomly offset it's curl noise samples from other emitter's curl noise samples.
Value: 启用时，每个发射器的卷曲噪声采样相对于其他发射器的采样具有随机偏移。

Key: When true, each vertex position and the triangle normal will be written to float 4 values that can be used to debug the triangle's layout.
Value: 启用时，每个顶点位置和三角形法线会写入浮点 4 值，可用于调试三角形布局。

Key:
When true, Emitter.Spawn group for any spawned particles will be overridden to the index of the data channel element that generated that spawn.
Doing this will submit all NDC spawns individually and will be less performant.
However it will allow particles to access the NDC data that generated then via the SpawnGroup value.
It will also mean that Exec Index will be correct on a per NDC Entry level.
Without this settings ExecIndex will be 0...TotalSpawnCount-1. With this it will be 0...SpawnCount for each NDC item individually.
Unless absolutely needed this is discouraged as it comes at significant performance cost when spawning and GPU emitters can currently only handle 8 individual spawns per frame.
Calling GetNDCSpawnInfo() in the particle spawn script to get the spawning NDC Index is preferred.
Value:
为true时，任何生成粒子的Emitter.Spawn组将被重载为生成该Spawn的数据通道元素的索引。
这样做将单独提交所有NDC生成，并且性能会降低。
然而，它将允许粒子通过SpawnGroup值访问随后生成的NDC数据。
这也意味着Exec索引在每个NDC入口级别上都是正确的。
如果没有此设置，ExecIndex将为0...TotalSpawnCount-1。如果有此设置，每个NDC项将为0...SpawnCount。
除非绝对需要，否则不鼓励这样做，因为在生成时会产生大幅的性能成本，并且GPU发射器目前每帧只能处理8个单独的生成。
首选在粒子生成脚本中调用GetNDCSpawnInfo()来获取生成的NDC索引。

Key: When true, GPU particles that are lodged within meshes will be deleted. This adds realism to the simulation as interpentrations are avoided.
Value: 启用时，将删除嵌入网格体内部的 GPU 粒子，从而避免穿插并提升模拟真实感。

Key: When true, kernel samples will be compared to the center value. If the value delta is too great the sample will be discarded.
Value: 启用时，将核采样值与中心值比较。如果差值过大，则丢弃该采样。

Key: When true, MeshOrientation will be overwritten.  When false, the raw orientation calculated from the align to vector op will be output.
Value: 启用时覆盖 MeshOrientation；禁用时输出“对齐到向量”运算计算出的原始朝向。

Key: When true, sprite renderer parameters will be written out that can be used to draw debug lines for your effects. Be sure to change your alignment to custom alignment and bind the appropriate position, color, sprite size and sprite alignment parameters.
Value: 启用时输出可绘制调试线的精灵参数；需将对齐设为自定义并绑定位置、颜色、精灵大小和对齐参数。

Key: When true, the audio does not start directly with the target volume, but fades in over time. Same for stopping, it fades out rather than ending abruptly.
Value: 启用时，音频不会直接以目标音量开始，而会随时间淡入；停止时同样淡出而非突然结束。

Key: When true, the base stage's output will be multiplied by this stage (darkening it where it is translucent).
Value: 为true时，基础阶段的输出将乘以此阶段（在半透明之处使其变暗）。

Key:
When true, the input velocity, surface normal and particle radius are used to update the mesh orientation variable. When false, the last calculated rotation rate will be used. 

"Rotation Rate" can be used to further modify this behaviour.
Value: 启用时使用输入速度、表面法线和粒子半径更新网格体朝向；禁用时使用上次计算的旋转速率。

Key: When true, the intrinsic sprite alignment and sprite facing variables will be set to the plane's x and z basis vectors.
Value: 启用时，内置的精灵对齐和精灵朝向变量将分别设为平面的 x 和 z 基向量。

Key:
When true, the module will multiply the tick delta value by the rate of change value and add it to the output value. 

When false, the output value will remain unmodified.
Value: 启用时，将更新步长乘以变化率并加到输出值；禁用时，输出值保持不变。

Key: When true, the module will write to Particles.Position, Particles.SpriteFacing, etc. rather than just to Output.Module.Position.
Value: 启用时，模块写入 Particles.Position、Particles.SpriteFacing 等，而不仅写入 Output.Module.Position。

Key: When true, the OnTimer and OffTimer values will be directly set. This is done to offset each particle's phase. It's recommended that this is only performed for one frame. For that reason,  Output.ParticleState.FirstFrame from the ParticleState Module is referenced by default.
Value: 启用时直接设置 OnTimer 和 OffTimer，使每个粒子相位偏移；建议仅执行一帧，默认引用 Output.ParticleState.FirstFrame。

Key:
When true, the particles will align to a specific location in each grid cell. 

When false, the particles will be evenly placed from one edge of the user defined volume to the other.
Value: 启用时，粒子将在每个网格单元中的特定位置对齐；禁用时，粒子会从用户定义体积的一端到另一端均匀放置。

Key:
When true, the PhysicalMaterials list is used to ban specified materials for collision events but allow all others.
When false, the PhysicalMaterials list is used to allow only specified materials for collision events and ban all others.
Value:
为true时，PhysicalMaterials列表将用于禁用碰撞事件的指定材质，但会允许其他所有材质。
为false时，PhysicalMaterials列表将用于仅允许碰撞事件的指定材质，并禁用其他所有材质。

Key: When true, the pre-updated velocity, physics force and position variables will be written to Particles[PRESOLVE]X parameters. This is needed for post solve collisions. Note that  this should only be enabled in the first solver if multiple solvers are used in sequence.
Value: 启用时，将预求解速度、物理力和位置写入 Particles[PRESOLVE]X 参数，供求解后碰撞使用；多个求解器串联时仅在第一个启用。

Key:
When true, the sampled mesh orientation quat will be applied to the mesh relative to the initial mesh orientation quat. This allows one to apply the rotation as a relative offset. 

When false, the sampled mesh orientation quat will be applied directly.
Value: 启用时，采样网格体朝向四元数相对于初始朝向应用，作为相对偏移；禁用时直接应用。

Key: When true, the script will map the search vector to the mesh surface and maintain it's length. When false the search vector will be projected down to the mesh surface but its original length will not be retained.
Value: 启用时，将搜索向量映射到网格体表面并保持长度；禁用时，将搜索向量投影到表面但不保留原长度。

Key: When true, the search vector will be updated every frame based off of the forces applied to the particles in the particle update script.
Value: 启用时，根据粒子更新脚本中施加于粒子的力，每帧更新搜索向量。

Key:
When true, the system will process the neighbor grid particle indices as Particle.ID indices rather than exec indices. 

Note that the neighbor grid must store particle ids as well when this feature is used.
Value:
启用时，系统将邻居网格粒子索引作为 Particle.ID 索引，而非执行索引。

使用此功能时邻居网格也必须存储粒子 ID。

Key:
When true, the system will store the Particle.ID indices rather than exec indices. Module's that use this information down stream have to support particle id usage. 

Version 3 of the the Intraparticle collision module for instance, contains a checkbox that decodes the neighbor grid appropriately.
Value: 启用时系统存储 Particle.ID 索引而非执行索引，下游模块必须支持粒子 ID；例如粒子间碰撞模块第 3 版可正确解码邻居网格。

Key: When true, the total trace length will be subdivided evenly across each iteration of the encapsulating simulation stage.
Value: 启用时，总追踪长度将在所属模拟阶段的每次迭代之间均匀分配。

Key: When true, this module will combine the calculated orientation update and the existing  mesh orientation quat. If false, this module's mesh orientation quat will be output by itself.
Value: 启用时，将计算出的朝向更新与现有网格体朝向四元数合并；禁用时，仅输出本模块的网格体朝向四元数。

Key: When true, translucent materials have fog computed for every pixel, which costs more but fixes artifacts due to low tessellation.
Value: 设为true后，将对半透明材质的每个像素计算雾气，开销更大但可修复低曲面细分带来的瑕疵。

Key: When true, translucent materials receive cloud contribution as part of the fog evaluation, per vertex or per pixel according to the other selected options. This is a rough approximation but can help in some cases. Defaults to false. Fog is applied on clouds, so Apply Fogging must be true to use this feature.
Value: 如果为true，则根据其他选定选项，半透明材质将每顶点或每像素雾计算的一部分作为云的贡献而接受。这是一个粗略模拟，但在某些情况下可能有所帮助。默认为false。雾将应用于云，因此要使用此功能，“应用雾”必须为true。

Key:
When true, translucent materials that write velocity will calculate it only based on the written depth and camera movement.
This can be useful for translucent volume raycasts which write pixel depth offset and want to calculate velocity based on the output depth.
Value:
设为true时，写入速度的半透明材质将仅根据写入的深度和摄像机的移动来计算速度。
这对于写入像素深度偏移并希望根据输出深度计算速度的半透明体积光线投射非常实用。

Key: When true, translucent materials will output motion vectors and write to depth buffer in velocity pass.
Value: 当为true时，半透明材质将输出运动向量，并写入速度通道中的深度缓冲。

Key: When true, use the "Setup Rigid Body DI" module in emitter update to find nearby rigid bodies using a spatial query. Note that both this module and the "Setup..." module must point to the same Rigid Mesh Collision Query user variable.
Value: 启用时，在发射器更新中使用“设置刚体数据接口”通过空间查询查找附近刚体；两个模块必须使用同一用户变量。

Key: When true, we allow this DI to sample from streaming LODs. Selectively overriding the CVar fx.Niagara.NDIStaticMesh.UseInlineLODsOnly.
Value: 为true时，我们允许此DI从流送LODs中采样。选择性地重载CVar fx.Niagara.NDIStaticMesh.UseInlineLODsOnly。

Key:
When used in particle update add a Solve Forces and Velocity module to the bottom of the stack. 

When applied to the particle spawn script, add an "Apply Initial Forces" module to the end of particle spawn.
Value: 用于粒子更新时，将“求解力与速度”添加到堆栈底部；用于粒子生成脚本时，将“应用初始力”添加到末尾。

Key:
When used in particle update, add a "Solve Forces and Velocity" module to the bottom of the stack. 

When used within particle spawn, add an "Apply Initial Forces" module to the end of the stack.
Value:
用于粒子更新时，将“求解力与速度”模块添加到堆栈底部。

用于粒子生成时，将“应用初始力”模块添加到堆栈末尾。

Key:
When used in particle update, add a "Solve Rotational Forces and Velocity" module to the bottom of the stack. 

When used within particle spawn, add an "Apply Initial Forces" module to the bottom of the stack.
Value: 用于粒子更新时，将“求解旋转力与速度”添加到堆栈底部；用于粒子生成时，将“应用初始力”添加到底部。

Key: When using a delay, can force an emitter set to infinite or multiple loops to delay only the first loop, with subsequent loops having no delay.
Value: 使用延迟时，可强制设为无限循环或多次循环的发射器仅延迟第一轮，后续循环不延迟。

Key: When using simulation stages and bRequiresContext is true this will be the index of the stage that is associated with the function.
Value: 当使用模拟阶段且bRequiresContext为true时，这将是与该函数关联的阶段的索引。

Key: When using SubImage lookups for particles, this variable contains the number of columns in X and the number of rows in Y.
Value: 使用粒子的子图像查找时，此变量包括X中列的数量和Y中行的数量。

Key: When valid the user parameter is used as the render target rather than creating one internal, note that the input render target will be adjusted by the Niagara simulation
Value: 用户参数有效时，将其用作渲染目标，而不是在内部创建。注意：输入的渲染目标会被Niagara模拟调整。

Key: Where baked textures are placed. Intentionally not a config as it's heavily dependent on where the stage is
Value: 放置烘焙纹理的位置。故意并非配置，因为它严重依赖于阶段的位置

Key: Where the matched Texture assets should be placed into the Texture Set. Links to the channel for the given asset.
Value: 匹配的纹理资产应放入纹理集中。指向给定资产的通道的链接。

Key: Whether 'Use Asset Materials On Components' should only update the selected components, or update all components using this asset
Value: “在组件上使用资产材质”只应更新选定组件，还是更新使用此资产的所有组件

Key: Whether Collision is possible. This boolean must be true in order for the collision query to set Collision.Valid on the subsequent collision modules.
Value: 是否可能发生碰撞。此布尔值必须为真，后续碰撞模块的查询才能设置 Collision.Valid。

Key:
Whether lights from this renderer should affect translucency.
Use with caution - if enabled, create only a few particle lights at most, and the smaller they are, the less they will cost.
Value:
此渲染器发出的光源是否影响半透明度。
请谨慎使用。如启动，最多仅能创建些许粒子光源；其数量越少，所需开销越少。

Key:
Whether lights from this renderer should be handled by MegaLights.
Use with caution - if enabled, create only a few particle lights at most and keep them as small as possible. Look out for increased noise and sampling cost.
Value:
此渲染器的光源是否应由MegaLights处理。
请谨慎使用 - 如果启用，请最多只创建少量粒子光源，并使其尽可能小。注意增加的噪点和采样成本。

Key:
Whether or not a subject from the specific source is the enabled subject.
Only 1 subject with the same name can be enabled.
At the start of the frame, a snapshot of the enabled subjects will be made.
That snapshot dictate which subject will be used for the duration of that frame.
Value:
来自特定源的主题是否为启用的主题。
拥有相同名称的主题只能启用一个。
在帧开始时，将对启用主题进行快照。
该快照决定在该帧的时长中将使用哪个主题。

Key: Whether or not simulations should start playing automatically when the emitter or system editor is opened, or when the data is changed in the editor.
Value: 发射器或系统编译器开启，或编辑器中的数据变更时，模拟是否开始自动运行。

Key:
Whether or not the client has a subject with this name enabled
Only 1 subject with the same name can be enabled.
At the start of the frame, a snapshot of the enabled subjects will be made.
That snapshot dictate which subject will be used for the duration of that frame.
Value:
客户端是否启用了拥有此名称的主题
拥有相同名称的主题只能启用一个。
在帧开始时，将对启用主题进行快照。
该快照决定在该帧的时长中将使用哪个主题。

Key: Whether or not the Depth Buffer should be contributing to the generated Surface Distance Field (similar to a signed distance field.)
Value: 确定深度缓冲区是否参与生成的表面距离场（类似有符号距离场）。

Key: Whether or not the Landscape should be contributing to the generated Surface Distance Field (similar to a signed distance field.)
Value: 确定地形是否参与生成的表面距离场（类似有符号距离场）。

Key: Whether or not this blueprint's class is a abstract class or not.  Should set CLASS_Abstract in the KismetCompiler.
Value: 此蓝图的类是否为一个抽象类。应在KismetCompiler中设置CLASS_Abstract。

Key: Whether or not this blueprint's class is a const class or not.  Should set CLASS_Const in the KismetCompiler.
Value: 此蓝图的类是否为一个常量类。应在KismetCompiler中设置CLASS_Const。

Key: Whether or not this variable should be flagged with CPF_SaveGame, and inherit its name from the GUID of the macro that that gave rise to it
Value: 是否以CPF_SaveGame标记此变量，并从将其提高的宏的GUID处继承命名

Key: Whether or not to create materials according to found Face Set names (will not work without face sets)
Value: 是否根据找到的面集命名来创建材质（无面集则无法使用）

Key: Whether or not to enable material parameter caching on the skeletal mesh components created for each state
Value: 是否在为每个状态创建的骨骼网格体组件上启用材质参数缓存。

Key: Whether or not to try and find materials according to found Face Set names (will not work without face sets)
Value: 是否根据找到的面集命名来尝试并寻找材质（无面集则无法使用）

Key: whether or not you want to continuously rerun the construction script for an actor as you drag it in the editor, or only when the drag operation is complete
Value: 在编辑器中拖动actor时是否连续运行其构造脚本，或只在拖动操作完成后运行

Key: Whether the binding is enabled or disabled by default. The instance may enable the binding at runtime.
Value: 默认情况下启用或禁用绑定。此实例可以在运行时启用绑定。

Key: Whether the blueprint must be run on the game thread -- i.e. if it may use nodes that aren't thread safe.
Value: 蓝图是否必须在游戏线程上运行——即是否可以使用非线程安全的节点。

Key: Whether the converter process was cancelled due to an unrecoverable error in the python script process.
Value: 是否由于python脚本进程中的不可恢复错误而取消转换器进程。

Key: Whether the data generated by the niagara data interface should be published to CPU emitters in other Niagara systems. Setting this to true will have a minor performance impact.
Value: Niagara数据接口生成的数据是否应发布到其他Niagara系统中的CPU发射器。将其设为true会对性能产生轻微影响。

Key: Whether the data generated by the niagara data interface should be published to GPU emitters in other Niagara systems. Setting this to true will have a minor performance impact.
Value: Niagara数据接口生成的数据是否应发布到其他Niagara系统中的GPU发射器。将其设为true会对性能产生轻微影响。

Key: Whether the data generated by the niagara data interface should be published to the world game data channel. This is required to allow game BP and C++ to read this data. Setting this to true will have a minor performance impact.
Value: Niagara数据接口生成的数据是否应该发布到世界游戏数据通道。这是允许游戏蓝图和C++读取此数据所必需。将其设为true会对性能产生轻微影响。

Key: Whether the graph editor is currently part of a debugging session (any non-debugging commands should be disabled).
Value: 图表编辑器当前是否为调试会话的一部分（禁用所有非调试命令）。

Key: Whether the mask result should be inverted when applied. This is stored in the material as a float to allow runtime modification.
Value: 应用时是否应反转遮罩结果。它以浮点形式存储在材质中，以允许运行时修改。

Key: Whether the material should allow outputting negative emissive color values.  Only allowed on unlit materials.
Value: 是否允许材质输出负的自发光颜色值。仅无光照材质支持此功能。

Key:
Whether the material takes a tangent space normal or a world space normal as input.
(TangentSpace requires extra instructions but is often more convenient).
Value:
材质使用切线空间法线还是世界空间法线作为输入。
（TangentSpace需要额外指令，但通常更方便。）

Key: Whether the Niagara system should be immediately destroyed at the end of the notify state or be allowed to finish
Value: Niagara系统将在通知状态结束时立即销毁，或是能够完成

Key:
Whether the opaque material has any pixel animations happening, that isn't included in the geometric velocities.
This allows to disable renderer's heuristics that assumes animation is fully described with motion vector, such as TSR's anti-flickering heuristic.
Value:
不透明材质是否存在未计入几何速度的像素动画。
此选项允许禁用假定运动向量已完整描述动画的渲染器启发式机制，例如TSR的抗闪烁机制。

Key: Whether the selected material is applied to actors that are added to the composite meshes list in the Plate layer
Value: 是否将选中的材质应用到添加到Plate层复合网格列表中的Actor

Key: Whether the surface represents a dielectric (such as plastic) or a conductor (such as metal). (type = float, unit = unitless, defaults to 0 = dielectric)
Value: 表面是否代表绝缘体（例如塑料）或导体（例如金属）。（类型 = 浮点、单位 = 无单位、默认为0 = 绝缘体）

Key: Whether the texture should be sampled with per view mip biasing for sharper output with Temporal AA.
Value: 是否应使用尖锐输出（带临时抗锯齿）的逐视图mip偏重。

Key:
Whether this DI should request updated destination data from the Data Channel each tick.
Depending on the data channel this could be an expensive search so we should avoid doing this every tick if possible.
Value:
这个DI是否应该每次tick都从数据通道请求更新的目标数据。
根据数据通道的不同，这可能是一个昂贵的搜索，所以我们应该尽可能避免每tick都这样做。

Key:
Whether this DI should request updated source data from the Data Channel each tick.
Some Data Channels have multiple separate source data elements for things such as spatial subdivision.
Each DI will request the correct one for it's owning system instance from the data channel.
Depending on the data channel this could be an expensive search so we should avoid doing this every tick if possible.
Value:
这个DI是否应该每次tick都从数据通道请求更新的源数据。
一些数据通道有多个单独源数据元素，例如空间细分。
每个DI将从数据通道请求它所拥有的系统实例的正确的那个。
根据数据通道的不同，这可能是一个昂贵的搜索，所以我们应该尽可能避免每tick都这样做。

Key: Whether this pin represents a branch. If it does not represent a branch, then it is a value-providing pin.
Value: 这个引脚是否代表一个分支。如果它不代表分支，那么它就是一个提供值的引脚。

Key:
Whether to allow input events to be created/displayed in animation blueprints.

You used to be able to place input event nodes in anim graphs and they would just not work, sometimes causing an ensure.

If needed, you can enable this legacy behavior by setting this property to true (allowing input events to be placed in a graph).

Default value is false.
Value:
是否允许在动画蓝图中创建/显示输入事件。

你曾经可以在动画图中放置输入事件节点，但它们无法工作，有时会导致一个保证。

如果需要，你可以通过将此属性设为true（允许将输入事件放置在图中）来启用此旧版行为。

默认值为false。

Key: Whether to allow restrict which base function overrides can created/displayed in animation blueprints
Value: 是否允许限制在动画蓝图中创建/显示哪些基函数重载

Key: Whether to allow to share Lumen Cards between different instances even when material uses world position or per instance data, which may change material look per instance. All materials on a component needs this flag set for sharing to work.
Value: 即使材质使用了世界坐标或逐实例数据（可能导致每个实例的材质外观不同），是否仍允许在不同实例之间共享Lumen卡。组件上的所有材质都必须设置此标志，共享功能才能生效。

Key: Whether to attempt to merge materials that are deemed equivalent. This can cause artifacts in the merged mesh if world position/actor position etc. is used to determine output color.
Value: 是否尝试合并被视为相同的材质。如场景位置/actor位置等用于确定输出颜色，此操作可能导致合并网格体中出现瑕疵。

Key:
Whether to automatically set usage flags on this material or its instances based on what they are applied to in the editor.
Note that adding usage flags accidentally can add unwanted shader permutations.
Value:
是否根据此材质或其实例在编辑器中应用的对象来自动设置使用标记。
请注意，意外添加用法标记可能会添加不必要的着色器置换。

Key: Whether to bake the landscape material's vertical world position offset into the collision heightfield. Only z (vertical) offset is supported.
Value: 是否将地形材质的垂直世界位置偏移烘焙到碰撞高度场中。仅支持Z轴（垂直）偏移。

Key: Whether to clamp the texture lookup.  Necessary when sampling a UserSceneTexture at reduced resolution with filtering, to avoid blending out of bounds pixels.
Value: 是否限制纹理查找。当通过过滤以降低的分辨率对UserSceneTexture进行采样时，这是必要，以避免混合越界像素。

Key: Whether to compute materials' mask opacity only in early Z pass. Changing this setting requires restarting the editor.
Value: 是否只在早Z通道中计算材质的遮罩不透明度。修改此设置需要重启编辑器。

Key:
Whether to do a Gather of the given component from 4 neighboring texels (xyzw in counter clockwise order starting with the sample to the lower left).
Only works with Texture2D or TextureCube.  Doesn't work with virtual textures.
Value:
是否从4个相邻纹素（从左下角的样本开始，按逆时针方向xyzw排列）收集给定组件。
仅适用于Texture2D或TextureCube。不适用于虚拟纹理。

Key: Whether to draw on top of opaque pixels even if behind them. This only has meaning for translucency.
Value: 即使位于不透明像素后方，是否仍绘制在其上方。此选项仅对半透明有效。

Key: Whether to enable namespace filtering features in the Blueprint editor // @todo_namespaces - Remove this if/when dependent code is changed to utilize the single setting above.
Value: 是否在蓝图编辑器中启用命名空间过滤功能 // @todo_namespaces - 如果/当依赖代码被改为利用上面的单个设置时，则将其移除。

Key: Whether to enable namespace importing features in the Blueprint editor // @todo_namespaces - Remove this if/when dependent code is changed to utilize the single setting above.
Value: 是否在蓝图编辑器中启用命名空间导入功能 // @todo_namespaces - 如果/当依赖代码被改为利用上面的单个设置时，则将其移除。

Key: Whether to enable the "Index All" action in the Find-in-Blueprints search window when blueprint assets with an out-of-date index (search metadata) are found and whether to allow automatic resaving. WARNING: Only allow "Index All" if your project is small enough that all assets can be loaded in memory at once. Only enable saving if you are allowed to potentially checkout and resave all assets.
Value: 当找到拥有过时索引（搜索元数据）的蓝图资产时，是否在“在蓝图中查找”搜索窗口中启用“索引所有”操作，以及是否允许自动重新保存。警告：如果你的项目足够小，可以一次将所有资产加载到内存中，则仅允许“索引所有”。仅当允许你检出并重新保存所有资产时才启用保存。

Key:
Whether to generate textures storing the AO computed by Lightmass.
These can be accessed through the PrecomputedAOMask material node,
Which is useful for blending between material layers on environment assets.
Be sure to set DirectIlluminationOcclusionFraction and IndirectIlluminationOcclusionFraction to 0 if you only want the PrecomputedAOMask!
Value:
是否生成纹理来保存由Lightmass计算的AO。
它们可通过PrecomputedAOMask材质节点来进行访问，
适用于在环境资产上的材质图层之间进行混合。
如果只需要PrecomputedAOMask，则将DirectIlluminationOcclusionFraction和IndirectIlluminationOcclusionFraction设为0！

Key:
Whether to include the property GUIDs for the generated class in a cooked build.
@note This option may slightly increase memory usage in a cooked build, but can avoid needing to add CoreRedirect data for Blueprint classes stored within SaveGame archives.
Value:
是否应该在烘焙版本中包含生成的类的属性GUID。
@注意：这个选项可能会稍微增加烘焙版本中的内存使用率，但可以避免需要添加保存在SaveGame档案中的蓝图类的CoreRedirect数据。

Key: Whether to inherit the set of imported namespaces from the parent class hierarchy // @todo_namespaces - Remove this if/when this becomes a permanent setting. For now this is experimental.
Value: 是否从父类层级继承导入命名空间的集// @todo_namespaces - 如果/当它成为永久设置时，将此删除。目前仍在实验性阶段。

Key: Whether to list this function in the material function library, which is a window in the material editor that lists categorized functions.
Value: 是否在材质函数库中列出此函数，此函数库是在材质编辑器中列出未分类函数的窗口。

Key: Whether to merge source materials into one flat material, ONLY available when LOD Selection Type is set to LowestDetailLOD
Value: 是否将源材质合并到一个平面材质中，仅当LOD选择类型设为LowestDetailLOD时可用

Key: Whether to reset the materials along with the rest of the collection, or attempt to keep the current materials across the reset.
Value: 是否将材质与集合的其余部分一起重设，或者尝试在重设中保留当前材质。

Key: Whether to show a zoom-invariant comment bubble when zoomed out (making the comment readable at any distance).
Value: 是否在缩小时显示一个缩放不变评论气泡（使评论在任何距离均可见）。

Key: Whether to use density ( for mass computation ) from physics material ( if physics material is not set, use the component one or defaults )
Value: 是否使用来自物理材质的密度（用于质量计算）（如果物理材质未设置，使用组件1或默认）

Key: Whether to use physically based inverse squared falloff from the light.  If unchecked, the value from the LightExponent binding will be used instead.
Value: 是否基于反转的平方衰减进行物理性使用。若未勾选，将替换使用LightExponent绑定中的值。

Key: Whether to use point sampled texture lookup (default) or using [bi-linear] filtered (can be slower, avoid faceted lock with distortions)
